text.title: 钢铁之核
text.objectives: 从恐轨车站的列车引擎里取得钢铁之核[仅限英雄难度]。
text.description: 如果不能汇聚烈焰之核的力量，那么获得它也就变得毫无意义了。地精们不知怎的研究出了汇聚的方法——那技术被应用到了“钢铁之星”引擎当中，钢铁部落正在德拉诺各处大肆使用这种引擎。我们得把最大的引擎核心找来。$b$b最好的办法就是让他们的某列火车脱轨，然后弄开引擎舱。不如突袭恐轨车站吧……
text.progress: Did you get the engine core?$B$BOrdinarily I wouldn't ask you to assault a fortified moving train - ah, no, that's not true. This is exactly the sort of thing I'm going to need from you. All the time.
text.completion: Oh very good. I've been waiting to get a close look at one of these - let's open it up here.$B$BHmmmmm...$B$BWell, those goblins aren't very creative but their methods have a certain brute-force charm to them. It's amazing this thing doesn't explode. Or maybe it does. At least I'm beginning to understand what they use a "samophlange" for.$B$BThis will work. Well done, $n!

english.title: Core of Iron
english.objectives: Collect a Core of Iron from the engine of the Grimrail Depot train [Heroic only.]
english.description: There's no point in getting a Core of Flame without any way to focus its power. Somehow, the goblins figured out how to do it - the technology is used in the "Iron Star" engines that the Iron Horde is using extensively throughout Draenor. We're gonna need the biggest engine core that we can find.$b$bOur best bet is to derail one of their trains and crack open the engine compartment. I suggest a raid on the Grimrail Depot...
english.progress: Did you get the engine core?$B$BOrdinarily I wouldn't ask you to assault a fortified moving train - ah, no, that's not true. This is exactly the sort of thing I'm going to need from you. All the time.
english.completion: Замечательно. Давно хотел посмотреть на такое вблизи... Давай откроем.$b$bХм...$b$bЧто ж, творческим их подход не назовешь, но определенное своеобразное очарование в гоблинской работе есть – этого не отнять. Удивительно, как эта штука не взрывается. Хотя, может, и взрывается. По крайней мере, теперь я понимаю, для чего они используют "самофланж".$b$bВсе получится. Отлично, $n!

text.title: 生命之核
text.objectives: 消灭永茂林地的雅努并取得生命之核[仅限英雄难度]。
text.description: 占卜活物是一种非常特殊的魔法，如果我们想要在整个德拉诺世界中寻找古尔丹的话，就要用到一种非常强大的活体试剂。$b$b答案就在德拉诺的植物当中。有种名叫“原祖荆兽”的生物，它们是我们所能接触到的生物当中与塑造了这世界上所有生命的那些原始生物最接近的物种。$b$b我们在戈尔隆德的一处肯瑞托哨站遭到了侵袭，有人在那里发现了一只名叫“雅努”的原祖荆兽。去消灭它，把它的心带给我！
text.progress: How fares the outpost? More importantly... where's my core of life?
text.completion: Oh - it's still alive! Can you feel that?$B$BI must return this to the soil of Draenor when we are done with it. Perhaps in the care of the Cenarion Circle, who can ensure that it doesn't grow into another corrupted threat.$B$BWell done, $n. This was no easy feat.

english.title: Core of Life
english.objectives: Collect a Core of Life by slaying Yalnu in the Everbloom [Heroic only].
english.description: Scrying for a living being is a very specific kind of magic, and if we want to search the whole of Draenor for Gul'dan, we're going to need a very powerful living reagent.$b$bThe answer lies with the plant life of Draenor itself. There is a creature known as a "genesaur" who is the closest we can get to the primordial creatures who shaped all life on this world.$b$bOne of our Kirin-Tor outposts has been overrun in Gorgrond, and a genesaur named "Yalnu" was spotted. Kill it, and bring its heart to me!
english.progress: How fares the outpost? More importantly... where's my core of life?
english.completion: Ого, еще живое! Ты чувствуешь?$b$bЯ обязательно верну его в землю Дренора, когда мы закончим. Надеюсь, Круг Кенария не допустит его превращения в еще одно оскверненное чудовище.$b$bОтличная работа, $n. Это было весьма непростое задание.

text.title: Tackling Teron'gor
text.objectives: Obtain Corrupted Blood of Teron'gor from Teron'gor in Auchindoun [Heroic only].
text.description: I just received dark news from Exarch Maladaar that may be of use to us. Shadow Council agents have infiltrated Auchindoun! I guarantee Gul'dan's minions are behind this - likely Teron'gor, his right-hand orc.$b$bLet's pull him from the chessboard, $n. Kill Teron'gor!$b$bBring me a vial of his corrupt blood, and I can use it to track down other Shadow Council troublemakers... Including Gul'dan. Our prey will not be able to hide.
text.progress: What news of Auchindoun? Are the spirits of the draenei safe?$B$BWas I right about Teron'gor?
text.completion: We've done a great thing today, $n. We've deprived Gul'dan of one of his top lieutenants and we're one step closer to finding the fiend himself.
text.completed: Bring the Corrupted Blood to Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

english.objectives: Obtain Corrupted Blood of Teron'gor from Teron'gor in Auchindoun [Heroic only].

Kill Teron'gor!$b$bBring me a vial of his corrupt blood, and I can use it to track down other Shadow Council troublemakers... Including Gul'dan. Our prey will not be able to hide.
english.progress: What news of Auchindoun? Are the spirits of the draenei safe?$B$BWas I right about Teron'gor?
english.completion: Сегодня большой день, $n. Мы уничтожили одного из главных приспешников Гул'дана и еще на один шаг приблизились к тому, чтобы найти его самого.
english.completed: Bring the Corrupted Blood to Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

text.title: Eyes of the Archmage
text.objectives: Speak with Khadgar and guard him as he performs his scrying spell.
text.description: With the blood of Teron'gor and the crystals you collected for me, I should be able to zero in on our target. Step outside with me and I will begin my scrying spell. Speak with me to start - be ready for anything!
text.completion: Gul'dan is countering my magic, $n! He's hiding!$B$BHe's a crafty one, but we're craftier. I think I know a way to increase the power and range of my spell...
text.completed: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

english.title: Eyes of the Archmage
english.objectives: Speak with Khadgar and guard him as he performs his scrying spell.
english.description: With the blood of Teron'gor and the crystals you collected for me, I should be able to zero in on our target. Step outside with me and I will begin my scrying spell. Speak with me to start - be ready for anything!
english.completion: Gul'dan resists my magic, $n! Hiding, scoundrel! $b$bWell, nothing, we’ll find it on him. I know how to increase the strength and range of my spell ...
english.completed: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

text.title: Tarnished Bronze
text.objectives: Speak to Archmage Khadgar to choose your preferred role, and defeat the Spirit of Kairozdormu.
text.description: That dead dragon's essence has seeped into the very fabric of this light-forsaken world. His spirit is also restless. If you and I are to claim what remains of his power, we're going to need to finish the job that Garrosh started.$b$bI'm going to need to rely on your tactical combat expertise, commander. Would you prefer to go on the offensive, to fight defensively, or to heal us?$b$bThe decision is yours. Speak to me when you are ready, and the three of us will destroy Kairoz once and for all.
text.completion: <The archmage is out of breath.>$B$BGive me - give me a moment. Pshew.$B$B$n, that was incredible! You are possibly the greatest $C I've ever had the honor to fight alongside.
text.completed: Speak to Archmage Khadgar at the Time-Lost Glade in Nagrand.

english.title: Tarnished Bronze
english.objectives: Speak to Archmage Khadgar to choose your preferred role, and defeat the Spirit of Kairozdormu.
english.description: That dead dragon's essence has seeped into the very fabric of this light-forsaken world. His spirit is also restless. If you and I are to claim what remains of his power, we're going to need to finish the job that Garrosh started.$b$bI'm going to need to rely on your tactical combat expertise, commander. english.completion: <The upper magician is choking. >$b$b Give me...> one minute. Uh...$b$b.That was just unbelievable, $n! Perhaps you're $g-largest:greatest:c; |3-6($c), shoulder to shoulder with $gwhich..:who:c; I have had the honor of fighting.
english.completed: Speak to Archmage Khadgar at the Time-Lost Glade in Nagrand.

text.title: 帝国的陨落
text.objectives: 从悬槌堡里找到破魔者法典和巫师之王印记。
text.description: 食人魔巫师之王——元首马尔高克掌握着被视作奥术秘法边缘的强大魔法技巧。在他麾下的战将之中，破魔者能主动抑制或消除魔法。就连邪能魔法也不例外！$b$b如果我们想要找到古尔丹，就需要弄清这是怎么实现的。从他的破魔者队长身上找到一本破魔者法典，还有巫师之王本人的印章——我必须搞清楚他所知道的一切。$b$b是的，$n，这意味着我要你去攻破悬槌堡，击败里面的所有敌人。出发吧！
text.progress: What have you found in Highmaul?
text.completion: The felbreaker's tome is blank? Let me see that. Did you get the Sorcerer King's sigil? Of course - see here, as you run the sigil over the page, runic lettering appears. Oh... this is really advanced.$B$BIt may take some time to fully comprehend what you've discovered, $n, but these initial pages appear to be dedicated to the nature of fel. Exactly what I need! Great work!
text.completed: Return to Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

english.title: Empire's Fall
english.objectives: Collect a Felbreaker's Tome and the Sigil of the Sorcerer King from Highmaul.
english.description: The Ogre Sorcerer King, Imperator Mar'gok, has mastered magical techniques we would consider on the fringe of arcane science. His felbreakers, among others, can actively dampen or nullify magic. Even fel magic!$b$bIf we're to locate Gul'dan, we need to figure out how it's done. Acquire a felbreaker's tome from his felbreaker captain and acquire the sigil of the sorcerer king himself - I must know what he knows.$b$bYes, $n, this means I expect you to storm Highmaul and defeat everyone inside. Get to it!
english.progress: What have you found in Highmaul?
english.completion: Фолиант скверноломов пуст? Дай-ка я посмотрю. А печать короля-чародея у тебя? Ну конечно: смотри, проводишь печатью по странице, и появляется рунный текст. Ого... Это книга не для новичков.$b$bМне нужно время, чтобы полностью расшифровать твою находку, $n, но, похоже, первые страницы посвящены природе Скверны. То, что мне нужно! Отличная работа!
english.completed: Return to Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

text.title: 巫王的遗产
text.objectives: 从悬槌堡的怪物身上收集$1oa块消魔之石。你要塞的追随者们或许也能在某些特定的任务中找到石头。
text.description: 在过往一千多年的岁月里，食人魔巫师之王凭借各类神器维护着统御帝国的铁腕政权。受信任的副官们手中握有魔法宝石，可以在战场上行使帝王的意志。这些“消魔之石”直到今天仍然力量不减，就散落在悬槌堡的各处。有时是数块成群。$b$b帮我找$1oa块消魔之石来！
text.progress: Do you have the stones? I never thought I'd turn to ogres for magical might, but those ancient Sorcerer Kings knew a thing or two about raw arcane energy that would keep Kirin-Tor scholars busy for ages.
text.completion: <Khadgar holds some of the stones up to the light, allowing narrow filaments of arcane energy to spiral from stone to stone.>$B$BI don't think I'll ever underestimate ogres again, $n. One or two intelligent ones can mold the others into a formidable army.
text.completed: Bring the Abrogator Stones to Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

english.title: Legacy of the Sorcerer Kings
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Abrogator Stones from creatures in Highmaul. Your garrison followers may also be able to locate stones in certain missions.
english.description: For over a thousand years, the ogre sorcerer kings maintained an iron grip over their empire using a variety of artifacts. Trusted lieutenants were given magical gems that allowed them to enforce the emperor's will out in the field. These "Abrogator Stones" still maintain their power even today, and can be found scattered throughout the Highmaul complex. Sometimes in clusters.$b$bCollect $1oa of these Abrogator Stones for me!
english.progress: Do you have the stones? I never thought I'd turn to ogres for magical might, but those ancient Sorcerer Kings knew a thing or two about raw arcane energy that would keep Kirin-Tor scholars busy for ages.
english.completion: <Cadgar lifts several stones to light, so thin threads of secret energy begin to wriggle from stone to stone. >$b$bI don't think it would ever occur to me to underestimate ogres again, $n. Take a couple who can think for themselves, and they blind a formidable army of others.
english.completed: Bring the Abrogator Stones to Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

text.title: Fugitive Dragon
text.objectives: Meet with Khadgar north of the Ring of Trials in Nagrand.
text.description: Ready to do some dragon hunting? A bronze dragon freed Garrosh Hellscream and took him to this world. His name is  Kairozdormu, and he's a fugitive from Azeroth. It's time to track him down.$b$bHis essence permeates this entire timeline. If I could just get a hold of him - dead or alive! - I could re-calibrate my magic to this era of Draenor.$b$bWe'll need the help of a fellow bronze dragon. I'll find her and meet you in Nagrand. Let's rendezvous at the crossroads north of the Ring of Trials.
text.completion: $n, Chromie here has offered to help track down our bronze fugitive.$B$BShe may look diminutive, but I assure you she is as old as a hundred of your lifetimes.
text.completed: Meet with Khadgar north of the Ring of Trials in Nagrand.

english.title: Fugitive Dragon
english.objectives: Meet with Khadgar north of the Ring of Trials in Nagrand.
english.description: Ready to do some dragon hunting? A bronze dragon freed Garrosh Hellscream and took him to this world. His name is  Kairozdormu, and he's a fugitive from Azeroth. It's time to track him down.$b$bHis essence permeates this entire timeline. If I could just get a hold of him - dead or alive! - I could re-calibrate my magic to this era of Draenor.$b$bWe'll need the help of a fellow bronze dragon. I'll find her and meet you in Nagrand. Let's rendezvous at the crossroads north of the Ring of Trials.
english.completion: $n, Chromie agreed to help track down our bronze fugitive. $b$bShe may look miniature, but believe me, she's a hundred times older than you.
english.completed: Meet with Khadgar north of the Ring of Trials in Nagrand.

text.title: Power Unleashed
text.objectives: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra, and allow him to upgrade your ring.
text.description: You've more than earned a reward, commander. I'll wrap things up here and meet you back at my tower - you can use my portal as a shortcut.$b$bSpeak to me when you arrive and I will use Kairoz's power with the crystals you gathered earlier to upgrade your ring!
text.completion: How are you feeling? Can I get you a drink?$B$BI wish I could say that things will get easier from here, but we're just getting started. I must ask you to storm the very heart of the ogre empire... Are you ready?
text.completed: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

english.objectives: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra, and allow him to upgrade your ring.

english.completion: Как самочувствие? Хочешь что-нибудь выпить?$b$bХотелось бы сказать, что теперь дела пойдут легче, но все только начинается. Мне придется попросить тебя отправиться в самое сердце империи огров... Ты $gготов:готова;?
english.completed: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

text.title: The Scrying Game
text.objectives: Speak with Khadgar and locate Gul'dan with his scrying spell.
text.description: We've learned everything we need from the ogres, $n. Thanks to your efforts, I believe I can pierce the veil of secrecy that's cloaking Gul'dan.$b$bI WILL find him, $c.$b$bOnce my spell is finished we should be ready to leap into action. I won't begin until you let me know you're ready.
text.completion: Stabbed! He's been stabbed!$B$BWhy wasn't he more careful? We could've set up wards, we could've -$B$BIt doesn't matter now. We have to act fast.
text.completed: Speak to Cordana at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

english.title: The Scrying Game
english.objectives: Speak with Khadgar and locate Gul'dan with his scrying spell.

I won't begin until you let me know you're ready.
english.completion: Колотая рана! Его ранили кинжалом!$b$bЧто за преступная беспечность... Надо было выставить часовых, надо было...$b$bВпрочем, что теперь говорить. Надо действовать, и быстро.
english.completed: Speak to Cordana at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

text.title: Hunter: Hunted
text.objectives: Follow Garona's trail into the Zangarra lowlands. Find, defeat, and capture her.
text.description: The weapon that stabbed the archmage was imbued with fel magic. He's slowly being poisoned!$b$b$n, we don't have any time. Khadgar will be dead in minutes. I need you to track down Garona before she gets away - find that murder weapon and maybe we can find a cure!$b$bFollow the traces of fel energy she left behind. Track her down into the Zangarra lowlands and capture her with this Violet Hold Incarceration rune.$b$bHurry!
text.completion: The Kirin-Tor responded quickly. Jaina was here in minutes. But if you hadn't located Garona, the Archmage would've died for certain. Thank you, $n!
text.completed: Hurry back to Cordana at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

english.objectives: Follow Garona's trail into the Zangarra lowlands. Find, defeat, and capture her.
english.description: The weapon that stabbed the archmage was imbued with fel magic. He's slowly being poisoned!$b$b$n, we don't have any time. Khadgar will be dead in minutes. Track her down into the Zangarra lowlands and capture her with this Violet Hold Incarceration rune.$b$bHurry!
english.completion: Кирин-Тор выслал помощь незамедлительно. Джайна явилась вовремя. Но если бы ты не $gнашел:нашла; Гарону, верховный маг бы точно скончался. Спасибо тебе, $n!
english.completed: Hurry back to Cordana at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

text.title: Touch of the Kirin-Tor
text.objectives: Speak with Archmage Khadgar to upgrade your ring.
text.description: <Khadgar's breathing is labored and his face is drained of color, but his eyes still flash with energy.>$b$bYou saved me, $n. Once again I underestimated Gul'dan, and it nearly cost me everything.$b$bCome, help me up. While Jaina is here, the two of us can work together to upgrade your ring. You've earned it! Let me know when you're ready.
text.completion: How are you feeling?$B$BThat ring of yours is now one of the most powerful artifacts on this world. Which is good. Because we're about to strike right at the heart of the enemy...
text.completed: Speak to Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

english.objectives: Speak with Archmage Khadgar to upgrade your ring.

Let me know when you're ready.
english.completion: Как ощущения?$b$bТвое кольцо – теперь один из самых мощных артефактов в этом мире. И это хорошо. Потому что мы собираемся нанести удар прямо в сердце врага...
english.completed: Speak to Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

text.title: Heart of the Fury
text.objectives: Collect a Heart of the Fury from the elemental Fury encased within the furnace of the Blackrock Foundry.
text.description: It is foolish to pursue Gul'dan with magical means alone. But thanks to you we have a prisoner: Garona. If we can break Gul'dan's mind-control over her, we will learn all his secrets.$b$bI can do it, but I'll need some powerful spell components.$b$bFirst on the list is the heart of an elemental fury. There's one imprisoned in the center of the Blackrock Foundry. Fight your way in, destroy the furnace, and slay the elemental within.
text.progress: Elemental "furies" appear to be unique to Draenor. It may be something about the primal nature of this world.
text.completion: Careful, careful! Set it down gently. I'll take it from here.$B$BThe heart of a fury is nothing to toy with.
text.completed: Bring the Heart to Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

english.objectives: Collect a Heart of the Fury from the elemental Fury encased within the furnace of the Blackrock Foundry.

There's one imprisoned in the center of the Blackrock Foundry. Fight your way in, destroy the furnace, and slay the elemental within.
english.progress: Elemental "furies" appear to be unique to Draenor. It may be something about the primal nature of this world.
english.completion: Watch out! Put it down carefully. I'll take it from here.$b$bThe Heart of Rage is not a toy.
english.completed: Bring the Heart to Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

text.title: Flamebender's Tome
text.objectives: Retrieve the Flamebender's Tome from Flamebender Ka'graz in the Blackrock Foundry.
text.description: The Iron Horde, and the Burning Blade clan in particular, have forged a unique relationship with Draenor's ancient elementals. They can work with iron and flame in ways that even I don't fully understand.$b$bYet.$b$b$n, slay the Burning Blade's highest-ranking artisan: Flamebender Ka'graz. She is down in the very heart of the Black Forge of the Blackrock Foundry, an area known as the Burning Font. If we're lucky, her secrets are codified in a Flamebender's Tome.
text.progress: Do you have the Flamebender's Tome? Many legendary Burning Blade weapons owe their existence to this volume!
text.completion: Let me see what we have here... very interesting! This runic language here seems similar to the ignan kalimag dialect spoken by Azeroth's fire elementals. A full translation may take years.$B$BBut these parts written in orcish - yes, these I can probably decipher. Not just to bend steel, but to bend elemental power itself to our will.$B$BGul'dan may be powerful, but if we continue to unlock the mysteries of Draenor, we will be able to counter his every move...
text.completed: Bring the tome to Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

english.title: Flamebender's Tome
english.objectives: Retrieve the Flamebender's Tome from Flamebender Ka'graz in the Blackrock Foundry.
english.description: The Iron Horde, and the Burning Blade clan in particular, have forged a unique relationship with Draenor's ancient elementals. They can work with iron and flame in ways that even I don't fully understand.$b$bYet.$b$b$n, slay the Burning Blade's highest-ranking artisan: Flamebender Ka'graz. She is down in the very heart of the Black Forge of the Blackrock Foundry, an area known as the Burning Font. If we're lucky, her secrets are codified in a Flamebender's Tome.
english.progress: Do you have the Flamebender's Tome? Many legendary Burning Blade weapons owe their existence to this volume!
english.completion: Посмотрим, что у нас тут... как интересно! Этот рунический язык чем-то похож на диалект игнан калимаг, на котором разговаривают огненные элементали Азерота. Полный перевод может занять целые годы.$b$bНо части на орочьем – да, эти я могу расшифровать. Чтобы научиться не только обрабатывать сталь, но и подчинять саму силу элементаля.$b$bГул'дан силен, но если мы продолжим раскрывать тайны Дренора, то сумеем ответить на любой его удар...
english.completed: Bring the tome to Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

text.title: Reverse Piracy
text.objectives: Acquire the Draenic Thaumaturgical Orb from the Dread Grotto in the Blackrock Foundry.
text.description: $n, during the attack on Karabor Iron Horde dreadnaughts looted or sank most of the draenei eastern fleet. A priceless artifact was captured: A genuine Draenic Thaumaturgical Orb.$b$bI must have it! Those orcs don't know what they've got!$b$bMy sources indicate that the orb was aboard a ship that's being retrofitted down in the Dread Grotto beneath the Blackrock Foundry. Search the ship and the area nearby for the Sha'tari Vault that contained the orb. We've got to get it back!
text.progress: The orb! Tell me you've found the orb...?
text.completion: You found it! I have heard stories of these orbs of power. How I craved to study them during my long exile in Outland. And now, at last, I have one. Show me...$B$B<Reverently, Khadgar opens your pack and looks inside. His face remains motionless for a long time. Finally, he speaks:>$B$B...I don't know what I expected.
text.completed: Bring the orb to Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

english.objectives: Acquire the Draenic Thaumaturgical Orb from the Dread Grotto in the Blackrock Foundry.

Search the ship and the area nearby for the Sha'tari Vault that contained the orb. We've got to get it back!
english.progress: The orb! Tell me you've found the orb...?
english.completion: Ты $gнашел:нашла; ее! Мне доводилось слышать рассказы об этих могущественных сферах. Как же мне хотелось изучить их во время долгого изгнания в Запределье. И вот, теперь сфера у меня в руках. Покажи-ка…$b$b<Кадгар с благоговением открывает ваш рюкзак и заглядывает внутрь. Его лицо долгое время остается неподвижным. Наконец он произносит:>$b$b...Не знаю, чего я ожидал.
english.completed: Bring the orb to Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

text.title: 元素领主的力量
text.objectives: 收集$oa块元素石板。从黑石锻造厂的首领身上收集元素符文，把石板拼合起来。
text.description: 黑石氏族不知怎的居然跟那些烈火与石头生物结成了联盟。我必须弄清楚原委！$b$b彻底搜查黑石锻造厂的每个角落。我们要找的是可追溯到德拉诺史前时代的石板。那些石板很可能已经变成了破碎的残片，你得亲自动手把它们拼合起来。仔细找找钢铁部落高阶成员带在身上的元素符文。$b$b收集这些符文，然后把石板拼合起来交给我，$n。我会用他们的力量来强化你的指环！
text.progress: I've been able to spend some time studying the prehistory of Draenor. Primal elemental forces competed with each other to shape the world in what is known as the Age of Colossals. Their descendants still fight to this day, especially in regions such as Gorgrond.$B$BThose tablets you're assembling will reveal the forces at work during the era... and more importantly, they will allow us to control and channel those forces, just as the Blackrock do today!
text.completion: You've got the tablets. Good, good! It must've been very time-consuming to assemble these - not to mention dangerous. I am lucky to have you.$B$BI see no reason to delay. Show me your ring. Yes... I can do this. Let's put these tablets to use and enhance your power.
text.completed: Bring the tablets to Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

english.title: Might of the Elemental Lords
english.objectives: Collect $oa Elemental Tablets. Assemble the tablets by collecting Elemental Runes from bosses in the Blackrock Foundry.
english.description: Somehow, the Blackrock Clan has forged an alliance with the creatures of fire and stone. I must know how!$b$bSearch the entirety of the Blackrock Foundry. We are looking for stone tablets dating back to the prehistory of Draenor. They will likely be broken apart into fragments that you'll need to assemble by hand. Look for elemental runes carried by high-ranking members of the Iron Horde.$b$bAssemble them and bring me those tablets, $n. I will use their power to augment the powers of your ring!
english.progress: I've been able to spend some time studying the prehistory of Draenor. Primal elemental forces competed with each other to shape the world in what is known as the Age of Colossals. Their descendants still fight to this day, especially in regions such as Gorgrond.$B$BThose tablets you're assembling will reveal the forces at work during the era... and more importantly, they will allow us to control and channel those forces, just as the Blackrock do today!
english.completion: Скрижали у тебя в руках. Отлично! Должно быть, на их сборку ушла уйма времени и сил. Повезло мне с тобой.$b$bНе будем откладывать. Покажи мне свое кольцо. Ага… Я справлюсь. Используем скрижали и сделаем тебя сильнее.
english.completed: Bring the tablets to Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

text.title: 黑手的秘密
text.objectives: 在黑石铸造厂里消灭督军黑手，并取得他的断臂。
text.description: $n，你让我思考了许多。在缚火者宝典里有一段讲到了“献祭”，而一处更新的注释则提及了“酋长”。我想它说的应该是督军黑手。$b$b黑手献祭了什么人吗？难道是他自己？他自己身体的某一部分？他那只畸形的手就是这么来的吗？$b$b在我冒险引导这些元素施展法术之前，我得查出答案。而办法则只有一个。$b$b消灭督军黑手。然后把他的断臂给我带来。
text.progress: Well $n? Are you armed?
text.completion: What do we have here? The legends ARE true. Blackhand sacrificed his own arm to the elements. Now that he's dead, it's indistinguishable from stone. Or is it?$B$B<Khadgar utters a few incantations from the Flamebinder's Tome. The severed hand slowly clenches into a fist.>$B$BHmmmm. Yes. $n, I'll be perfectly honest with you: This thing is extremely creepy.
text.completed: Bring the arm to Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

english.title: Blackhand's Secret
english.objectives: Slay Warlord Blackhand and acquire his severed arm in the Blackrock Foundry.
english.description: $n, you've given me a lot to think about. There's a section of the Flamebender's Tome that speaks about a "sacrifice," and a more recent notation referring to "the chieftain." I think it's talking about Warlord Blackhand.$b$bDid Blackhand sacrifice someone? Himself? A piece of himself? Is that why his hand is deformed?$b$bBefore I risk channeling these elements into a spell, I need to know. And there's only one way to find out.$b$bKill Warlord Blackhand. And bring me his severed arm.
english.progress: Well $n? Are you armed?
english.completion: Что у нас тут? Надо же, легенды все-таки не врут. Чернорук принес свою руку в жертву стихиям. И теперь, после его смерти, ее не отличить от камня. Хотя…$b$b<Кадгар произносит несколько заклинаний из Фолианта укрощения огня. Отрубленная рука медленно сжимает пальцы в кулак.>$b$bХ-м-м-м. Ага. Скажу тебе честно, $n. Это было чертовски жутко.
english.completed: Bring the arm to Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

text.title: The Unbroken Circle
text.objectives: Speak with Archmage Khadgar to upgrade your ring.
text.description: Reading these tablets is like stepping back in time to the moment of Draenor's creation. There is a power here greater than any I have dealt with since I was Medivh's apprentice. I believe I can control it, but - can you handle it?$b$bIf you think you are ready, prepare yourself. Hold your ring close to your heart. I will channel pure elemental energies into it.$b$bSpeak with me to begin!
text.completion: <Khadgar is deeply distressed.>$B$BI am very sorry, commander. For a moment I thought we had lost you forever.$B$BThis ring will serve you well - I have never seen an artifact so powerful and pure of form. It may be possible to enhance it further but... I do not know at what cost.$B$BUse your ring wisely!
text.completed: Speak to Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

english.completed: Speak to Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

text.title: Prisoner of the Mind
text.objectives: Speak with Khadgar and protect him while he casts his spell on Garona.
text.description: I'd had some time to compare the Flamebinder's tome with the elemental tablets you collected. Where it gets interesting is when I cross-reference the incantations you obtained from the ogre felbreakers... I can see I'm losing you. I will get to the point: I believe I can cast a spell that will nullify Gul'dan's mind control over his assassin Garona.$b$bMind-controlled or not, she may be dangerous, so I won't begin the spell until you're with me. Let me know when you're ready!
text.completion: Gul'dan's magic is embedded deep within Garona's mind. The more time I spend with her, the more it becomes clear that we MUST free her from his control.$B$BI am not giving up on this, $n.
text.completed: Return to Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

english.completion: Магия Гул'дана глубоко проникла в разум Гароны. Чем больше времени я провожу с ней, тем более мне очевидно, что мы ДОЛЖНЫ освободить ее от этой власти.$B$BЯ ни за что не отступлюсь, $n.
english.completed: Return to Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

text.title: We're Not Finished...
text.objectives: Report to Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.
text.description: $n, I'm going to have to hit the books and do more research to figure out how to locate Gul'dan or untangle his mind control of Garona. It's not glamorous, but the life of a mage is often spent in long hours of grueling study.$b$bAs for you, there's much to do. Ensure that your garrison is fully upgraded, locate the best possible equipment, and continue fighting the Iron Horde.$b$bI will summon you when the next step of our journey is ready.
text.completion: My studies have gone well. I believe we are ready for the next step. You may not like it...
text.completed: Return to Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

text.title: 外部激励
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个碎手盲眼行者、$2oa个碎手收割者和$3oa个碎手吟血者。
text.description: 碎手兽人对疼痛并不陌生。他们每个人都砍下了自己一只手以示效忠卡加斯。假如你想让他们坦白交代，那么有我的毒药还不够。$B$B去把他们全都干掉，让我们看看，为了他们亲爱的领袖，他们会愿意付出多少。
text.completion: Excellent work.
text.completed: Return to Dark Ranger Velonara in Shadow's Vigil.

english.title: Extrinsic Motivation
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Shattered Sightless, $2oa Shattered Harvesters, and $3oa Shattered Blood-Singer.
english.description: The Shattered Hand aren't strangers to pain. They each cut off their own hand as a sign of their allegiance to Kargath.$B$BIf you're going to get them to talk, it might take more than my poison.$B$BSlaughter them all. We'll see how far they're willing to go for their beloved warlord.
english.completion: That's great.
english.completed: Return to Dark Ranger Velonara in Shadow's Vigil.

text.objectives: 在碎手高地击败加杜尔·毒刃。
text.description: 我们必须趁敌明我暗之际除掉这个加杜尔，并夺取他的毒药配方。我们需要用它制出解毒剂。这可能是我们唯一的机会。$B$B假如你的情报正确，他的营地就在南边。你负责干掉他，而我则负责让他的卫兵没法打扰你。$B$B我们出发吧。
text.completion: We won't let him get away.
text.completed: Speak to Dark Ranger Velonara at Shattered Rise.

english.objectives: Defeat Gardul Venomshiv in Shattered Rise.
english.description: We need to take out Gardul and take his poison recipe while we still have the element of surprise on our side. We need it to craft the antidote. This may be our only opportunity.$B$BIf what you learned is true, his camp is just south of here. You take him down, and I'll make sure none of his guards interfere.$B$BLet's get moving.
english.completion: Мы не дадим ему уйти.
english.completed: Speak to Dark Ranger Velonara at Shattered Rise.

text.title: 我们逮住他了
text.objectives: 收集毒刃的秘密配方和$2oa个毒药桶。
text.description: 我们已经把加杜尔困在这里了，指挥官。$B$B你有着更为精良的装备，更适合去消灭他。去将他打倒，然后从他的尸体上夺取配方，顺便捎上尽量多的毒药桶。$B$B我会守住这个斜坡，确保不让任何援军接近加杜尔。
text.progress: Do you have everything we need?
text.completion: Excellent. I have a ride back to your outpost ready.
text.completed: Return to Dark Ranger Velonara in Shattered Rise.

english.title: We Have Him Now
english.objectives: Collect Venomshiv's Secret Formula and $2oa Poison Barrels.
english.description: We have Gardul right where we want him, commander.$B$BYou're far more equipped to face him than I am. Dispose of him, take his formula from his corpse, and grab as many barrels of poison as you can.$B$BI'll guard this ramp and make sure no reinforcements come to his aid.
english.progress: $gCollected:Collected; everything you need?
english.completion: Отлично. Можем возвращаться на заставу.
english.completed: Return to Dark Ranger Velonara in Shattered Rise.

text.objectives: 收集毒刃的秘密配方和$2oa个毒药桶。

text.progress: I don't want to stick around here any longer than we need to.
text.completion: Perfect work. I called in a ride for ye back to the outpost when yer ready.

text.description: Alright, I'm outta here. What? Oh now you want me to help you? Sheesh, alright fine.$b$bA goblin named Ganky came through here just a bit ago. She tried to help me down but she was too short, and in a massive hurry. She said something about stopping Azuki? Azukah? I'm pretty sure it was a name that started with "az".$b$bAnyway, Ganky ran toward the top of the Broken Precipice. Bad timing if you ask me. The ogres and ogron are in some kind of civil war. I'd be careful if I were you.

text.title: 基姆兹·宾奇维斯
text.completion: Ya know, I've been thinking.$b$bWith uncle Krixel back that now frees me up to take some time off from running the Gearworks for a bit.$b$bIf you have the room in your garrison I'd be glad to come join you, I could even teach you some tricks I've learned to keep your accounts in order and the books cooked!

text.title: 力量的证明：独眼魔角
text.objectives: 把证明带到戈尔隆德的高山走廊，交给游侠乔纳。
text.description: 这只角证明了你有消灭独眼魔的能力，你的角斗士朋友目击了你的战斗！把这只角带回去给乔纳，换取你应得的嘉奖！
text.completion: It is hard to admit that there is a creature more brutal than an ogre, but the ogron definitely fit that description. Facing a captured ogron in the arena is no mean feat. Facing one in their own lair is something even more dangerous. Hail to thee champion!

english.title: Proof of Strength: Ogron Horn
english.objectives: Take the proof to Rangari Jonaa at Highpass in Gorgrond.
english.description: This horn is proof of your strength at slaying ogron and your gladiator friend has born witness!$b$bTake the horn back to Jonaa and claim your accolades!
english.completion: Сложно поверить, что есть существо более жестокое, чем огр, но огрон определенно подходит под это определение. Сражение с пойманным огроном на арене – уже непростая задача, но сражение с диким огроном в его собственном логове гораздо опаснее. Слава тебе, герой!

text.title: 力量的证明：独眼魔角
text.objectives: 把证明带到戈尔隆德的蛮兽岗哨，交给断肢。
text.description: 这支角证明了你有消灭独眼魔的能力，你的角斗士朋友可以作证！把这支角带回去给断肢，换取你应得的嘉奖！
text.completion: We are impressed with your ability to slay the goren. They are relentless and voracious and can overwhelm those are not prepared.

english.title: Proof of Strength: Ogron Horn
english.objectives: Take the proof to Limbflayer at Beastwatch in Gorgrond.
english.description: This horn is proof of your strength at slaying ogron and your gladiator friend has born witness!$b$bTake the horn back to Limbflayer and claim your accolades!
english.completion: Мы приятно удивлены твоей ловкости в охоте на горенов. Они безжалостны и свирепы и с легкостью могут разделаться с тем, кто не готов к встрече с ними.

text.title: 力量的证明：小戈隆鳞片
text.objectives: 把证明带到戈尔隆德的高山走廊，交给游侠乔纳。
text.description: 这块鳞片证明了你有消灭独眼魔的能力，你的角斗士朋友目击了你的战斗！把这块鳞片带回去给乔纳，换取你应得的嘉奖！
text.completion: A gladiator saw you tear this off the back of a gronnling, which I am sure did not part with it easily. It is more like a stone than a true scale though as these brutes are part stone it seems. Not an easy trophy to collect!

english.title: Proof of Strength: Gronnling Scale
english.objectives: Take the proof to Rangari Jonaa at Highpass in Gorgrond.
english.description: This scale is proof of your strength at slaying ogron and your gladiator friend has born witness!$b$bTake the scale back to Jonaa and claim your accolades!
english.completion: The gladiator has seen you rip the scales off the back of a small throne, and it is unlikely that he parted with her willingly. It is more of a stone than scales, and the monsters themselves are half stone. It's not easy to get a trophy like that!

text.title: A Hero's Welcome
text.objectives: Speak with Farseer Drek'Thar at Glacier Bay in Frostfire Ridge.
text.description: You have arrived in Frostfire Ridge. Farseer Drek'Thar can guide you from here.

text.completion: The botani are nothing to be trifled with. They are incredibly cunning and their powers are strong on their home land. Taking one of their blooms is an true example of your fighting skill!

english.completion: С ботани шутки плохи. Они невероятно хитрые, да еще и сильные, особенно на своей земле. Этот цветок – настоящее доказательство твоего воинского искусства!

text.title: 展翼高飞
text.objectives: 消灭$2oa名信徒和风卫士科雷克斯。与卡鲁交谈飞往啸风平台。
text.description: 现在轮到我们对信徒主动出击了。拉斯托克坚信他的新发明能让我们获得埃匹希斯武器的控制权，可我们必须靠近才行——而且要非常近。$B$B卡鲁和她的渡鸦们会送我们飞往啸风平台。在向晨曦平台推进前，我们先在那稳住脚跟吧。
text.completion: Good work!$B$BNow, it is time for the next phase of our plan.
text.completed: Speak to Reshad upon the Windswept Terrace.

english.title: On Ebon Wings
english.objectives: Slay $2oa Adherents and Windkeeper Koreyx. Speak with Ka'alu for a ride to Windswept Terrace.
english.description: Now we bring our fight to the Adherents. Raastok is certain his new invention will give us control of the Apexis weapons, but we must get close - very close.$B$BKa'alu and her ravens will fly us to the Windswept Terrace. We shall gain a foothold there before pressing on to the Terrace of Dawn.
english.completion: Отлично!$B$BНастало время для следующей фазы нашего плана.
english.completed: Speak to Reshad upon the Windswept Terrace.

text.completion: The infested appear to be mere husks animated by plant life. They are slow but very strong. Slaying even one is a strong demonstration of your own skill!

text.title: 阿祖卡·刃怒
text.objectives: 回你位于影月谷的要塞找伯德里克·格雷。
text.description: 密探弹滑死了。一团烈火烧穿了他的心脏，留下了巨大的创口。$b$b你在他的尸体上找到了一份报告，翻看报告，你拼凑出了一些基本情报。阿祖卡背叛了食人魔，她除掉了乌布莱特，并将他的力量占为己有。$b$b你应该立即将这份情报转达给伯德里克。
text.completion: I'm sorry to hear Springslip didn't make it. He was a good agent.$B$BThis news of Azuka gaining even more power is troubling to say the least.
text.completed: 回你位于影月谷的要塞找伯德里克·格雷。

english.title: Azuka Bladefury
english.objectives: Return to Bodrick Grey at your garrison in Shadowmoon Valley.
english.description: Agent Springslip is dead. A fire smolders inside a large wound where his heart used to be.$b$bFlipping through a report you find on his corpse you are able to piece together some basic information. Azuka has betrayed the ogres, she has killed Ugbright and taken his power for herself.$b$bYou should report this information to Bodrick at once.
english.completion: I'm sorry to hear Springslip didn't make it. He was a good agent.$B$BThis news of Azuka gaining even more power is troubling to say the least.
english.completed: Return to Bodrick Grey at your garrison in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.objectives: Take the proof to Rangari Jonaa at Highpass in Gorgrond.
english.description: This crystal is proof of your strength at slaying elementals and your gladiator friend has born witness!$b$bTake the crystal back to Jonaa and claim your accolades!
english.completion: I have seen no elementals elsewhere in Draenor that compare in ferocity to those in Gorgrond. I wonder what caused them to be so angry. That crystal was hard-won I am sure!

text.title: 力量的证明：元素水晶
text.objectives: 把证明带到戈尔隆德的蛮兽岗哨，交给断肢。
text.description: 这块水晶证明你拥有着消灭元素的力量，而你的斗士朋友亲眼见证了这一切！$b$b把水晶交给断肢领取嘉奖吧！
text.completion: I have seen no elementals elsewhere in Draenor that compare in ferocity to those in Gorgrond. I wonder what caused them to be so angry. That crystal was hard-won I am sure!

english.title: Proof of Strength: Elemental Crystal
english.objectives: Take the proof to Limbflayer at Beastwatch in Gorgrond.
english.description: This crystal is proof of your strength at slaying elementals and your gladiator friend has born witness!$b$bTake the crystal back to Limbflayer and claim your accolades!
english.completion: I have seen no elementals elsewhere in Draenor that compare in ferocity to those in Gorgrond. I wonder what caused them to be so angry. That crystal was hard-won I am sure!

text.title: [Deprecated] Azuka Bladefury
text.objectives: Return to Rokhan at your garrison in Frostfire Ridge.
text.description: Jub'waz is dead. A fire smolders inside a large wound where her heart used to be.$b$bFlipping through a report you find on her corpse you are able to piece together some basic information.$b$bAzuka has betrayed the ogres, she has killed Ugbright and used her blade to take his power for herself.$b$bRokhan will want to know of Jub'waz's fate.

english.title: [Deprecated] Azuka Bladefury
english.objectives: Return to Rokhan at your garrison in Frostfire Ridge.
english.description: Jub'waz is dead. A fire smolders inside a large wound where her heart used to be.$b$bFlipping through a report you find on her corpse you are able to piece together some basic information.$b$bAzuka has betrayed the ogres, she has killed Ugbright and used her blade to take his power for herself.$b$bRokhan will want to know of Jub'waz's fate.

text.title: 要塞战役：破碎悬崖
text.objectives: 找到格莱布林·迅爆。
text.description: 嘿，你好啊！你是这要塞的指挥官对吧？我是代表热砂保护协会来的。$b$b我们想在纳格兰开展一项极其重要的挖掘项目。可惜当地的食人魔给我们添了不少麻烦。$b$b就在不久前，我们团队中一位最优秀的保护者在当地勘探时失踪了。他已经是我们协会这星期失去的第三位成员了！$b$b我们的设备还真执行不了救援任务……那你怎么想？我们非常需要你的帮助。
text.completion: You're looking for what now? I mean, yeah sure... whatever. Just get me down alright?
text.completed: 在纳格兰的破碎悬崖与格莱布林·迅爆谈一谈。

english.title: Garrison Campaign: The Broken Precipice
english.objectives: Find Greblin Fastfizzle.
english.description: Hey there! You're the commander of this keep, right? I represent the Steamwheedle Preservation Society.$b$bWe've been trying to get a very important excavation up and running in Nagrand. Unfortunately, we've had trouble with ogres in the area.$b$bIn fact, one of our best preservationists recently went missing while surveying the area. He's the third society member we've lost up there this week!$b$bWe aren't really equipped for a rescue mission... so whad'ya say? We could really use the help.
english.completion: Ты чего там рыщешь, а? Хотя, собственно, какая разница... Просто помоги мне спуститься, ладно?
english.completed: Speak with Greblin Fastfizzle at the Broken Precipice in Nagrand.

text.title: 欢迎来到阿什兰
text.objectives: 与暴风之盾的指挥官安妮·顿沃斯对话。
text.description: 你好啊，欢迎来到阿什兰。$B$B去找暴风之盾的指挥官安妮·顿沃斯报到，听她安排任务。
text.completion: You've just now showed up? Well, better late than never.

english.title: Welcome to Ashran
english.objectives: Speak to Commander Anne Dunworthy in Stormshield.
english.description: Greetings, and welcome to Ashran. $B$BReport to Commander Anne Dunworthy in Stormshield for your briefing.
english.completion: You've just now showed up? Well, better late than never.

text.title: 进入荒原
text.objectives: 暴风之盾堡垒里的克里斯·克拉奇要你在主干道以外的地区击败一名部落成员，并拿回敌人身上的一块护甲碎片。
text.description: 荣耀之路可不只是这片大陆上唯一的纷争之地这么简单，$n。我们必须深入这里的荒原寻找神器。$B$B前往外围区域，消灭一名你发现的部落成员，然后把敌人身上的一块护甲碎片交给我，证明你的价值。
text.progress: That was fast, did you bring me a piece of their armor as proof?
text.completion: Fantastic. You can always bring me back tokens you find on Horde corpses for a bonus reward.
text.completed: Return to Chris Clarkie in Stormshield Stronghold.

english.title: Into The Wilderness
english.objectives: Chris Clarkie in Stormshield Stronghold wants you to kill a member of the Horde outside of the main road and recover a piece of their armor.
english.description: The Road of Glory is not just the only field of strife in this land, $n. We must go into the wilderness here to uncover the artifacts.$B$BVenture forth and kill a member of the Horde you find in the outskirt areas and bring me back a piece of their armor to prove your worth.
english.progress: That was fast, did you bring me a piece of their armor as proof?
english.completion: Fantastic. You can always bring me back tokens you find on Horde corpses for a bonus reward.
english.completed: Return to Chris Clarkie in Stormshield Stronghold.

text.title: 荣耀之路
text.objectives: 暴风之盾的克里斯·克拉奇要你在荣耀之路消灭5名部落成员。
text.description: 部落想要把我们赶出阿什兰，$n。决不能让他们得逞。向荣耀之路进军，至少除掉他们5位成员。
text.completion: Nice work, $n. You're a natural.
text.completed: Return to Chris Clarkie in Stormshield.

english.title: The Road of Glory
english.objectives: Chris Clarkie in Stormshield wants you to kill 5 members of the Horde within the Road of Glory.
english.description: The Horde intends to force us out of Ashran, $n. We can't let them succeed. March into the Road of Glory and thin their ranks by at least five.
english.completion: Nice work, $n. You're a natural.
english.completed: Return to Chris Clarkie in Stormshield.

text.title: 勘察阿什兰
text.objectives: 暴风之盾的先知奇兰达要你去勘察阿什兰的荣耀之路、熔岩采石场、蛮兵高地、毁灭斗兽场和灰槌墓地附近的情况。
text.description: 身为先知，我单在暴风之盾就能看到阿什兰的每一个角落。而你则需要出去亲眼看一看，$n。
text.completion: I can see you have the spirit of a true adventurer, $n. Come visit me anytime and you can see Ashran through my eyes, even from Stormshield.
text.completed: Return to Farseer Kylanda in Stormshield.

english.title: Survey Ashran
english.objectives: Farseer Kylanda in Stormshield wants you to explore The Road of Glory, The Molten Quarry, Brute's Rise, The Amphitheater Of Annihilation and The Ashmaul Burial Grounds in Ashran.
english.description: As a Farseer, I can peer into the far corners of Ashran while within Stormshield. But you must go forth and see it for yourself, $n.
english.completion: Yes, you see, $gis a real seeker: a real seeker; adventure, $n! Come to me anytime you want to look at Ashran with my eyes without leaving the Barrier of the Winds.
english.completed: Return to Farseer Kylanda in Stormshield.

text.title: 报到
text.objectives: 与米思林·酒趾、先知奇兰达和克里斯·克拉奇谈一谈。
text.description: 出列，$n！别耽误时间了，去找这些家伙谈谈，他们会向你说明一切的。
text.completion: Yes yes, it's the real Harrison Jones. Why is he such a celebrity all of a sudden?
text.completed: Return to Anne Dunworthy in Stormshield Stronghold.

english.title: Reporting For Duty
english.objectives: Speak to Misirin Stouttoe, Farseer Kylanda and Chris Clarkie.
english.description: Front and center, $n! No time to waste, go speak with these fellows and they'll fill you in.
english.completion: Yes yes, it's the real Harrison Jones. Why is he such a celebrity all of a sudden?
english.completed: Return to Anne Dunworthy in Stormshield Stronghold.

text.title: 证明你的实力
text.objectives: 使用莫古格·重磅提供的鱼饵捕捉5条赞加鳗鱼，向莫古格证明你的实力。
text.description: 你已证明了自己是一位战士，现在让我们来瞧瞧你的钓鱼技术如何。我已经把你带来的那些冰脊钉刺者做成了鱼饵，你试试用它来捕捉近海的赞加鳗鱼。
text.progress: Catch those eels?
text.completion: I see you are both a fisherman and a warrior.  I will do what I can to help you.
text.completed: Return to Mokugg Lagerpounder with the eels.

english.title: Proving Your Worth
english.objectives: Prove your worth to Mokugg Lagerpounder by catching 5 Zangar Eels using the supplied bait.
english.description: Now that you have proven yourself as a warrior, let's see how your fishing skills hold up. I have fashioned a bait out of the icespine stingers you brought me. Use it to catch the Zangar eels in these coastal waters.
english.progress: Catch those eels?
english.completion: I see you are both a fisherman and a warrior.  I will do what I can to help you.
english.completed: Return to Mokugg Lagerpounder with the eels.

text.title: 在自家要塞里垂钓
text.objectives: 带着《霜狼垂钓日志》回去找马克金。
text.description: 你已证明了你的价值，旅行者。带着这本《霜狼垂钓日志》回你的要塞好好学学。很快，你就能靠钓鱼养活自己啦。
text.progress: We can use that as bait?!
text.completion: Look at all the bait ideas in this thing! Great job $n!
text.completed: Return to Mak'jin at your Garrison.

english.title: Anglin' In Our Garrison
english.objectives: Return to Mak'jin with the Frostwolf Fishing Journal.
english.description: You have proven your worth, traveler.  Now take this frostwolf fishing journal back to your garrison and study up.  You will be catching all you can eat in no time.
english.progress: We can use that as bait?!
english.completion: Look at all the bait ideas in this thing! Great job $n!
english.completed: Return to Mak'jin at your Garrison.

text.title: 找到神器碎片
text.objectives: 暴风之盾堡垒的米思林·酒趾要你在阿什兰郊野的大路边消灭怪物，并将5块神器碎片交给艾希兰姆。
text.description: 你似乎可以从阿什兰郊外的任何生物身上找到神器碎片。去那儿消灭那里的生物，并至少带5块碎片回暴风之盾堡垒，把它们交给营火附近的法师艾希兰姆。
text.progress: Are those Artifact Fragments, I see?
text.completion: Good work. If you happen to find anymore Artifact Fragments, bring them to me or the others in need of them to contribute to the war effort.
text.completed: Return to Ecilam in Stormshield Stronghold.

english.title: Uncovering the Artifact Fragments
english.objectives: Misirin Stouttoe in Stormshield Stronghold wants you to go kill creatures in the outskirts of Ashran outside of the main road and bring back 5 Artifact Fragments to Ecilam.
english.description: The Artifact Fragments seem to come from any creature we've found in the outskirts of Ashran. Go out and kill any you find and bring at least five to Ecilam the Mage near the campfire in Stormshield Stronghold.
english.progress: Are those Artifact Fragments, I see?
english.completion: Потрясающе! Если найдешь еще фрагменты артефакта, принеси их мне или тем, кто в них нуждается. Так ты приблизишь час победы.
english.completed: Return to Ecilam in Stormshield Stronghold.

text.title: 要塞战役：觉醒
text.objectives: 到戈尔隆德的高格里克之眠找希萨莉·黑鸦谈一谈。
text.description: 我们一直跟踪刃怒督军和失窃的神器来到了戈尔隆德西部的盐场。$B$B希萨莉·黑鸦和一支侦察先头部队将在那里跟你汇合。$B$B整个要塞现在都处于高度戒备状态。我们必须做好在必要情况下拦截敌人的准备。
text.progress: This isn't looking good.
text.completion: I've never seen a magnaron of that size before. This is bad, $n.
text.completed: Return to Thisalee Crow at Gorgorek's Rest.

english.title: Garrison Campaign: Awakening
english.objectives: Speak to Thisalee Crow at Gorgorek's Rest in Gorgrond.
english.description: We've tracked Warlord Bladefury and the stolen artifact to the salt fields of western Gorgrond.$B$BThisalee Crow will meet you there with an advance scouting team.$B$BThe entire garrison is on high alert. We must be ready to intercept the enemy if necessary.
english.progress: This isn't looking good.
english.completion: I've never seen a magnaron of that size before. This is bad, $n.
english.completed: Return to Thisalee Crow at Gorgorek's Rest.

text.title: Rosa is bad
text.objectives: Retrieve Rulga's lost inscription papers.
text.description: Text
text.completed: Return to Rulga at Palemoon Village.

english.title: Rosa is bad
english.objectives: Retrieve Rulga's lost inscription papers.
english.description: Text
english.completed: Return to Rulga at Palemoon Village.

text.title: 要塞战役：觉醒
text.objectives: 到戈尔隆德的高格里克之眠找楚伦娜谈一谈。
text.description: 我们一直跟踪刃怒督军和失窃的神器来到了戈尔隆德西部的盐场。$B$B楚伦娜和一支侦察部队已经在那里待命。$B$B整个要塞现在都处于高度戒备状态。快去跟她汇合吧，我们必须做好在必要情况下拦截敌人的准备。
text.completion: I've never seen a magnaron of that size before. This is bad, $n.
text.completed: Return to Choluna at Gorgorek's Rest.

english.title: Garrison Campaign: Awakening
english.objectives: Speak to Choluna at Gorgorek's Rest in Gorgrond.
english.description: We've tracked Warlord Bladefury an' da stolen artifact ta northern Gorgrond.$B$BCholuna be dere wit a scouting team.$B$BI got dey entire garrison on high alert. Go, meet wit her, and intercept da enemy if necessary.
english.completion: I've never seen a magnaron of that size before. This is bad, $n.
english.completed: Return to Choluna at Gorgorek's Rest.

text.title: 伐木工入门
text.objectives: 从小型木料上收集木材样本，并交给木材管理员奥克顿。
text.description: $G先生:女士;，如果我们想把这座要塞打造成合格的堡垒，就需要用到一大堆木料。那意味着我们得做些工作才行。$B$B当然，我是肯定不会麻烦你去干脏活累活的，可我需要你去帮我们的伐木场寻找木料。等你标记好一棵树之后，就会有一个身强体壮却又好吃懒做的苦工前去砍伐，把木料交给你。$B$B霜火岭并不是个盛产木材的地方，可我在附近发现了一棵还算不错的小树。
text.progress: This garrison isn't going to build itself, commander! We need timber!
text.completion: You're going to make a fine overseer, sir! Keep those peons in line!$B$BNow you know the basics of logging and finding timber. Time to put them to good use for the good of your garrison.

english.title: Easing into Lumberjacking
english.objectives: Harvest a Timber Sample from Small Timber and return it to Lumber Lord Oktron.
english.description: $G Sir:Ma'am;, we're going to need a lot of lumber if we're going to build this garrison into a suitable fortress. That means we're going to have to do a little work.$B$BWhile I certainly wouldn't ask you to dirty your hands with manual labor, I do need you to go out and find timber for our mill. Once you mark a tree an able-bodied lazy-good-for-nothing peon will come and chop it down and give you the timber.$B$BFrostfire isn't the best place for timber, but I did see a suitable small tree nearby.
english.progress: This garrison isn't going to build itself, commander! We need timber!
english.completion: Из тебя выйдет прекрасный надзиратель, командир! Не давай спуску этим батракам!$b$bТеперь ты $gпостиг:постигла; основы заготовки леса и поиска древесины. Применим же эти знания на благо нашего гарнизона.

text.title: 化木材为利润
text.objectives: 从德拉诺各地收集10份木料，然后在你要塞的伐木场里下达一份产品订单。
text.description: 既然你已经知道如何让苦工们去砍伐木料了，我们接下来要为你的伐木场创建一份产品订单。$B$B但首先，我们得找些可供加工的木料！$B$B德拉诺到处都盛产着可供砍伐的高大树木。去为我们的伐木场找些合适的木料。等找到足够之后再回到这里来，我们将开始完成一份产品订单。$B$B老样子，还是把累活留给苦工们做，只要保护好他们就行。德拉诺可是个危险的地方！
text.completion: That's how it's done, commander!$B$BWe're now fully operational. Any time you have enough timber to place a work order, come on back to me and we'll get started.$B$BThis garrison ain't gonna build itself!
text.completed: Return to Lumber Lord Oktron at the Lumber Mill.

english.title: Turning Timber into Profit
english.objectives: Collect 10 pieces of Timber from around Draenor and then Place a Work Order at your Garrison's Lumber Mill.
english.description: Now that you know how to put peons to work harvesting timber, we're going to create a work order for your mill.$B$BBut first we're going to need some timber to process!$B$BAll around Draenor are juicy trees ripe for the chopping. Go out and find suitable timber for the lumber mill. Come back here when you have enough and we'll get started on a work order.$B$BAnd as usual, let the peons do the hard work. Just keep 'em protected. Draenor's a dangerous place!
english.completion: That's how it's done, commander!$B$BWe're now fully operational. Any time you have enough timber to place a work order, come on back to me and we'll get started.$B$BThis garrison ain't gonna build itself!
english.completed: Return to Lumber Lord Oktron at the Lumber Mill.

text.title: 冰脊钉刺
text.objectives: 收集4枚冰脊钉刺，向莫古格·重磅证明你的实力。
text.description: 我可以帮忙，但你必须先证明你不仅是一名合格的渔夫，更是一名无畏的战士。$B$B北面的峡谷里满是冰脊钉刺者。去消灭它们，把它们的钉刺带回来给我。在这块水域，这种钉刺能充当不错的鱼饵。
text.progress: Have those stingers for me?
text.completion: Not bad traveler, not bad at all.
text.completed: Return to Mokugg Lagerpounder with the Icespine Stingers.

english.title: Icespine Stingers
english.objectives: Prove your worth to Mokugg Lagerpounder by collecting 4 Icespine Stingers.
english.description: I will help you, but you are going to need to prove to me that you are not only a worthy fisherman, but also a fearless warrior.$b$bThe canyon north of us is full of icespine stingers.  Slaughter them and bring their stingers back to me.  They should work well as bait in these local waters.
english.progress: Have those stingers for me?
english.completion: Not bad traveler, not bad at all.
english.completed: Return to Mokugg Lagerpounder with the Icespine Stingers.

text.title: 磨刀不误砍柴工
text.objectives: 从木料上采集一份木材样本，并把它交给木材管理员奥克顿。
text.description: 有个难以置信的好消息啊，指挥官$n。你忠心耿耿的仆人（就是我）给我们找来了木材大王。也许你还不知道木材大王是什么，那我就给你讲讲吧：想象一下我们平时是怎么形容那些嗜血成性、杀人不眨眼的狂魔的？把那种嗜杀的热情转移到砍树上来！那就是木材大王了。$B$B这意味着，我们现在可以砍伐中等大小的木料了——但首先，我们得先试试这些木材大王的身手。$B$B附近正好有一棵合适的树。祝你好运！
text.progress: Did you harvest that timber sample yet?
text.completion: You didn't believe me about those timber lords, did you? Well now you know.$B$BIt looks like this group will serve you well, $g sir:ma'am;. Medium sized trees across Draenor are now at your mercy. That means more timber per tree!
text.completed: Return to Lumber Lord Oktron at the Lumber Mill.

english.title: Sharper Blades, Bigger Timber
english.objectives: Harvest a Timber Sample from Timber and return it to Lumber Lord Oktron.
english.description: Incredible news, Commander $n. Your ever-loyal servant (that's me) has managed to secure us timber lords. Now maybe you don't know what a timber lord is, so let explain: think of a blood-crazed, mass murderer who enjoys nothing more than killing. Now take that same enthusiasm for killing and apply it to killing trees! That's a timber lord.$B$BWhat this means is that we can now cut medium sized timber - but first we need to give these timber lords a test run.$B$BThere's a suitable tree nearby. Good luck!
english.progress: Did you harvest that timber sample yet?
english.completion: You didn't believe me about those timber lords, did you? Well now you know.$B$BIt looks like this group will serve you well, $g sir:ma'am;. Medium sized trees across Draenor are now at your mercy. That means more timber per tree!
english.completed: Return to Lumber Lord Oktron at the Lumber Mill.

text.title: 背叛者的峰林
text.objectives: 从通天峰的高阶贤者维里克斯手里获得纯炎金指环。
text.description: 我有很多活要让你干，$n，不过在那之前，我得先激活你身上的潜力。这点我可以帮上忙。$B$B我想要在你我之间建立一种链接，一样可以强化你力量的神器，同时还能让我时刻追踪你的进展。你觉得护符如何？不喜欢？戒指？我懂了。$B$B我在鸦人流亡者里的线人提到过一枚由纯粹的炎金所铸造的指环。眼下它在高阶贤者维里克斯的手里。那家伙住在通天峰。把那枚指环带过来，$n。它在我们手里能发挥出更大的作用。
text.progress: The arakkoa we see today are a shade of their former glory. They hide atop their spires and glower at the land below, smug and superior. The truth is that they were driven to their lofty perches by the very enemies they look down on today.$B$BI wish the arakkoa were easier to deal with. Their manipulation of the sun's rays could've been an asset to us.
text.completion: The ring! You've got it. Feel how it's still warm to the touch? The power of Draenor's sun is locked into the metal. This is perfect, $n. It is exactly the base material we need to fashion into something amazing.$b$bWhile I prepare your treasure, let's talk about our next steps...

english.title: Spires of the Betrayer
english.objectives: Collect a Pure Solium Band from High Sage Viryx in Skyreach.
english.description: I have much to ask of you, $n, but before we begin I must ensure that you develop yourself to your full potential. I can help.$b$bI'd like to create a link between us, an artifact that will enhance your power and allow me to track your progress. How do you feel about amulets? No? A ring? I've got it.$b$bMy contacts among the arakkoa outcasts tell of a band of pure solium. Right now it's in the talons of High Sage Viryx high atop Skyreach. Bring me that ring, $n - you and I have much better uses for it.
english.progress: The arakkoa we see today are a shade of their former glory. They hide atop their spires and glower at the land below, smug and superior. The truth is that they were driven to their lofty perches by the very enemies they look down on today.$B$BI wish the arakkoa were easier to deal with. Their manipulation of the sun's rays could've been an asset to us.
english.completion: The ring! You've got it. Feel how it's still warm to the touch? The power of Draenor's sun is locked into the metal. This is perfect, $n. It is exactly the base material we need to fashion into something amazing.$b$bWhile I prepare your treasure, let's talk about our next steps...

text.title: 德拉诺的秘密力量
text.objectives: 为大法师卡德加收集4986枚埃匹希斯水晶。埃匹希斯水晶可以在德拉诺最危险的怪物身上找到。
text.description: 今后我们需要紧密合作，因此我想先把你的戒指升级一下。古代魔法是升级的关键：埃匹希斯水晶，失落的古代鸦人文明的遗物！你能在德拉诺最危险的生物身上找到它们。$B$B给我带4986枚水晶过来。$B$B别那样子看我。我是法师，我可懂数学。我就是要4986枚，多一枚少一枚，法术效果都会出问题。$B$B四千九百八十六，记住了吗？去吧！
text.progress: Do you have the crystals? I hope you kept an accurate count. If you counted wrong I simply can't be held responsible for the consequences.
text.completion: Marvelous, marvelous! I will use these to upgrade your ring once we finish up a couple more tasks...

english.title: Draenor's Secret Power
english.objectives: Gather 4986 Apexis Crystals for Archmage Khadgar. Crystals can be found amongst creatures in the most dangerous parts of the world.
english.description: Since we're going to be working so closely together, I'd like to upgrade that ring of yours. Ancient magics are the key: apexis crystals, the leftover remains of an earlier arakkoa civilization! They can be found among the most dangerous creatures around the world.$b$bCollect 4986 crystals for me.$b$bDon't look at me like that. I'm a mage. I did the math. I need exactly 4986 crystals. 4985 is inadequate. 4987 is of course absurd.$b$bFour thousand, nine hundred eighty-six. Go!
english.progress: Do you have the crystals? I hope you kept an accurate count. If you counted wrong I simply can't be held responsible for the consequences.
english.completion: Чудесно, просто чудесно! Эти кристаллы пойдут на отделку твоего кольца, когда мы разберемся еще с парочкой заданий.

text.title: 要塞战役：带刺的玫瑰
text.objectives: 帮巴隆斯找到献给索恩的玫瑰花。
text.description: 这份感觉是如此强烈。我再也不能隐瞒自己的爱意了。$b$b我必须告诉索恩实情。我得让她知道，我爱她。$b$b她曾经说自己最喜欢玫瑰花。我一直在要塞里埋头干活……连德拉诺哪有玫瑰花都不知道。
text.progress: We are under attack!
text.completion: Commander! The Burning Blade attacked just a few moments ago, they are looking for the Heart of Gorgorek. $B$BThankfully, Lieutenant Thorn was here to protect us.$B$BWhat? You found a rose? Shh, hand it to me quickly. I'll hold onto this until the time to confess my love is right.
text.completed: Return to Baros in your garrison.

english.title: Garrison Campaign: Every Rose Has Its Thorn
english.objectives: Find Baros a rose for Thorn.
english.description: These feelings are too strong. I can no longer hide my love away.$b$bI need to tell Thorn the truth. I need to tell Thorn, I love her.$b$bShe mentioned her favorite flower is a rose.  I've been so heads down with my work... I don't even know where I could find a rose on Draenor.
english.progress: We are under attack!
english.completion: Commander! The Burning Blade attacked just a few moments ago, they are looking for the Heart of Gorgorek. $B$BThankfully, Lieutenant Thorn was here to protect us.$B$BWhat? You found a rose? Shh, hand it to me quickly. I'll hold onto this until the time to confess my love is right.
english.completed: Return to Baros in your garrison.

text.title: Where There Is Smoke...
text.objectives: Kill Rag'sla Thunkblade, Akatha Blazeburn, and Drek the Firecaller.
text.description: Burning Blade assassins have infiltrated the garrison. We must not let them take the Heart of Gorgorek, commander.
text.completion: The assassin appeared out of nowhere.$B$BBaros took the blade that was meant for my heart. I ripped out the throat of our attacker... but I was too late.$B$BBaros gave me this flower before he passed.$B$B<Thorn holds up the rose. A tear rolls down her cheek.>
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant Thorn in your garrison.

english.title: Where There Is Smoke...
english.objectives: Kill Rag'sla Thunkblade, Akatha Blazeburn, and Drek the Firecaller.
english.description: Burning Blade assassins have infiltrated the garrison. We must not let them take the Heart of Gorgorek, commander.
english.completion: The assassin appeared out of nowhere.$B$BBaros took the blade that was meant for my heart. I ripped out the throat of our attacker... but I was too late.$B$BBaros gave me this flower before he passed.$B$B<Thorn holds up the rose. A tear rolls down her cheek.>
english.completed: Return to Lieutenant Thorn in your garrison.

text.title: A Stolen Heart
text.objectives: Kill Azuka Bladefury.
text.description: Don't let Azuka take the heart, commander. Don't let her win.
text.completion: Today was not a good day.
text.completed: Speak with Lieutenant Thorn in your garrison.

english.title: A Stolen Heart
english.objectives: Kill Azuka Bladefury.
english.description: Don't let Azuka take the heart, commander. Don't let her win.
english.completion: Today was not a good day.
english.completed: Speak with Lieutenant Thorn in your garrison.

text.title: 要塞战役：大主教的召唤
text.objectives: 在影月谷的艾洛多尔与伊瑞尔谈一谈。
text.description: 啊，你正是我要找的$r，宝贝儿。$B$B伊瑞尔曾在不久前路过要塞找你。她是那么可爱的小美人！在我想家时还听我唠叨了许多以前家里的事。她真好。可面对年华的流逝，我又有什么办法呢？$B$B噢！伊瑞尔说让你去东边的艾洛多尔找她。$B$B德莱尼议会邀请她去接受大主教的试炼，我也不知道等待她的是什么。$B$B反正你快去吧！
text.completion: Thank you for coming, $n.

english.title: Garrison Campaign: The Exarch's Call
english.objectives: Speak to Yrel at Elodor in Shadowmoon Valley.
english.description: Ahhh, just the $r I were hopin' ta see, my dear.$B$BYrel stopped by the garrison earlier lookin' fer ya. Such a lovely lass, that one! Asked me all about ma family back home when I be feelin' homesick. Bless her. Anyway, what were I goin' on about ag'in?$B$BOh! She asked if ye'd meet her at Elodor to the east.$B$BShe's been invited by the draenei council ta face the Exarch trials, whatever those may be.$B$BAnyway, ye'd better scooch!
english.completion: Thank you for coming, $n.

text.title: 勇气的试炼
text.objectives: 消灭恒燃。
text.description: 每一位大主教都必须是人民力量的支柱，而没什么力量能比直面危险的勇气更强大了。$B$B在遥远的西北边，霜火岭白雪皑皑的峭壁间，住着一个名叫恒燃的原始元素之怒。$B$B只有当你跟这样的怪物四目相对时，你才能挑战自己勇气的极限。
text.completion: I see that you and Yrel have stared into the eyes of the most primal of the elementals, and not waivered from your path.$B$BIt pleases me to say that your courage is not lacking.$B$BWell done.
text.completed: Return to Exarch Akama at the Altar of Sha'tar in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: The Trial of Courage
english.objectives: Kill Everburn.
english.description: An Exarch must be a pillar of strength, and no greater strength is there than the courage to face danger.$B$BFar to the northwest, among the snowy crags of Frostfire Ridge, lives a primal fury named Everburn.$B$BOnly when you face one of these creatures eye to eye, will you know the extent of your courage.
english.completion: I see that you and Yrel have stared into the eyes of the most primal of the elementals, and not waivered from your path.$B$BIt pleases me to say that your courage is not lacking.$B$BWell done.
english.completed: Return to Exarch Akama at the Altar of Sha'tar in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 不要浪费时间
text.objectives: 把峰林药膏喂给南港的考里格·斯托克顿。
text.description: 我们挺走运的，指挥官。解毒剂很容易调配。$B$B我已经用我手头的材料配了一点。你赶紧把它带给考里格吧，这应该能暂时保住他的命，至少能活到我配出更多解药。
text.completion: By Muradin's beard... what a headache...
text.completed: Speak to Kolrigg Stoktron in Southport.

english.title: No Time to Waste
english.objectives: Administer the Spiresalve to Kolrigg Stoktron in Southport.
english.description: We're in luck, commander. The antidote is relatively easy tae make.$B$BI've made a small amount with what I had on me. You should take it tae Kolrigg before it's too late. It'll keep him alive long enough for me tae make more.
english.completion: By Muradin's beard... what a headache...
english.completed: Speak to Kolrigg Stoktron in Southport.

text.title: 不要浪费时间
text.objectives: 把峰林药膏喂给坠斧营地的伦祖尔。
text.description: 指挥官，我们运气不错。解毒剂的配方很简单。$B$B我已经用我手头的材料配了一点。你赶紧把它带给伦祖尔吧，这应该能暂时保住她的命，至少能活到我配出更多解药。
text.completion: By da spirits... me head be hurtin'...
text.completed: Speak to Lunzul in Axefall.

english.title: No Time to Waste
english.objectives: Administer the Spiresalve to Lunzul in Axefall.
english.description: Commander, we're in luck. The antidote recipe is fairly simple.$B$BI was able to make a small amount with what I had on me. You should take it to Lunzul before it's too late. It should keep her alive long enough for me to make more.
english.completion: I swear by the spirits, by the spirits... how my head hurts...
english.completed: Speak to Lunzul in Axefall.

text.title: 心灵的试炼
text.objectives: 在天蓝礁湖与伊瑞尔谈一谈，然后查明产生毒雾的起因。
text.description: 心灵的试炼是为了考验你在身处逆境时坚韧不拔的意志力。$B$B在遥远的西方的天蓝礁湖有个游侠哨站。$B$B他们发来了求援的请求。那里的每一个人都因患上某种传染病而卧病不起。急需我们的帮助。$B$B快去找驻守在那里的游侠。帮他们查出这种可怕疾病的起因。
text.completion: News of your deeds precedes you. Rangari Saardar already sent word of your excellent work.$B$BThanks to the both of you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Exarch Naielle at Elodor in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: The Trial of Heart
english.objectives: Speak to Yrel at Cerulean Lagoon, then find out the cause of the poisonous mist.
english.description: The Trial of Heart is a test of your willingness to persevere in the face of great adversity.$B$BFar to the west, there is a rangari outpost at Cerulean Lagoon.$B$BThey have sent a request for help. Some sort of infection is making everyone in the area sick. They desperately need aid.$B$BGo and seek out the rangari stationed there. Help them find the cause of this terrible ailment.
english.completion: News of your deeds precedes you. Rangari Saardar already sent word of your excellent work.$B$BThanks to the both of you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Exarch Naielle at Elodor in Shadowmoon Valley.

objectiveDetails.description: 在天蓝礁湖与伊瑞尔见面

text.title: 信仰的试炼
text.objectives: 在奥金顿的入口外面与缚魂者图拉妮谈一谈，然后通过信仰的试炼。
text.description: 前往我们亡故勇士的安息之所进行朝圣，是大主教试炼的必要步骤。$B$B顺便，我要你带上守备官玛尔拉德的骨灰，并将它们安放在奥金顿的神圣殿堂之中。$B$B我们先人的灵魂会在那里考验伊瑞尔最大的弱点。$B$B祝你好运。
text.completion: It seems you have been successful in your journey.$B$BHow do I know this? If you had not passed the challenge of the ancestors, you would not have returned at all.
text.completed: Return to Exarch Maladaar at the Altar of Sha'tar in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: The Trial of Faith
english.objectives: Speak to Soulbinder Tuulani outside the entrance to Auchindoun, then pass the Trial of Faith.
english.description: No Exarch trial is complete without a holy pilgrimage to the sacred resting place of our fallen champions.$B$BOn the way, I ask that you take Vindicator Maraad's ashes and lay them to rest within the hallowed halls of Auchindoun.$B$BThere, the spirits of our fallen ancestors will test Yrel's greatest weakness.$B$BGood luck.
english.completion: It seems you have been successful in your journey.$B$BHow do I know this? If you had not passed the challenge of the ancestors, you would not have returned at all.
english.completed: Return to Exarch Maladaar at the Altar of Sha'tar in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 勇士的试炼
text.objectives: 击败主教议会。
text.description: 你出色地完成了前三个试炼。$B$B但在最后的试炼中，你将面对主教议会。$B$B等你做好开始的准备就来找我吧。
text.completion: Well done, champion. Well done.
text.completed: Return to Exarch Naielle at the Altar of Sha'tar in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: The Trial of Champions
english.objectives: Defeat the Exarch Council.
english.description: The first three trials you have passed with flying colors.$B$BFor the final trial, you shall face the Exarch Council.$B$BSpeak to me when you are ready to begin.
english.completion: Well done, champion. Well done.
english.completed: Return to Exarch Naielle at the Altar of Sha'tar in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 木精入侵！
text.objectives: 击退木精对你要塞的入侵。$B$B（再次与克劳勒中士交谈来开始行动）
text.description: 植物今天看起来很不一样。草叶都被风吹弯了，掠扫着我的靴子。早上还有两根树枝掉到了我的头盔上。
text.completion: We beat back nature, Commander. May I be excused? I'd like to get all this sap out of my armor.
text.completed: Speak with Sergeant Crowler in your garrison.

english.title: Botani Invasion!
english.objectives: Repel the botani invasion of your garrison.$B$B(Speak with Sergeant Crowler again to begin)
english.description: The plants seem different today. Grass blades bend against the wind and catch on my boots. Twice this morning a tree branch struck my helmet as it fell.
english.completion: We beat back nature, Commander. May I be excused? I'd like to get all this sap out of my armor.
english.completed: Speak with Sergeant Crowler in your garrison.
