text.title: Nagrand - Treasure 081 - Bounty of the Elements

english.title: Nagrand - Treasure 081 - Bounty of the Elements

text.title: 选拔猎手
text.objectives: 把肮脏的纸条交给安波里村的法娜拉来参加比赛。
text.description: <这张纸条上的字迹已经模糊难辨了，但它似乎是安波里村当地狩猎大赛的一张广告传单。>$B$B“欢迎所有乐于参赛的竞技者们在友好的狩猎挑战赛中一较高下。"
text.completion: Another competitor for the competition? How wonderful! Garaal will be pleased!
text.completed: 把纸条交给安波里村的法娜拉。

english.title: A Call for Huntsman
english.objectives: Deliver the Dirty Note to Fanara in Embaari Village to join the competition.
english.description: <The note is barely legible, but it seems to be an advertisement for a local hunting competition out of Embaari Village.>$B$B"Any and all competitors are welcome to test their skills in a friendly hunting challenge."
english.completion: Another competitor for the competition? How wonderful! Garaal will be pleased!
english.completed: Deliver the note to Fanara in Embaari Village.

text.title: 友好竞赛
text.objectives: 赶在其他竞争对手之前收集到$1oa块影月皮革和$2oa个银翼利爪，并回去交给法娜拉。
text.description: 所以你是要参加比赛吗，$n？愿好运降临到你头上。$B$B以最快的速度，赶在其他对手前面，从当地的野生动物身上收集满满一袋皮革和利爪，并把它们交给我！$B$B获胜者将有机会成为工匠加莱尔的学徒。$B$B祝你好运！
text.progress: The satchel is full and ready for delivery.
text.completion: Congratulations, $n! You did it!$B$BThe other competitors are nowhere to be found!$B$BGaraal will be most pleased. With such an abundance of supplies to work with he and the other craftsmen will have no trouble staying busy.$B$BI'll start tanning these immediately. They'll be ready for delivery in just a moment.
text.completed: Return to Fanara in Embaari Village.

english.title: Friendly Competition
english.objectives: Gather $1oa Shadowmoon Hides and $2oa Silverwing Talons and return to Fanara before the other competitors.
english.description: So you wish to join the competition, $n? Best of luck to you.$B$BBe the first to gather a sack full of hides and talons from local wildlife and return them to me before the other competitors!$B$BWinner earns the opportunity for an apprenticeship under craftsman Garaal.$B$BGood luck!
english.progress: The satchel is full and ready for delivery.
english.completion: Congratulations, $n! You did it!$B$BThe other competitors are nowhere to be found!$B$BGaraal will be most pleased. With such an abundance of supplies to work with he and the other craftsmen will have no trouble staying busy.$B$BI'll start tanning these immediately. They'll be ready for delivery in just a moment.
english.completed: Return to Fanara in Embaari Village.

text.title: 恼人的昆虫
text.objectives: 在菌雾浅滩消灭掉10个孢子漂流者或巨型真菌。
text.description: 只要我们一架设起炮台，浅滩上的那些怪物就会跑来破坏。$b$b我本想亲自去消灭它们的，可我的引爆器却彻底坏掉了，那破玩意就连一根像这样的蜡烛都点不着！$b$b我得留在车间里修理引爆器，你能不能帮我去干掉几个怪物？$b$b记得告诉加兹维茨你是替我做的，那样我就能顺利报销修理费了。
text.completion: Lemmy's gun broke down again I take it?$b$bGood job covering for 'em out there. I could use more workers like you!

english.title: Unwanted Pests
english.objectives: Kill 10 Spore Drifters or Fungal Hulks in Sporemist Shallows.
english.description: Those creatures out in the shallows keep busting the turrets as fast as we can get them operational.$b$bI'm supposed to go clear them out but my blaster is completely busted; the damn thing barely can light a candle like this!$b$bCould you do me a favor and go kill a few of those pests while I get my blaster fixed at the shop?$b$bJust let Gazwitz know you covered for me so I can get reimbursed for the repair.
english.completion: Lemmy's gun broke down again I take it?$b$bGood job covering for 'em out there. I could use more workers like you!

text.title: 山木自寇
text.objectives: 从大型木料上收集木材样本，并交给木材管理员奥克顿。
text.description: 指挥官，地精们给你带来了一份礼物。他们管它叫伐树者9000型。$B$B它是干嘛用的？我想应该是用来砍树的——可更重要的是，它能让你砍伐大块木料。你知道一棵参天大树上有多少木料吗？我也不知道，但肯定少不了！$B$B在附近就正好有一大块木料等待砍伐呢。你不如去试试那台新设备？把它砍下来的木料给我带来，我一定会善加利用。
text.progress: Did you harvest that timber sample yet?
text.completion: This is fantastic! This sample indicates massive timber reserves in the large timber found across Draenor. And now with the Tree Murderer 9000 at your disposal you'll be able to chop those towering monstrosities down with ease.

english.title: Tree-i-cide
english.objectives: Harvest a Timber Sample from Large Timber and return it to Lumber Lord Oktron.
english.description: Commander, the goblins have brought you a present. They call it the Tree Murderer 9000.$B$BWhat's it do? I reckon it murders trees - but more importantly it will allow for the harvesting of large timber. Do you know how much timber a large tree holds? Me neither, but I bet it's a lot!$B$BThere's a large piece of timber ready to be murdered nearby. Why don't you give the contraption a test run? Bring me back whatever it harvests and I'll put it to good use.
english.progress: Did you harvest that timber sample yet?
english.completion: This is fantastic! This sample indicates massive timber reserves in the large timber found across Draenor. And now with the Tree Murderer 9000 at your disposal you'll be able to chop those towering monstrosities down with ease.

text.title: 海军上将泰勒
text.objectives: 去海军上将泰勒的农场找海军上将泰勒。
text.description: 海军上将泰勒已经查出了是谁在幕后搞鬼。他让我们想尽一切办法拯救幸存者……他想要自己一个人去处理这件事。$B$B之后我们就再也没有听到他的消息，但我们必须执行命令。$B$B我们请求你……找到他。他往农场那边去了。
text.completion: From one commander to another... thank you.$B$BWe've faced off on the field of battle so many times. Vashj'ir... the Jade Forest... Lion's Landing...$B$BI am glad I could end my journey with such a worthy adversary.
text.completed: Speak to Admiral Taylor at Admiral Taylor's Farm.

english.title: Admiral Taylor
english.objectives: Find Admiral Taylor at Admiral Taylor's Farm.
english.description: Admiral Taylor had figured out who was behind all this. He told us to save who we could... he wanted to handle matters himself.$B$BWe never heard from him again, but we have our orders.$B$BPlease... please find him. He went towards the farm.
english.completion: From one commander to another... thank you.$B$BWe've faced off on the field of battle so many times. Vashj'ir... the Jade Forest... Lion's Landing...$B$BI am glad I could end my journey with such a worthy adversary.
english.completed: Speak to Admiral Taylor at Admiral Taylor's Farm.

text.title: 公平交易
text.objectives: 加莱尔在等你送货。
text.description: 好了，搞定。$B$B一定要尽快把它们交给加莱尔。他对细节和精湛的做工有着孜孜不倦的追求。你的作品肯定会得到他的赞许。
text.completion: Greetings, $n.$B$BFanara mentioned the competition was fierce this year.$B$BMy, my. These goods should keep me busy for an entire season!$B$BAs the victor of the competition one usually becomes my apprentice, however, your skills are surely in need of no apprenticeship.$B$BPerhaps a trade is in order.$B$BI'll keep your delivery and share the goods with our local craftsmen and in return, I'll share some of our knowledge with you.
text.completed: 把商品交给安波里村的加莱尔。

english.title: Fair Trade
english.objectives: Garaal awaits your delivery.
english.description: Alright. Here you go.$B$BBe sure to deliver them to Garaal quickly. He has a heavy interest in detail and fine craftsmanship. He'll surely appreciate your work.
english.completion: Greetings, $n.$B$BFanara mentioned the competition was fierce this year.$B$BMy, my. These goods should keep me busy for an entire season!$B$BAs the victor of the competition one usually becomes my apprentice, however, your skills are surely in need of no apprenticeship.$B$BPerhaps a trade is in order.$B$BI'll keep your delivery and share the goods with our local craftsmen and in return, I'll share some of our knowledge with you.
english.completed: Deliver the goods to Garaal at Embaari Village.

text.title: Moving On Up
text.objectives: Garaal has offered to further your knowledge in leatherworking.
text.description: A generous decision, $n.$B$BYou have demonstrated your skills as a hunter, delivered a piece worthy of your name and proven your dedication to your craft. Please, take this as a token of my gratitude.$B$BMay the light guide your hand and passion, your heart.
text.completed: Garaal has afforded you his knowledge of draenic craftsmanship.

english.title: Moving On Up
english.objectives: Garaal has offered to further your knowledge in leatherworking.
english.description: A generous decision, $n.$B$BYou have demonstrated your skills as a hunter, delivered a piece worthy of your name and proven your dedication to your craft. Please, take this as a token of my gratitude.$B$BMay the light guide your hand and passion, your heart.
english.completed: Garaal has afforded you his knowledge of draenic craftsmanship.

text.title: 伐木工入门
text.objectives: 从小型木料上收集木材样本，并交给贾斯汀·汀布罗德。
text.description: $G先生:女士;，如果我们想把这座要塞打造成合格的堡垒，就需要用到一大堆木料。那意味着我们得做些工作才行。$B$B当然，我是肯定不会麻烦你去干脏活累活的，可我需要你去帮我们的伐木场寻找木料。等你标记好一棵树之后，就会有一个伐木工前去砍伐，把木料交给你。$B$B让我们看看伐木工的本事吧。附近正好就有一棵树！
text.progress: This garrison isn't going to build itself, commander! We need timber!
text.completion: You're going to make a fine overseer, sir! Keep those lumberjacks in line!$B$BNow you know the basics of logging and finding timber. Time to put them to good use for the good of your garrison.

english.title: Easing into Lumberjacking
english.objectives: Harvest a Timber Sample from Small Timber and return it to Justin Timberlord.
english.description: $G Sir:Ma'am;, we're going to need a lot of lumber if we're going to build this garrison into a suitable fortress. That means we're going to have to do a little work.$B$BWhile I certainly wouldn't ask you to dirty your hands with manual labor, I do need you to go out and find timber for our mill. Once you mark a tree a lumberjack will come chop it down and give you the timber.$B$BLet's give our lumberjacks a test run. There's a tree nearby!
english.progress: Командир! Гарнизон сам себя не построит! Нам нужна древесина!
english.completion: Из тебя выйдет прекрасный надсмотрщик! Не давай спуску этим дровосекам!$b$bТеперь ты знаешь основы заготовки леса и поиска древесины. Применим же эти знания на благо твоего гарнизона.

text.title: 化木材为利润
text.objectives: 从德拉诺各地收集10份木料，然后在你要塞的伐木场里下达一份产品订单。
text.description: 既然你已经知道如何让伐木工们去砍伐木料了，我们接下来要为你的伐木场创建一份产品订单。$B$B但首先，我们得找些可供加工的木料！$B$B德拉诺到处都盛产着可供砍伐的成熟树木。去为我们的伐木场找些合适的木料。等找到足够之后再回到这里来，我们将开始完成一份产品订单。$B$B老样子，还是把累活留给伐木工们做，只要保护好他们就行。德拉诺可是个危险的地方！
text.completion: That's how it's done, commander!$B$BWe're now fully operational. Any time you have enough timber to place a work order, come on back to me and we'll get started.$B$BThis garrison ain't gonna build itself!
text.completed: Return to Justin Timberlord at the Lumber Mill.

english.title: Turning Timber into Profit
english.objectives: Collect 10 pieces of Timber from around Draenor and then Place a Work Order at your Garrison's Lumber Mill.
english.description: Now that you know how to put lumberjacks to work harvesting timber, we're going to create a work order for your mill.$B$BBut first we're going to need some timber to process!$B$BAll around Draenor are juicy trees ripe for the chopping. Go out and find suitable timber for the lumber mill. Come back here when you have enough and we'll get started on a work order.$B$BAnd as usual, let the lumberjacks do the hard work. Just keep 'em protected. Draenor's a dangerous place!
english.completion: Так-то, командир!$b$bТеперь мы работаем на полную мощность. Когда у вас будет достаточно древесины для размещения заказа, возвращайся ко мне, и мы приступим.$b$bГарнизон сам себя не построит!
english.completed: Return to Justin Timberlord at the Lumber Mill.

text.title: 善举
text.objectives: 用愈体金伞菌来帮倒下的游侠疗伤。
text.description: 我知道你跟守备官伊瑞尔身负重任，可还是得请你帮个忙。$B$B有一群游侠在毒雾弥散前出去巡逻了。$B$B要是他们被困在沼泽里，可就有大麻烦了。$B$B去采一些生长在芦苇丛中的愈体金伞菌，用它们给你找到的所有倒下的游侠疗伤。$B$B要是你自己也身陷险境的话，就吃一个来解毒。
text.completion: Thank the Light! All of the rangari who were missing have returned accounted for. Thank you, hero.
text.completed: Return to Rangari Saardar at Cerulean Lagoon in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: An Act of Kindness
english.objectives: Use Restorative Goldcaps to revive fallen rangari.
english.description: I know that you and Vindicator Yrel are here on important matters, but I must ask you a favor.$B$BA squad of rangari left on patrol just before the poisonous mist set in.$B$BIf they were caught out in the swamp, they are surely in trouble.$B$BHarvest the Restorative Goldcaps growing among the reeds, and use them to restore any fallen rangari that you find.$B$BIf you find yourself in trouble, eat one to combat the poison.
english.completion: Thank the Light! All of the rangari who were missing have returned accounted for. Thank you, hero.
english.completed: Return to Rangari Saardar at Cerulean Lagoon in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 磨刀不误砍柴工
text.objectives: 从木料上采集一份木材样本，并把它交给贾斯汀·汀布罗德。
text.description: 有个难以置信的好消息啊，指挥官$n。你忠心耿耿的仆人给我们找来了树木终结者。也许你还不知道树木终结者是什么，那我就给你讲讲吧：他们跟普通伐木工一样，只不过接受了杀戮艺术的严格训练，大多数以前都是雇佣兵和杀手。$B$B这意味着，我们现在可以砍伐中等大小的木料了——但首先，我们得先试试这些树木终结者的身手。$B$B附近正好有一棵合适的树。祝你好运！
text.progress: Did you harvest that timber sample yet?
text.completion: We haven't even scratched the surface when it comes to overkill.$B$BIt looks like this group will serve you well, sir. Medium sized trees across Draenor are now at your mercy. That means more timber per tree!
text.completed: Return to Justin Timberlord at the Lumber Mill.

english.title: Sharper Blades, Bigger Timber
english.objectives: Harvest a Timber Sample from Timber and return it to Justin Timberlord.
english.description: Incredible news, Commander $n. Your ever-loyal servant has managed to secure us commandojacks. Now maybe you don't know what a commandojack is, so let me explain: they're like lumberjacks, only highly trained in the art of killing. Mostly they're out of work mercenaries and assassins.$B$BWhat this means is that we can now cut medium sized timber - but first we need to give these commandojacks a test run.$B$BThere's a suitable tree nearby. Good luck!
english.progress: Did you harvest that timber sample yet?
english.completion: И это они еще даже не старались.$b$bУверен, помощь боевых дровосеков окажется незаменимой, командир. Средние деревья по всему Дренору отныне беззащитны перед тобой. А с каждого такого дерева мы получим еще больше древесины!
english.completed: Return to Justin Timberlord at the Lumber Mill.

text.title: 山木自寇
text.objectives: 从大型木料上收集木材样本，并交给贾斯汀·汀布罗德。
text.description: 指挥官，你的工程师们给你带来了一份礼物。他们管它叫森林毁灭者XXI型三世。$B$B它是干嘛用的？我想应该是用来砍树的——可更重要的是，它能让你砍伐大块木料。你知道一棵参天大树上有多少木料吗？我也不知道，但肯定少不了！$B$B在附近就正好有一大块木料等待砍伐呢。你不如去试试那台新设备？把它砍下来的木料给我带来，我一定会善加利用。
text.progress: Did you harvest that timber sample yet?
text.completion: This is fantastic! This sample indicates massive timber reserves in the large timber found across Draenor. And now with the Wood Annihilator XXI the Third, Jr. at your disposal you'll be able to chop those towering monstrosities down with ease.$B$BGet off my back, I didn't name it.
text.completed: Return to Justin Timberlord at the Lumber Mill.

english.title: Tree-i-cide
english.objectives: Harvest a Timber Sample from Large Timber and return it to Justin Timberlord.
english.description: Commander, your engineers have brought you a present. They call it the Wood Annihilator XXI the Third, Jr.$B$BWhat's it do? I reckon it annihilates trees - but more importantly it will allow for the harvesting of large timber. Do you know how much timber a large tree holds? Me neither, but I bet it's a lot!$B$BThere's a large piece of timber ready to be annihilated nearby. Why don't you give the contraption a test run? Bring me back whatever it harvests and I'll put it to good use.
english.progress: Did you harvest that timber sample yet?
english.completion: This is fantastic! This sample indicates massive timber reserves in the large timber found across Draenor. And now with the Wood Annihilator XXI the Third, Jr. at your disposal you'll be able to chop those towering monstrosities down with ease.$B$BGet off my back, I didn't name it.
english.completed: Return to Justin Timberlord at the Lumber Mill.

text.title: 欢迎来到阿什兰
text.objectives: 到战争之矛找乌瑟特·狼行将军谈一谈。
text.description: 你好啊，欢迎来到阿什兰。$B$B去找战争之矛的乌瑟特·狼行将军报到，听她安排任务。
text.completion: You've just now showed up? Well, better late than never.

english.title: Welcome to Ashran
english.objectives: Speak to General Ushet Wolfbarger  in Warspear.
english.description: Greetings, and welcome to Ashran. $B$BReport to General Ushet Wolfbarger in Warspear for your orders.
english.completion: Ты только $gявился:явилась;? Что ж, лучше поздно, чем никогда.

text.title: 报到
text.objectives: 与凯米尔·辉刃、玛儿·野蹄和祖格谈一谈。
text.description: 出列，$n！别耽误时间了，去找这些家伙谈谈，他们会向你说明一切的。
text.completion: Yea, that Zurge really is angry isn't he?
text.completed: Return to Ushet Wolfbarger in Warspear Outpost.

english.title: Reporting For Duty
english.objectives: Speak to Cymre Brightblade, Mare Wildrunner and Zurge.
english.description: Front and center, $n! No time to waste, go speak with these fellows and they'll fill you in.
english.completion: Yeah, this Zurg is really evil, right?
english.completed: Return to Ushet Wolfbarger in Warspear Outpost.

text.title: 找到神器碎片
text.objectives: 战争之矛岗哨的凯米尔·辉刃要你在阿什兰郊野的大路边消灭怪物，并将5块神器碎片交给弗拉。
text.description: 我们在阿什兰郊野的任何怪物身上似乎都能找到神器碎片。$B$B去消灭你看到的任何怪物，把至少5块神器碎片交给战争之矛岗哨的法师弗拉。
text.progress: Are those Artifact Fragments, I see?
text.completion: Good work. If you happen to find anymore Artifact Fragments, bring them to me or the others in need of them to contribute to the war effort.
text.completed: Return to Fura in Warspear Outpost.

english.title: Uncovering the Artifact Fragments
english.objectives: Cymre Brightblade in Warspear Outpost wants you to go kill creatures in the outskirts of Ashran outside of the main road and bring back 5 Artifact Fragments to Fura.
english.description: The Artifact Fragments seem to come from any creature we've found in the outskirts of Ashran.$B$BGo out and kill any you find and bring at least five Artifact Fragments to Fura the Mage in Warspear Outpost.
english.progress: Are those Artifact Fragments, I see?
english.completion: Потрясающе! Если найдешь еще фрагменты артефакта, принеси их мне или тем, кто в них нуждается. Так ты приблизишь час победы.
english.completed: Return to Fura in Warspear Outpost.

text.title: 月壳蟹爪
text.objectives: 收集4个月壳蟹爪，向玛达利证明你的价值。
text.description: 我可以帮忙，但你必须先证明你不仅是一名合格的渔夫，更是一名无畏的战士。$B$B东南边的海滩上满是月壳爬行者。去消灭它们，把它们的蟹爪带回来给我。在这块水域，这种蟹爪能充当不错的鱼饵。
text.progress: Have those claws for me?
text.completion: Not bad traveler, not bad at all.
text.completed: Return to Madari with the Moosnshell Claws.

english.title: Moonshell Claws
english.objectives: Prove your worth to Madari by collecting 4 Moonshell Claws.
english.description: I will help you, but you are going to need to prove to me that you are not only a worthy fisherman, but also a fearless warrior.$b$bThe beach southeast of us is full of moonshell crawlers.  Slaughter them and bring their claws back to me.  They should work well as bait in these local waters.
english.progress: Have those claws for me?
english.completion: Not bad traveler, not bad at all.
english.completed: Return to Madari with the Moosnshell Claws.

text.title: 证明你的实力
text.objectives: 用拿到的鱼饵捕捉到5条暗影鲟鱼，向玛达利证明你的价值。
text.description: 你已证明了自己是一位战士，现在让我们来瞧瞧你的钓鱼技术如何。我已经把你带来的那些月壳蟹爪做成了鱼饵，你试试用它来捕捉近海的暗影鲟鱼。
text.progress: Catch those sturgeon?
text.completion: I see you are both a fisherman and a warrior.  I will do what I can to help you.
text.completed: Return to Madari with the sturgeon.

english.title: Proving Your Worth
english.objectives: Prove your worth to Madari by catching 5 Shadow Sturgeon using the supplied bait.
english.description: Now that you have proven yourself as a warrior, let's see how your fishing skills hold up. I have fashioned a bait out of the moonshell claws you brought me. Use it to catch the shadow sturgeon in these coastal waters.
english.progress: Catch those sturgeon?
english.completion: I see you are both a fisherman and a warrior.  I will do what I can to help you.
english.completed: Return to Madari with the sturgeon.

text.title: 在自家要塞里垂钓
text.objectives: 把日暮垂钓日志交给罗恩·艾什顿。
text.description: 你已证明了你的价值，旅行者。带着这本《日暮垂钓日志》回你的要塞好好学学。很快，你就能靠钓鱼养活自己啦。
text.progress: We can use that as bait?!
text.completion: Look at all the bait ideas in this thing! Great job $n!
text.completed: Return to Ron Ashton at the Garrison.

english.title: Anglin' In Our Garrison
english.objectives: Return to Ron Ashton with the Eventide Fishing Journal.
english.description: You have proven your worth, traveler.  Now take this eventide fishing journal back to your garrison and study up.  You will be catching all you can eat in no time.
english.progress: We can use that as bait?!
english.completion: Look at all the bait ideas in this thing! Great job $n!
english.completed: Return to Ron Ashton at the Garrison.

text.title: 破损的锤子
text.objectives: 在岩牙岗哨寻找锤子从前的主人。
text.description: 这把工艺精良的锻造锤从前肯定不是这般光景。$B$B现在又脏又破，勉强还能看出一点从前的风采。$B$B可以肯定的是，它原先的主人既不是食人魔也不是钢铁部落的成员。$B$B也许岩牙岗哨里有人知道它的出处。
text.progress: What do you want, $R?
text.completion: My father's hammer, where did you find this!?

english.title: The Fractured Hammer
english.objectives: Search Stonefang Outpost for the hammer's previous owner.
english.description: It is obvious that this elaborate smithing hammer has seen better days.$B$BNow fractured and dirty, it is merely a shadow of its former self.$B$BOne thing is certain, its previous owner was neither ogre nor Iron Horde.$B$BPerhaps someone at Stonefang Outpost would know who this belongs to.
english.progress: What do you want, $R?
english.completion: My father's hammer, where did you find this!?

text.title: The Dragon's Tale
text.objectives: Follow the trail of clues up the hillside until you discover Kairozdormu in the Time-Lost Glade.
text.description: Chromie thinks she's picked up the trail. We suspect that Garrosh traveled through here when he first arrived on Draenor. But what about Kairoz? He must be close.$b$bChromie will illuminate the clues. Look for a series of temporal anomalies. Follow the trail east of here and pick your way up to the top of the mountains until we've located Kairozdormu... or his body. Good luck!
text.completion: That solves one riddle. The moment they arrived in Draenor, Garrosh killed his savior.$B$BHe left the job unfinished; The dragon's spirit is still restless.$B$BI hope you're ready for a fight.
text.completed: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at the Time-Lost Glade in Nagrand.

english.title: The Dragon's Tale
english.objectives: Follow the trail of clues up the hillside until you discover Kairozdormu in the Time-Lost Glade.
english.description: Chromie thinks she's picked up the trail. We suspect that Garrosh traveled through here when he first arrived on Draenor. But what about Kairoz? He must be close.$b$bChromie will illuminate the clues. Look for a series of temporal anomalies. Follow the trail east of here and pick your way up to the top of the mountains until we've located Kairozdormu... or his body. Good luck!
english.completion: С этим разобрались. Как только они прибыли на Дренор, Гаррош убил своего спасителя.$b$bНо он не довел дело до конца. Дух дракона все еще не упокоен.$b$bНадеюсь, ты $gготов:готова; к сражению.
english.completed: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at the Time-Lost Glade in Nagrand.

text.title: 冰铸者瓦鲁克
text.objectives: 把瓦鲁克的锤子送到他的坟墓。
text.description: 好多人都说我的父亲是一位传奇铁匠，他们把他称作冰铸者。他们会给你讲述关于他强大武器的传说，那些武器完全是由寒冰与钢铁铸就的。而我却称他为谎话精瓦鲁克。$B$B他信誓旦旦地承诺自己不会离开太久，他说“我必须要给我们的军队提供支援！”$B$B可他为什么非去不可呢？他们为什么会让他被抓走？！$B$B既然承诺都化为了泡影，我留着这些破损的工具也没什么用。他的坟墓就在东边，你可以把这把锤子跟他其它没用的东西放到一起。
text.progress: Greetings $R, what brings you to this old orc's grave?
text.completion: Where did you find this hammer!?

english.title: Waruk the Frostforger
english.objectives: Deliver Waruk's hammer to his grave site.
english.description: Many say my father was a legendary blacksmith, Waruk the Frostforger they called him. They will tell you tales of his mighty weapons, crafted with nothing more than ice and steel. Waruk the Lieforger, I call him.$B$BHe promised he wouldn't be gone long, "I must support our troops!" he said.$B$BWhy did he have to go? Why did they let him get captured!?$B$BI have no more need for broken tools than I do broken promises. His grave is east of here, you can leave this with the rest of his unwanted belongings.
english.progress: Greetings $R, what brings you to this old orc's grave?
english.completion: Where did you find this hammer!?

text.title: 水晶碎片
text.objectives: 从长牙吞噬者身上收集$1oa块鬣蜥人水晶。
text.description: 你能及时赶到真是太好了。$b$b嘲颅氏族的兽人们演练着什么诡异的灵魂魔法，可他们的其中一项传统却对我们当下的处境很有帮助。$b$b在我做准备的同时，你能不能去收集材料？$b$b首先，我们需要用到鬣蜥人尸体外皮上的水晶。你可以在峡谷里找到它们的尸体。
text.progress: I have learned some of the Laughing Skull traditions. This is less strange than many.
text.completion: Goren crystals are used by some as weapons. The acid left behind can be deadly though, even to the wielder.
text.completed: Return to Rangari Erdanii at Breaker's Crown.

english.title: The Crystal Shard
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Goren Crystals from Longtooth Gorgers.
english.description: I'm glad you arrived when you did.$b$bThe Laughing Skull orcs practice some strange spirit magic, but one of their traditions could be quite useful in our situation.$b$bWhile I make preparations, can you gather the reagents?$b$bFirst, we'll need crystals from the husks of goren corpses. You can find their bodies in the canyon.
english.progress: I have learned some of the Laughing Skull traditions. This is less strange than many.
english.completion: Некоторые делают из кристаллов горенов оружие. Правда, оставшаяся на таком кристалле кислота смертельно опасна даже для того, кто им вооружен.
english.completed: Return to Rangari Erdanii at Breaker's Crown.

text.title: 那下面有什么？
text.objectives: 使用鬣蜥人伪装服，探索戈尔隆德的各个地点。
text.description: 完成了。$b$b有了这个魔法做掩护，你不仅能大摇大摆地在鬣蜥人面前行走，还能像他们那样移动。$b$b你现在可以轻松地在峡谷里往来穿行了。你可以安全地进入原本不可能靠近的地方。$b$b也许这些隧道可以让我们掌握更多情报，用来对抗钢铁部落。
text.progress: That goren disguise smells awful.
text.completion: Your search brought rewards?
text.completed: Return to Rangari Erdanii at Breaker's Crown.

english.title: What's Under There?
english.objectives: Use the goren disguise to explore locations in Gorgrond.
english.description: It is done.$b$bWith this enchantment, not only can you roam amongst the goren freely, but you can move as they do.$b$bYour travels through the canyon are now made easier. You have safe access to places otherwise impossible to reach.$b$bPerhaps these tunnels will lead to more information that could be used against the Iron Horde.
english.progress: That goren disguise smells awful.
english.completion: Поиски увенчались успехом?
english.completed: Return to Rangari Erdanii at Breaker's Crown.

objectiveDetails.description: 查看第一条隧道通往哪里
查看第三条隧道通往哪里
检查格罗姆卡信使尸体
沿着隧道返回毁灭者之冠
查看第二条隧道通往哪里

text.title: 硬壳
text.objectives: 从骨园暴食者身上获得$1oa份鬣蜥人甲壳。
text.description: 我通过观察嘲颅氏族获知了不少情报。$b$b由于鬣蜥人会在身后留下酸性物质，穿过鬣蜥人坑洞向来被视作是不可能完成的任务，可这些兽人却想出了解决办法。$b$b我们需要一些峡谷中鬣蜥人的甲壳。$b$b如果你看到任何即将喷发的坑口，就靠近它们，鬣蜥人会鱼贯而出。这样你就能一下子干掉好多个，更快地找到甲壳。
text.progress: Goren seem willing to eat anything in their path, alive or otherwise.
text.completion: Ah, yes, these shells will work perfectly.
text.completed: Return to Rangari Erdanii at Breaker's Crown.

english.title: Hard Shell
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Goren Shells from Boneyard Gorgers.
english.description: I have already learned much from watching the Laughing Skull.$b$bTraveling through goren tunnels was thought to be impossible due to the acid they leave behind, but the orcs found a way around it.$b$bWe will need some of the shells of goren within the canyon.$b$bIf you see any of their tunnel craters ready to burst, approach them and goren will come pouring out. This way, you can kill many at once and find the shells more quickly.
english.progress: Goren seem willing to eat anything in their path, alive or otherwise.
english.completion: Отлично. Эти панцири – как раз то, что нужно.
english.completed: Return to Rangari Erdanii at Breaker's Crown.

text.title: 要塞战役：鲜血竞技场
text.objectives: 在纳格兰古尔戈索克的秘巢与古尔戈索克谈一谈。
text.description: 你好啊，勇士。$B$B我路过时你刚好外出了。我在纳格兰的鲜血竞技场准备了一场巅峰对决。好多食人魔都在等着下一场大战呢。大笔大笔的赏金啊。你要来吗？$B$B我这简直是在开玩笑，谁会对名望、财富和切磋拳脚的好机会无动于衷啊？到我的秘巢里找我吧，在你隆重登场前，我们得先私下聊聊。$B$B<面前有一张地图，在一座废弃的食人魔高塔所在的位置上画出了一个钱币的标志。>
text.completion: I won't waste your time, champ. I've got a once in a lifetime opportunity for you.
text.completed: Speak to Gurgthock at Gurgthock's Stash in Nagrand.

english.title: Garrison Campaign: The Ring of Blood
english.objectives: Speak to Gurgthock at Gurgthock's Stash in Nagrand.
english.description: Hey Champ,$B$BYou were out when I stopped by. I've got a sweet gig set up at the Ring of Blood in Nagrand. Lots of ogres looking for the next big fight. Big money. You in?$B$BWho am I kidding, who wouldn't be interested in fame, fortune, and brawlin'? I'll meet you at my stash so we can talk a bit in private before your big debut.$B$B<A map is included with a dollar sign scrawled on an abandoned ogre tower.>
english.completion: I won't waste your time, champ. I've got a once in a lifetime opportunity for you.
english.completed: Speak to Gurgthock at Gurgthock's Stash in Nagrand.

text.title: 你究竟有多强？
text.objectives: 消灭鲁格多尔，并将他的徽记交给高里亚试练场外的“铁壁”克罗戈尔。
text.description: 穆戈尔正在鲜血竞技场举办一场特别的对决，以加冕新晋的鲜血勇士，在我看来这一桂冠非你莫属！$B$B听好了，这些食人魔只奉行一个原则，那就是无恶……不作。他们派出了一个大块头守住了前门，确保只有最勇猛的角斗士才能进入试炼场。$B$B如果你决定参加的话，就消灭路前方高塔那里怒火冲天的角斗士鲁格多尔，然后把他的徽记交给“铁壁”克罗戈尔。那应该能让他们知道你的本事。
text.progress: Nobody gets in da proving grounds unless I say so.
text.completion: If you kill Lug'dol, you definitely belong in da proving grounds.$B$BI don't even care that you tiny not ogre!
text.completed: Speak to Kroggol the Wall outside the Gorian Proving Grounds.

english.title: How Tough Are You?
english.objectives: Kill Lug'dol and present his head to Kroggol the Wall outside the Gorian Proving Grounds.
english.description: Mogor's holding a special match over at the Ring of Blood to crown the new Blood Champion and I think you have what it takes!$B$BNow, these ogres respect one thing and one thing only: badass...ness. They have a big fella at the front door making sure only the toughest gladiators enter the proving grounds.$B$BIf you're in, kill the grizzled gladiator Lug'dol at the tower just up the road and present his head to Kroggol the Wall. That oughta show 'em what you're made of.
english.progress: Nobody gets in da proving grounds unless I say so.
english.completion: If you've killed; Lug'dola, you're definitely in the test arena. $B$BI don't even care if you're gsmall:small; and not ogre.
english.completed: Speak to Kroggol the Wall outside the Gorian Proving Grounds.

text.title: 入场费
text.objectives: 收集$1oa块鲜血之石，并把它们交给巨魔仆从伍迪。
text.description: 你要找鲜血竞技场？哈哈！真有抱负。可不是随便什么人都能进去比试的。你得交入场费才行：50个鲜血印记。$B$B你问鲜血印记要怎么获得？噢，小不点，你可真无知！$B$B<克罗戈尔给了你一枚沾满鲜血的小石块。>$B$B这块是你的了。击败试练场中的对手来收集剩下的印记。完成后，把它们交给穆戈尔身边的巨魔仆从伍迪。$B$B但不要跟穆戈尔说话。他是头儿。
text.progress: Don't be wastin' my time, $R. What business do you be havin' with Mogor?
text.completion: You? Fightin' ta be da Blood Champion? Hmm.
text.completed: Speak to Wodin the Troll Servant in the Ring of Blood.

english.title: Entry Fee
english.objectives: Gather $1oa Blood Stones and bring them to Wodin the Troll Servant.
english.description: You looking for da Ring of Blood? HAH! That good one. Not just anybody able to compete in da ring. You gotta pay the entry fee: fifty blood marks.$B$BHow do you get them? Oh, tiny one, you killing me!$B$B<Kroggol hands you a small stone caked in blood.>$B$BDat one is yours. You kill others in da proving grounds to get da rest. Take dem to Wodin da troll servant by Mogor when you done.$B$BDon't talk to Mogor, though. Mogor da boss.
english.progress: Don't be wastin' my time, $R. What business do you be havin' with Mogor?
english.completion: You? Fightin' ta be da Blood Champion? Hmm.
english.completed: Speak to Wodin the Troll Servant in the Ring of Blood.

text.title: 鲜血勇士
text.objectives: 与古尔戈索克交谈来参加鲜血勇士的对决。
text.description: 你拿到了证明你价值的鲜血之石。嗯。很好，你或许正是穆戈尔要找的勇士。$B$B迄今为止只有两个人通过了鲜血之石的试炼，你就是其中一个。你们俩将为争夺鲜血勇士的殊荣而战。$B$B去找古尔戈索克谈一谈，让我们见证下你能不能当得起勇士的名号……还是只会在竞技场的地面上留下一滩血污。
text.completion: You did it, mon! I never thought I'd be seein' such a fight!
text.completed: Return to Wodin the Troll Servant at the Ring of Blood.

english.title: The Champion of Blood
english.objectives: Speak to Gurgthock to participate in the Blood Champion fight.
english.description: You have da blood stones required as proof of your worth. Hmm. Yes, you might be da champion Mogor be lookin' for.$B$BYou be one of only two to complete da blood stone trial. Da two of ya be fightin' for da glory of becoming Blood Champion.$B$BSpeak to Gurgthock and we be seein' if you be a champion... or just another stain on da arena floor.
english.completion: You did it, mon! I never thought I'd be seein' such a fight!
english.completed: Return to Wodin the Troll Servant at the Ring of Blood.

text.title: 孤身上路
text.objectives: 找到图卡玛下士，并获得他的情报。
text.description: 独眼魔掌握着对钢铁部落来说至关重要的东西。我相信他们还没意识到，可能只是觉得无聊，随便折腾点什么打发时间。$b$b我们完全可以任由他们自生自灭，但是决不能让这条线索中断。要是走运的话，它能帮我们阻止钢铁部落，以免他们将戈尔隆德最可怕的怪物变成武器。$b$b试着去找到图卡玛下士和他的笔记吧。
text.progress: Again you've done well, friend.
text.completion: We have the notes. Let us see what they reveal about our enemy's strategy.
text.completed: Speak to Rexxar outside Fissure of Fury.

english.title: Leave Every Soldier Behind
english.objectives: Find Corporal Thukmar and recover his intel.
english.description: The ogron possess something of value to the Iron Horde. I am sure they're unaware, likely just bored and in need of something to torture.$b$bWe could simply leave them to their fate, but we should follow up on this clue. With any luck, it will help us stop the Iron Horde from turning Gorgrond's most fearsome creatures into weapons.$b$bTry to find Corporal Thukmar and his notes.
english.progress: Again you've done well, friend.
english.completion: Ну что ж, записи у нас. Посмотрим, что из них удастся узнать о вражеской стратегии.
english.completed: Speak to Rexxar outside Fissure of Fury.

text.title: 勘察阿什兰
text.objectives: 战争之矛的先知玛儿·野蹄想让你去勘察阿什兰的荣耀之路、熔岩采石场、蛮兵高地、毁灭斗兽场和灰槌墓地附近的情况。
text.description: 作为一名先知，我在战争之矛就能看见阿什兰遥远的各个角落。可你得去亲眼看看才行，$n。
text.completion: You have the spirit of a true explorer, $n.
text.completed: Return to Mare Wildrunner in Warspear Outpost.

english.title: Survey Ashran
english.objectives: Farseer Mare Wildrunner in Warspear wants you to explore The Road of Glory, The Molten Quarry, Brute's Rise, The Amphitheater Of Annihilation and The Ashmaul Burial Grounds in Ashran.
english.description: As a Farseer, I can peer into the far corners of Ashran while within Warspear. But you must go forth and see it for yourself, $n.
english.completion: You have the spirit of a real researcher, $n.
english.completed: Return to Mare Wildrunner in Warspear Outpost.

text.title: 荣耀之路
text.objectives: 战争之矛的祖格让你去消灭荣耀之路的5名联盟成员。
text.description: 该死的联盟！<跺脚>必须立刻把他们逐出阿什兰！前往荣耀之路，对联盟赶尽杀绝！$b$b快去！
text.completion: ONLY FIVE? UGH. TAKE THIS REWARD AND GET BACK OUT THERE.
text.completed: Return to Zurge in Warspear Outpost.

english.title: The Road of Glory
english.objectives: Zurge in Warspear wants you to kill 5 members of the Alliance within the Road of Glory.
english.description: THE ALLIANCE! <Stomps feet> THEY NEED TO BE REMOVED FROM ASHRAN IMMEDIATELY! MARCH INTO THE ROAD OF GLORY AND SLAY AS MANY AS YOU CAN! $b$bNOW!
english.completion: ALL FIVE? PFF. TAKE YOUR REWARD AND GO BACK.
english.completed: Return to Zurge in Warspear Outpost.

text.title: 进入荒原
text.objectives: 战争之矛岗哨的祖格要你在主干道以外的地区击败一名联盟成员，并拿回他们的护甲碎片作为证据。
text.description: 你知道比在荣耀之路消灭联盟渣滓更刺激的是什么事吗？$B$B那就是完全不给他们活路。<大笑>$B$B到阿什兰的郊外去，把所有联盟成员通通赶尽杀绝。把他们身上恶心的护甲碎片给我带来作为证明。越血腥越痛快。
text.progress: SHOW ME THE ARMOR SCRAPS!
text.completion: YES... YES! <Takes a deep whiff of the armor scrap> MMMM, ITS FRESH!
text.completed: Return to Zurge in Warspear Outpost.

english.title: Into The Wilderness
english.objectives: Zurge in Warspear Outpost wants you to kill a member of the Alliance outside of the main road and recover a piece of their armor as proof.
english.description: YOU KNOW WHAT'S BETTER THAN KILLING ALLIANCE SCUM IN THE ROAD OF GLORY?$B$BKILLING THEM EVERYWHERE ELSE. <Laughs>$B$BGO INTO THE OUTSKIRTS OF ASHRAN AND SLAY ANY ALLIANCE MEMBER. BRING ME BACK SCRAPS OF THEIR DISGUSTING ARMOR AS PROOF. THE BLOODIER THE BETTER.
english.progress: SHOW ME THE ARMOR SCRAPS!
english.completion: YES YES! <Sniffs armor parts> MM-M ... BLOOD! FRESH!
english.completed: Return to Zurge in Warspear Outpost.

text.title: Nagrand - Vignette Boss - Mr. Pinchy Sr.

english.title: Nagrand - Vignette Boss - Mr. Pinchy Sr.

text.title: 不安的灵魂
text.objectives: 消灭残酷的库格图克，并用瓦鲁克的锤子从雷神兽人手中回收装备。
text.description: 这把锤子曾经是用来为我的霜狼兄弟姐妹们打造威风的武器。$B$B当我被雷神氏族抓为俘虏时，我拒绝使用它。我怎么能帮敌人铸造武器，让他们拿来对付我自己的族人呢？$B$B眼睁睁地看着这把锤子落到恶人手中，损坏得面目全非，我的内心感到非常难过。$B$B希望有一天，我能把它传给库格拉，可现在她却愤怒得连来坟墓祭拜我都不肯。$B$B拜托了，$p，你能帮我修好锤子，并向那些造成今日悲惨结局的人复仇吗？$B$B为了库格拉……
text.progress: So, it is done?
text.completion: $n, thank you for avenging my death.
text.completed: Return to Waruk the Frostforger below Stonefang Outpost.

english.title: The Restless Spirit
english.objectives: Slay Kurgthuk the Merciless and use Waruk's hammer to salvage equipment from the Thunderlord orcs.
english.description: This hammer was once used to craft magnificent weapons for my Frostwolf brothers and sisters.$B$BWhen I was taken prisoner by the Thunderlords, however, I refused to wield it. How could I craft weapons to be used against my own people?$B$BIt saddens me to see that it has been damaged and abused.$B$BI wished to one day pass it down to Kugra, but now, her anger prevents her from even visiting my grave.$B$BPlease $p, can you help me repair my hammer and seek revenge on those that caused this?$B$BFor Kugra....
english.progress: So, it is done?
english.completion: $n, thank you for avenging my death.
english.completed: Return to Waruk the Frostforger below Stonefang Outpost.

objectiveDetails.description: 取得库格图克的监视器
取得回收的德拉诺金属

text.title: 裁缝秘典
text.objectives: 到你的要塞中找艾伦谈谈。
text.description: 这本书卷的不同章节分别描述了与传统方法相比，独具一格的纺织技巧。$b$b翻遍书卷也没有找到作者的名字。也许你要塞中有人对这本书的出处有更深的了解。
text.progress: What have you there, child?
text.completion: It seems that you have found a very special tailoring book.$B$BIt belongs to Ameeka, a tailor of great renown from Embaari Village.

english.title: The Cryptic Tome of Tailoring
english.objectives: Speak to Aerun in your garrison.
english.description: The different sections of the tome describe tailoring techniques that seem strange compared to traditional methods.$b$bThe author's name does not appear anywhere in the tome. Maybe someone in your garrison knows more about the book's origins.
english.progress: What have you there, child?
english.completion: Кажется, вам досталась особенная портновская книга.$B$BОна принадлежит Амике, лучшей портнихе в деревне Эмбаари.

text.title: 解开心结
text.objectives: 到岩牙岗哨找瓦鲁克。
text.description: $p，谢谢你为我报了仇……可我还要请你帮个忙。$B$B如果你能帮我做成这件事，我将永远不会忘记你的恩情。$B$B拿上这些东西，到岩牙岗哨的熔炉那找我。$B$B我将自己的一部分精华灌注到了这些东西里面，可我们还需要找别人帮忙来熔铸锤子。$B$B现在到了跟库格拉言归于好的时候了，只有那样我们两个才都能得到安宁……
text.progress: My father... but, how did you....
text.completion: This entire time... I have been so consumed with my own grief.$B$BI never once stopped to consider how much my father was suffering at the hands of our enemies.$B$BThank you so much, $C, for helping him to return to me. Please, allow me to repair his hammer.$B$BIn exchange for everything you have done for us, I will teach you whatever you wish to know.

english.title: Mending A Broken Heart
english.objectives: Meet Waruk at Stonefang Outpost.
english.description: $p, thank you for avenging my death... but I have just one more favor to ask of you.$B$BIf you help me see this through, I will forever be in your debt.$B$BTake these items and meet me at the forge in Stonefang Outpost.$B$BI have imbued them with a portion of my essence, but we still need the aid of another to reforge the hammer.$B$BIt is time for me to reconcile with Kugra, so that we both may finally find peace....
english.progress: My father... but, how did you....
english.completion: This entire time... I have been so consumed with my own grief.$B$BI never once stopped to consider how much my father was suffering at the hands of our enemies.$B$BThank you so much, $C, for helping him to return to me. Please, allow me to repair his hammer.$B$BIn exchange for everything you have done for us, I will teach you whatever you wish to know.

text.title: 神秘的背包
text.objectives: 找到背包的主人。
text.description: 一个空背包，笼罩着古老的魔法光环。$B$B看上去破旧不堪，内层还残存一些草药和蘑菇残渣。也许探索黯影沼泽会找到线索。
text.completion: Oh, my. One of my satchels! Where did you find this? I lost it weeks ago.$B$BI've been so busy training I forgot to collect herbs for Master Ardule. I need your help $n, if you are willing, but I must warn you - the herbs can be quite dangerous!$B$BHand me the satchel and I'll restore the protective inscription to guard you from harmful toxins.

english.title: A Mysterious Satchel
english.objectives: Find the satchel's owner.
english.description: An empty satchel with an old, magical aura.$B$BIt appears quite dilapidated, with remnants of herbs and mushrooms along the inner lining. Perhaps exploring Umbrafen will offer a clue.
english.completion: Oh, my. One of my satchels! Where did you find this? I lost it weeks ago.$B$BI've been so busy training I forgot to collect herbs for Master Ardule. I need your help $n, if you are willing, but I must warn you - the herbs can be quite dangerous!$B$BHand me the satchel and I'll restore the protective inscription to guard you from harmful toxins.

text.title: 蓄力猛击
text.objectives: 收集草药，并回去交给莎拉。
text.description: 好极了！$B$B等你从当地采集到足够的草药后，就把它们交给我，我会为阿杜尔大师制造墨水。$B$B在孢子蝠和巨人身上应该有你要找的东西。$B$B切记，千万要多加小心！
text.progress: Ah, these are just what I was looking for!
text.completion: That was fast, $n! And such a generous delivery!$B$BI've secured the ink in a vial for you, but please be careful.
text.completed: Return to Sha'la at the Rangari Enclave.

english.title: Slow and Steady
english.objectives: Gather the herbs and return to Sha'la.
english.description: Excellent!$B$BWhen you've collected enough herbs from the local wildlife, return to me and I'll craft them into an ink for Master Ardule.$B$BThe sporebats and giants should have what you're looking for.$B$BAnd remember, be careful!
english.progress: Ah, these are just what I was looking for!
english.completion: That was fast, $n! And such a generous delivery!$B$BI've secured the ink in a vial for you, but please be careful.
english.completed: Return to Sha'la at the Rangari Enclave.

text.title: 传承的力量
text.objectives: 把墨水交给阿杜尔大师。
text.description: 这瓶墨水对我的族人无比珍贵。它能让古老的文字留存千古。$B$B阿杜尔大师可以为你作进一步解释。他就在里边。
text.completion: My, $n. Your delivery...$B$BI don't know how to thank you enough.$B$BThis is a substantial amount of ink. You've helped ensure our history for generations to come.$B$BPerhaps I can repay you with a taste of the very knowledge you've helped preserve?
text.completed: 到游侠飞地找阿杜尔大师。

english.title: The Power of Preservation
english.objectives: Deliver the ink to Master Ardule.
english.description: The ink is very precious to our people. It has the ability to preserve ancient texts.$B$BMaster Ardule can explain further. He's just inside.
english.completion: My, $n. Your delivery...$B$BI don't know how to thank you enough.$B$BThis is a substantial amount of ink. You've helped ensure our history for generations to come.$B$BPerhaps I can repay you with a taste of the very knowledge you've helped preserve?
english.completed: Visit Master Ardule at the Rengari Enclave.

text.title: 硝烟弥漫之处……
text.objectives: 消灭拉格斯勒·响刃、阿卡萨·炽焰和召火者德雷克。
text.description: 你的要塞遭到了火刃氏族的攻击！$b$b干掉那些指挥攻击的火刃剑圣，然后去向战争大师佐格报告吧。
text.completion: I knew it was only a matter of time before Azuka would make her move.
text.completed: Return to Warmaster Zog in your garrison.

english.title: Where There Is Smoke...
english.objectives: Kill Rag'sla Thunkblade, Akatha Blazeburn, and Drek the Firecaller.
english.description: You garrison is under attack by the Burning Blade!$b$bKill the Burning Blade masters that are leading the assault and report back to Warmaster Zog.
english.completion: I knew it was only a matter of time before Azuka would make her move.
english.completed: Return to Warmaster Zog in your garrison.

text.title: Spires - Treasure 004 - Relics of the Outcasts

english.title: Spires - Treasure 004 - Relics of the Outcasts

text.title: 被偷走的混沌之心
text.objectives: 击败阿祖卡·刃怒。
text.description: 这次入侵的目的显然是夺取高格里克之心。$b$b我们得尽快加固防线，否则就迟了！
text.completion: Azuka's reign of terror continues... we need a new plan.
text.completed: Speak with Warmaster Zog in your garrison at Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: A Stolen Heart
english.objectives: Defeat Azuka Bladefury.
english.description: This invasion is clearly an attempt to seize the Heart of Gorgorek.$b$bWe need to fortify our guard before it's too late!
english.completion: Azuka's reign of terror continues... we need a new plan.
english.completed: Speak with Warmaster Zog in your garrison at Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: Spires - Vignette Boss 002 - Tesska the Broken

english.title: Spires - Vignette Boss 002 - Tesska the Broken

text.title: 悬槌附魔护腕
text.objectives: 把护腕带到你的要塞，交给秘法师尤丽娜。
text.description:
从这些古老的悬槌护腕中散发着强大的魔法之力。

也许你要塞的附魔军需官——秘法师尤丽娜能跟你讲述更多有关这护腕的事。
text.completion: Interesting, an Arakkoa recently visited the garrison looking for an armor piece with a powerful enchantment like this. His name was Delath.$B$BThe enchantment on this bracer is beyond my skill, but perhaps this Delath can give you the necessary insight to replicate it.
text.completed: 在你的要塞与秘法师尤丽娜谈一谈。

english.title: Enchanted Highmaul Bracer
english.objectives: Take the bracer to Yu'rina the Mystic in your Garrison.
english.description:
A powerful enchantment emanates from these ancient Highmaul bracers.

Maybe Yu'rina the Mystic, your garrison enchanting quartermaster, can tell you more about the bracer.
english.completion: Interesting, an Arakkoa recently visited the garrison looking for an armor piece with a powerful enchantment like this. His name was Delath.$B$BThe enchantment on this bracer is beyond my skill, but perhaps this Delath can give you the necessary insight to replicate it.
english.completed: Speak to Yu'rina the Mystic in your garrison.

text.title: 鸦人附魔师
text.objectives: 在北边的龟裂平原边缘地带找到德拉斯。
text.description: 那位鸦人说他要去调查龟裂平原的异常现象，也许跟另外一件护甲部件有关。
text.progress: Greetings Enchanter. I can see you are acquainted with the art. $B$BGood, good. Perhaps you and I can help each other.
text.completion: Do I also detect that you have in your possession an artifact of our land? $B$BCan I see it?$B$BOne of Oru'kai's bracers... Thank you!
text.completed: Speak to Arcanist Delath at the Cracking Plains.

english.title: The Arakkoan Enchanter
english.objectives: Find Delath on the edge of the Cracking Plains to the north.
english.description: The arakkoa said it was going to investigate an anomaly in the Cracking Plains that might be related to another armor piece.
english.progress: Greetings Enchanter. I can see you are acquainted with the art. $B$BGood, good. Perhaps you and I can help each other.
english.completion: Do I also detect that you have in your possession an artifact of our land? $B$BCan I see it?$B$BOne of Oru'kai's bracers... Thank you!
english.completed: Speak to Arcanist Delath at the Cracking Plains.

text.title: 失败的学徒
text.objectives: 找到托拉格，并从他的寒冰牢笼里解救他。
text.description:
奥鲁凯是第一位精通附魔艺术的食人魔法师。他去世后，遗物散落到了德拉诺的各个角落。我在我们面前的旷野里找到了他的权杖。

如你所见，权杖上的附魔效果难以破除。他的一位准学徒——托拉格·石怒抢走了奥鲁凯的一枚戒指，想要打破附魔，结果却失败了，被封在了寒冰之中。

释放托拉格，拿上那枚戒指，完成他的任务，我会考虑给你奖励的。
text.completion: Thank you. I thought I was going to be stuck here forever.
text.completed: Speak to Torag at the Cracking Plains.

english.title: Failed Apprentice
english.objectives: Find and release Torag from his icy prison.
english.description:
Oru'kai was the first ogre mage to master the art of enchanting. Upon his death, his items were scattered across Draenor. I have tracked his scepter to the field you see before us. 

As you can see, the scepter's enchantment is making it difficult to retrieve. A would-be apprentice, Torag Stonefury, took one of Oru'kai's rings in to break the enchantment, but he failed and became trapped in ice. 

Free Torag, take the ring, and complete his task, and I will consider a reward.
english.completion: Thank you. I thought I was going to be stuck here forever.
english.completed: Speak to Torag at the Cracking Plains.

text.title: 奥鲁凯的节杖
text.objectives: 取得奥鲁凯的节杖，交还给德拉斯。
text.description:
要是我知道当个附魔师这么危险的话，我就老老实实留在沃高尔了。

给，拿上这枚戒指吧。那只鸟人跟我说，对着权杖使用这枚戒指，就能消除上面的附魔效果。

把权杖带回去交给他，也许他会愿意把当初承诺传授给我的技艺教给你。
text.progress: Do you have it? Give it to me.
text.completion: Yes... This is it, after so many years. Soon, I will have all of the Armaments of Oru'kai.$B$BReturn my ring as well and I will fulfill the promise I made to that squeamish orc. $B$BTake this book. If you have any skill, you can use it to decipher and learn Draenor's enchantments. $B$BOf course, you will need a proper workplace as well. Here are plans; hopefully you can follow them.$B$BNow, be gone, and steer clear of the other armaments, for they are mine.
text.completed: Speak to Arcanist Delath at the Crackling Plains.

english.title: Oru'kai's Scepter
english.objectives: Retrieve Oru'kai's scepter and return it to Delath.
english.description:
If I had known being an enchanter was this dangerous, I would have stayed in Wor'gol. 

Here, take this ring. The bird man told me to use the ring on the scepter to nullify the enchantment.

Bring the scepter back to him and maybe he will teach you what he promised to teach me.
english.progress: Do you have it? Give it to me.
english.completion: Yes... This is it, after so many years. Soon, I will have all of the Armaments of Oru'kai.$B$BReturn my ring as well and I will fulfill the promise I made to that squeamish orc. $B$BTake this book. If you have any skill, you can use it to decipher and learn Draenor's enchantments. $B$BOf course, you will need a proper workplace as well. Here are plans; hopefully you can follow them.$B$BNow, be gone, and steer clear of the other armaments, for they are mine.
english.completed: Speak to Arcanist Delath at the Crackling Plains.

text.title: 要塞战役：失踪的步兵
text.objectives: 找到杜尔扎克。
text.description: 由于要塞里收藏着高格里克之心，我们必须随时保持警惕。火刃氏族向来以出其不意，来去如风著称。$b$b我派了一群步兵出去巡逻。其中的一位新兵，杜尔扎克本来应该已经回来报到了。
text.completed: Return to Skaggit in your garrions at Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Garrison Campaign: Missing Grunt
english.objectives: Find Dul'zak.
english.description: With the Heart of Gorgorek residing inside the garrison walls, we need to stay vigilant. The Burning Blade are known for attacking swiftly, and without warning.$b$bI have a number of grunts patrolling the keep. Dul'zak, one of our newer recruits, should have reported back by now.
english.completed: Return to Skaggit in your garrions at Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 裁缝大师艾米卡
text.objectives: 在艾洛多尔与艾米卡交谈。
text.description: 艾米卡撰写了这本书，是为了把我们最宝贵的制作技巧记录下来，好传承给我们的孩子们。她肯定是在旅行时把它弄掉了。失而复得，一定会让她感到如释重负。$b$b据其他村民说，她最后一次是出现在通往艾洛多尔的路上。也许你可以去那找她。
text.progress: Hello, traveler! Is there something that I can help you with?
text.completion: Is that my tailoring tome? It is! I'm so glad it is safe! How can I ever repay you?

english.title: Ameeka, Master Tailor
english.objectives: Speak to Ameeka in Elodor.
english.description: Ameeka created this book to document and pass down our most cherished crafting techniques to our children. She must have dropped it while traveling. She will be relieved to see her book.$b$bFrom what I have heard from other villagers, she was last seen on the road to Elodor. Perhaps you can find her there.
english.progress: Hello, traveler! Is there something that I can help you with?
english.completion: Это что, моя портновская книга? Точно! Какое счастье, она цела! Как я могу тебя отблагодарить?

text.title: A Strengthened Bond
text.objectives: Give Axe-Shaper Kugra the Ghost-Touched Materials.
text.description: This entire time... I have been so consumed with my own grief.$B$BI never once stopped to consider how much my father was suffering at the hands of our enemies.$B$BThank you so much $c for helping him to return to me. Please, allow me to repair his hammer.$B$BIn exchange for everything you have done for us, I will teach you whatever you wish to know.

english.title: A Strengthened Bond
english.objectives: Give Axe-Shaper Kugra the Ghost-Touched Materials.
english.description: This entire time... I have been so consumed with my own grief.$B$BI never once stopped to consider how much my father was suffering at the hands of our enemies.$B$BThank you so much $c for helping him to return to me. Please, allow me to repair his hammer.$B$BIn exchange for everything you have done for us, I will teach you whatever you wish to know.

text.title: 偷走他们身上的衣服
text.objectives: 收集10件影月仪式长袍。
text.description: 既然你对我这么好，也许我能再多提一个要求？$b$b在我们的村子里，我们会对旧布料进行回收和再利用，用来给衣服打补丁，或是制作轻型护甲。可惜我的大部分补给品都在不久前的战乱中被抢走或是毁掉了。$b$b要是你能把影月邪教徒自己的物料偷来，他们也许就不敢再来随便偷我们的东西了。$b$b如果你能帮我收集几件影月仪式长袍，我就把我最得意的独门裁缝秘技传授给你。
text.progress: Were you able to get the robes?
text.completion: Again, you show me great kindness.$B$BNow, let us begin.
text.completed: Return to Ameeka at Elodor.

english.title: The Clothes on Their Backs
english.objectives: Collect 10 Ceremonial Shadowmoon Robes.
english.description: Such kindness you have shown me, perhaps I can ask for one more?$b$bIn our village, we salvage and reuse old cloth to patch clothes and light armor. Sadly, most of my supply was taken or destroyed in the recent attacks.$b$bThe Shadowmoon cultists might think twice about stealing from us if you were to relieve them of their own resources.$b$bIf you can collect some ceremonial Shadowmoon robes for me, I will demonstrate some of my favorite tailoring techniques for you.
english.progress: Were you able to get the robes?
english.completion: И вновь ты $gоказал:оказала; мне большую услугу.$b$bНачнем же.
english.completed: Return to Ameeka at Elodor.

text.title: Spires - Vignette Boss 007 - Kalos the Bloodbathed

english.title: Spires - Vignette Boss 007 - Kalos the Bloodbathed

text.title: 妖纹布
text.objectives: 用艾米卡的捕蝇草汁液，制造一些妖纹布。
text.description: 我现在要教你制作妖纹布的微妙之处。$b$b过程其实相当简单。只要小心地将毛织布放到戈尔隆德捕蝇草汁液中浸泡就可以了。$b$b通常你需要自己去采集这种汁液，不过我在影月兽人上一次突袭时设法弄到了一些。$b$b欢迎你随意取用。
text.completion: This is perfect! The cloth and magic are perfectly balanced and stable.$B$BI am happy to say that you have learned the basics of my tailoring methods. I respect your skill and your eagerness to learn new techniques.$B$BLet me give you some other patterns and materials that I hope you find useful during your journey.
text.completed: Return to Ameeka at Elodor.

english.title: Hexcloth
english.objectives: Use Ameeka's Flytrap Ichor to create a Swatch of Hexweave.
english.description: I shall now impart to you the finer points of creating hexcloth.$b$bThe process is quite simple. It involves immersing carefully woven fur into the ichor drawn from Gorgrond Flytraps.$b$bNormally, you would need to harvest it yourself, but I actually managed to liberate some from the Shadowmoon during their last raid.$b$bYou are welcome to use it.
english.completion:
Превосходно! Ткань и магия идеально сбалансированы и стабильны.

Рада признать, что ты $gовладел:овладела; основами моего портновского искусства. Я восхищаюсь твоим мастерством и неутомимым желанием учиться чему-то новому.

Давай я дам тебе еще несколько отрезов и материалов. Надеюсь, они пригодятся тебе в путешествии.
english.completed: Return to Ameeka at Elodor.

text.title: 捕猎游戏
text.objectives: 在影月谷里使用钢铁陷阱捕捉一只雷象或塔布羊，然后在你的畜棚里下达一份产品订单。
text.description: 当我们穿过传送门时，没能带上任何动物。要想生产皮革和毛皮，就得用陷阱诱捕一些当地的野兽，并把它们带到这儿来。$B$B在影月谷里，我们可以从雷象身上弄到皮革，或是从塔布羊身上取得毛皮。$B$B拿上这个钢铁陷阱，对着受伤的成年塔布羊或雷象使用它，然后把陷阱带回来，我们就能开始完成产品订单了。
text.completion: Great job, commander! We'll have your leather or fur ready in no time.$B$BNow that you know how to use the trap, it will be available for your use at any time. We can only handle so many beasts in the barn at one time, though, so make sure you've got room before you start trapping!
text.completed: Return to Homer Stonefield at your garrison.

english.title: Breaking into the Trap Game
english.objectives: Use the Iron Trap to capture an Elekk or Talbuk in Shadowmoon Valley and then place a Work Order at your Barn.
english.description: When we came through the portal, we weren't able to bring any of our animals with us. For us to produce leather and furs, we'll need to trap some of the native beasts and bring them back here.$B$BWe can get a load of leather from the elekk, or furs from the talbuk, right here in Shadowmoon.$B$BTake this iron trap and use it on a wounded adult talbuk or elekk, then bring the trap on back here and we'll start a work order.
english.completion: Great, commander! Before you know it, we'll have your skin or fur ready for you. Now that you know how to use the trap, you can hunt with it whenever you want. Really, our stable isn't rubber, so before you catch any new creatures, make sure there's room!
english.completed: Return to Homer Stonefield at your garrison.

text.title: 喂饱一支军队
text.objectives: 在戈尔隆德使用强化钢铁陷阱捕捉一只野猪或淡水兽，然后在你的畜棚里下达一份产品订单。
text.description: 我们已经跟这些野兽打了一阵子交道了，于是研发出了一款全新的陷阱，供你试用。它比原先那种应该要结实得多！$B$B想不想去试试看呢，指挥官？强化钢铁陷阱可以让你捕捉到一些肥壮多肉的野兽，比如说戈尔隆德的巨大野猪和淡水兽。我们能用它们的肉烹制出美味的肉排。
text.completion: Great work, commander! We'll get to grillin' up those steaks right away. I can already smell them!
text.completed: Return to Homer Stonefield at your garrison.

english.title: Feeding An Army
english.objectives: Use the Improved Iron Trap to capture a Boar or Riverbeast in Gorgrond and then place a Work Order at your Barn.
english.description: We've had a chance to work with these beasts for a while now, and that's allowed us to develop a brand-new trap for you to try out. It should be much sturdier than the last one!$B$BMind giving 'er a run, commander? The Improved Iron Trap will let you capture some of the meatiest wildlife, like the big boars and riverbeasts out in Gorgrond. We'll be able to turn them into some tasty steaks.
english.completion: Great work, commander! We'll get to grillin' up those steaks right away. I can already smell them!
english.completed: Return to Homer Stonefield at your garrison.

text.title: 恼人的杂草
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个怨叶魔荚人。
text.description: 必须对怨叶林地中的魔荚人采取行动了！$b$b我跟赫米特·奈辛瓦里一起在各地捕猎过一些最大最凶猛的野兽。可却从来也没遇见过像魔荚人这么邪恶，这么卑鄙，这么无耻，这么堕落的家伙！$b$b这种恶毒的小怪物犹如野草般到处蔓延，如果不赶快出手制止的话，它们将会遍布整个大陆！$b$b到怨叶林地里去把你见到的所有魔荚人全部消灭掉吧！
text.completion: Great work, $n.$b$bI'm surprised we made it out of Spiteleaf Thicket alive! I can still hear the sound of their maniacal laughter as they swarmed us....

english.title: Whacking Weeds
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Spiteleaf podlings.
english.description: Something needs to be done about the podling menace in Spiteleaf Thicket!$b$bAlongside Hemet Nesingwary, I've hunted some of the largest and most terrifying beasts around. Never in my life have I encountered a creature as vile, depraved, nefarious or degenerate as a podling!$b$bThe vicious little monsters spread themselves like weeds and if something isn't done, they'll spread across the entire continent!$b$bMake your way into Spiteleaf Thicket and slay as many podlings as you can find!
english.completion: Great work, $n.$b$bI'm surprised we made it out of Spiteleaf Thicket alive! I can still hear the sound of their maniacal laughter as they swarmed us....

text.title: 更大的陷阱，更好的奖励
text.objectives: 使用致命的钢铁陷阱捕捉一只铁皮公牛、恐牙头狼或湿地践踏者。
text.description: 好消息，指挥官！有了我们在德拉诺采集到的材料，就能制造出一个足够结实的陷阱，哪怕最强大的野兽一旦被困住也动弹不得！$B$B你为什么不去纳格兰试试看呢？听说在西部平原上水晶湖的这一侧住着一些最为庞大的野兽。$B$B但我要事先警告你，这些野兽很难对付。你也许需要叫上几个朋友一同前往。
text.completion: That must have been quite a fight, commander!$B$BThe materials we obtain from beasts of this magnitude will last us for quite a while.
text.completed: Return to Homer Stonefield at your garrison.

english.title: Bigger Trap, Better Rewards
english.objectives: Use the Deadly Iron Trap to capture an Ironhide Bull, Direfang Alpha, or Wetland Trampler.
english.description: Good news, commander! With the materials we've gathered here in Draenor, we've been able to construct a trap strong enough to immobilize even the mightiest beast!$B$BWhy don't you head on out to Nagrand and give it a try? Word has it that the western plains are home to some of the most magnificent beasts this side of Crystal Lake.$B$BI'm going to warn you, though, these beasts are tough. You may want to bring some friends along.
english.completion: That must have been quite a fight, commander!$B$BThe materials we obtain from beasts of this magnitude will last us for quite a while.
english.completed: Return to Homer Stonefield at your garrison.

objectiveDetails.description: 下达一份大额产品订单

text.title: 寻找研究物资
text.objectives: 帮哈德利·里卡德博士找回研究日志、远征队补给品和抗菌长靴。
text.description: 我的研究笔记不见了！$b$b肯定是在魔荚人攻击研究站的时候给遗失了。要是找不回那些笔记，我所有的心血都将付之东流！$b$b想到这，我发现我还弄丢了我的远征队补给袋和抗菌长靴……$b$b少了这些设备我该怎么进行生物研究啊？！$b$b不……这绝对不行。$b$b拜托了，去赞加海岸找找我丢失的物品，好让我能继续开展真菌研究工作！
text.progress: Have you retrieved my missing belongings?
text.completion: Ah! I see you have my research with you... and what's this? You also have my supply bag and the anti-fungal boots!$b$bSpectacular! I now have the tools I need to continue my research into the Zangar fungal strain....
text.completed: Return to Dr. Hadley Ricard.

All of my work will be lost if they are not found!$b$bCome to think of it, I'm also missing my expedition supply bag, as well as my anti-fungal boots....$b$bHow can I do biological research without my equipment?!$b$bNo... this will not do at all.$b$bPlease, go and search the Zangar Shore for my missing belongings so that I may continue my fungal research!

text.title: 要塞战役：鲜血竞技场
text.objectives: 在纳格兰古尔戈索克的秘巢与古尔戈索克谈一谈。
text.description: 你好啊，勇士，$B$B我路过时你刚好外出了。我在纳格兰的鲜血竞技场准备了一场巅峰对决。好多食人魔都在等着下一场大战呢。大笔大笔的赏金啊。你要来吗？$B$B你在不久前刚刚在试炼竞技场里大显身手，为拳拳到肉赋予了新的定义，对吧？这可是你攀登荣誉巅峰的第二步！你必须来亮个相。$B$B我会在我的秘巢等你，在你隆重登场前，我们私下先好好聊聊。$B$B<面前有一张地图，在一座废弃的食人魔高塔所在的位置上画出了一个钱币的标志。>
text.completion: I won't waste your time, champ. I've got a once in a lifetime opportunity for you.
text.completed: Speak to Gurgthock at Gurgthock's Stash in Nagrand.

english.objectives: Speak to Gurgthock at Gurgthock's Stash in Nagrand.

You in?$B$BYou're the one that brought a new meaning to pain at the Ring of Trials not too long ago, right? This is the next step in your climb to fame! You've gotta get down here.$B$BI'll meet you at my stash so we can talk a bit in private before your big debut.$B$B<A map is included with a dollar sign scrawled on an abandoned ogre tower.>

text.title: 迷人的菌类
text.objectives: 收集$1oa个菌类孢子。
text.description: 在赞加海岸上住着不少特殊的菌类，其中一些跟我们在故乡艾泽拉斯见到的十分类似。然而，有一种尤为引人注意！$b$b鉴于它在德拉诺菌类生态系统中的普遍性，我管它叫“赞加属德拉诺菌类”。这种特殊的菌类适应性极强，在赞加海岸的多种活体生物身上都能生存。$b$b它为什么会存在呢？究竟有些什么特性？$b$b为了搞懂这些问题，我需要更多的孢子样本。
text.progress: Have you collected the spore samples for my research?
text.completion: You have the spore samples for my research! Excellent!$b$bThe Zangar Shore is a dangerous place... what with the risk of fungal mutation and all.$b$bOh... I didn't mention that part before? I was sure I did!$b$bNo matter! You look hardy enough, I'm sure your genes are impervious to foreign fungal strains that your body has never before encountered!
text.completed: Return to Dr. Hadley Ricard.

english.title: A Fascinating Fungus
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Fungal Spores.
english.description: The Zangar Shore is home to many peculiar strains of fungi, some of which are similar to those of our native Azeroth. However, one strain in particular is most fascinating!$b$bI call it "Zangarium Draenormycota," due to its prevelance in Draenor's fungal ecosystem. This unique strain of fungus is highly adaptable and can be found on many of the living organisms throughout Zangar Shore.$b$bWhy does it exist? What properties does it hold?$b$bTo answer these questions, I will need additional spore samples.
english.progress: Have you collected the spore samples for my research?
english.completion: You have the spore samples for my research! Excellent!$b$bThe Zangar Shore is a dangerous place... what with the risk of fungal mutation and all.$b$bOh... I didn't mention that part before? I was sure I did!$b$bNo matter! You look hardy enough, I'm sure your genes are impervious to foreign fungal strains that your body has never before encountered!
english.completed: Return to Dr. Hadley Ricard.

text.title: 戴格米尔
text.objectives: 从戴格米尔身上取得真菌组织。
text.description: 为了彻底弄清楚“赞加属德拉诺菌类”的本质和特性，我需要在复杂的真菌结构环境下仔细检视这种真菌。孢子巨人的真菌组织再合适不过了。$b$b但并非什么孢子巨人都行，必须得是巨大的……邪恶的……原始的……完美标本！$b$b在下方深处有个洞穴，里面住着一个古老的孢子巨人，当地人惊惧地将它称作戴格米尔。去干掉那个怪物，千万要小心保管它的真菌组织，供我们进行研究！
text.progress: Without a fungal brain to examine, the mysteries of the Zangar ecosystem will remain unsolved!
text.completion: I see you've retrieved Dirgemire's fungal brain!$b$bNot only is the fungal structure perfectly intact, as a specimen it is exquisite! I will need only a moment to begin the examination...
text.completed: Return to Dr. Hadley Ricard.
text.giverWindow: 我们必须获得真菌组织！

english.title: Dirgemire
english.objectives: Retrieve the Fungal Brain from Dirgemire.
english.description: In order to fully understand the nature and properties of the Zangarium Draenormycota, I need to examine the strain within a complex fungal structure. The fungal brain of a spore giant would do nicely.$b$bNot just any spore giant will serve though, it needs to be big... mean... primordial... the perfect specimen!$b$bIn a cavern deep below the surface is an ancient spore giant the locals fearfully refer to as Dirgemire. Slay the monster, but be sure to carefully preserve the fungal brain for our research!
english.progress: Without a fungal brain to examine, the mysteries of the Zangar ecosystem will remain unsolved!
english.completion: I see you've retrieved Dirgemire's fungal brain!$b$bNot only is the fungal structure perfectly intact, as a specimen it is exquisite! I will need only a moment to begin the examination...

What do we have here, commander?$B$B<Inspecting the transponder.>$B$BA little damaged, slightly bent and burnt to a crisp, but this is my lucky day!$B$BWe've been testing a new device and this transponder carries invaluable information! text.objectives: 在海滩上寻找可回收的零件。
text.description: 我们把传送器里的所有数据都提取并绘制成了地图！现在我们的方位分析器已经完成！$B$B只需要再找来几个零件，就可以开始真正的测试了。$B$B我听一位飞行员说起过，他在海岸边看见过一艘搁浅的钢铁部落舰船。如果你能回收一些零件，我们也许就能让这东西工作起来了！
text.progress: Don't worry. We're just borrowing these from the Iron Horde!
text.completion: Those supplies were just what I needed! I think I'm finally figuring out how to work with all these Draenor parts. I'd be happy to show you, commander. I should be able to fix it in a jiffy.$B$BOh... and remember, deep breaths!

If you can salvage some parts we may just be able to get this thing up and running!

text.objectives: 在南边的遗忘海滩上找到德拉斯。
text.description: 那位鸦人说他要去调查遗忘海滩的异常现象，也许跟另外一件护甲部件有关。
text.progress: Greetings Enchanter. I can see you are acquainted with the art. $B$BGood, good. Perhaps you and I can help each other.
text.completion: Do I also detect that you have in your possession an artifact of our land? $B$BCan I see it?$B$BOne of Oru'kai's bracers... Thank you!

english.title: The Arakkoan Enchanter
english.objectives: Find Delath on the Forgotten Shore to the south.
english.description: The arakkoa said it was going to investigate an anomaly along the Forgotten Shore that might be related to another armor piece.
english.progress: Greetings Enchanter. I can see you are acquainted with the art. $B$BGood, good. Perhaps you and I can help each other.
english.completion:
Я не ошибаюсь, у тебя в руках артефакт наших земель? 

Позволь мне взглянуть на него.

Один из браслетов Ору'кая… Благодарю!

text.title: 父与子
text.objectives: 找到哈菲斯特的儿子。
text.description: 求你找找我的孩子！$B$B在那群强盗袭来之前，我们正在东北边的山上。$B$B他们人数并不多，可我只是个铁匠，不是战士！$B$B我让我唯一的孩子失望了吗？
text.completion: My boy!$B$B<A tear falls down his cheek, clearing a path down to the skin where soot once rested.>$B$BYou... no words can explain how grateful I am.$B$BI can only repay what I have to offer, which isn't much in terms of valued goods. Most of my work goes straight to our soldiers. I do, however, carry the wisdom of my people and my craft.$B$BIt would be an honor if you allowed me to share some of this wisdom with you.$B$BMay the light guide you, $n.

english.title: Father and Son
english.objectives: Find Haephest's son.
english.description: Please find my boy!$B$BBefore the looters came we were on the hill just northeast of here.$B$BThere weren't many of them, but I'm a blacksmith, not a fighter!$B$BHave I let my only son down?
english.completion: My boy!$B$B<A tear falls down his cheek, clearing a path down to the skin where soot once rested.>$B$BYou... no words can explain how grateful I am.$B$BI can only repay what I have to offer, which isn't much in terms of valued goods. Most of my work goes straight to our soldiers. I do, however, carry the wisdom of my people and my craft.$B$BIt would be an honor if you allowed me to share some of this wisdom with you.$B$BMay the light guide you, $n.

text.title: 失败的学徒
text.objectives: 找到蒂玛，并把她从时光牢笼里救出来。
text.description:
奥鲁凯是德拉诺首个精通附魔之道的食人魔法师。他死后，他的物品散落在了德拉诺各处。我追踪他的法杖来到了我们面前的这片海滩。

如你所见，法杖上的附魔效果使我们难以得到它。有位名叫蒂玛的准学徒试着用奥鲁凯的一枚指环去打破附魔，结果自己也因失败而被困住了。

去找到并解救蒂玛，拿到指环，完成她的任务，然后我会考虑给你奖励的。
text.completion: Thank you. I thought I was going to be stuck here forever.
text.completed: Speak to Deema at the Forgotten Shore.

english.title: Failed Apprentice
english.objectives: Find and release Deema from her time prison.
english.description:
Oru'kai was the first ogre mage to master the art of enchanting on Draenor. Upon his death, his items were scattered across Draenor. I have tracked his staff to the shore you see before us. 

As you can see, the staff's enchantment is making it difficult to retrieve. A would-be apprentice, Deema, took one of Oru'kai's rings in to break the enchantment, but she failed and became trapped as well. 

Find and free Deema, take the ring, complete her task, and I will consider a reward.
english.completion: Спасибо тебе. Я думала, что застряла здесь навсегда.
english.completed: Speak to Deema at the Forgotten Shore.

text.title: 精致的吊坠
text.objectives: 在你的要塞里四下打听，看看有没有人能认出这个吊坠。
text.description: 在这枚吊坠中镶嵌的深红色宝石是你前所未见的上品，宝石周围精心环绕着一圈金银丝，工艺精巧至极。$B$B你从制作这件吊坠的工匠身上一定能学到很多本领。也许你要塞中有人能认出这件作品。
text.progress: Why hello $n, what do we have here?
text.completion: Please, allow me to take a closer look.

english.title: The Intricate Pendant
english.objectives: Ask around your garrison to see if anyone recognizes the pendant.
english.description: The crimson gem used in this pendant is unlike any you've seen before, and the filigree wrapped around it is masterfully crafted.$B$BThere's likely to be much you can learn from the person who made this. Perhaps someone at your garrison will recognize the work.
english.progress: Why hello $n, what do we have here?
english.completion: Please, allow me to take a closer look.

text.title: 奥鲁凯的法杖
text.objectives: 取得奥鲁凯的法杖，交还给德拉斯。
text.description:
要是我知道当个附魔师这么危险的话，我就老老实实留在沙塔斯了。

给，拿上这枚戒指吧。那只鸦人跟我说，对着法杖使用这枚戒指，就能消除上面的附魔效果。

把权杖带回去交给他，也许他会愿意把当初承诺传授给我的技艺教给你。
text.progress: The staff! Give it to me!
text.completion: Yes... This is it, after so many years. Soon, I will have all of the Armaments of Oru'kai.$B$BReturn my ring as well and I will fulfill the promise I made to that squeamish draenei. $B$BTake this book. If you have any skill, you can use it to decipher and learn Draenor's enchantments. $B$BOf course, you will need a proper workplace as well. Here are plans; hopefully you can follow them.$B$BNow, be gone, and steer clear of the other armaments, for they are mine.
text.completed: Speak to Arcanist Delath at the Forgotten Shore.

english.title: Oru'kai's Staff
english.objectives: Retrieve Oru'kai's staff and return it to Delath.
english.description:
If I had known being an enchanter was this dangerous, I would have stayed in Shattrath. 

Here, take this ring. The arakkoa told me to use the ring on the staff to nullify the enchantment.

Bring the scepter back to him and maybe he will teach you what he promised to teach me.
english.progress: The staff! Give it to me!
english.completion:
О да, наконец-то. После стольких лет! Скоро я соберу все артефакты Ору'кая.

Верни мое кольцо, и я исполню обещание, данное этой привередливой дренейке. 

Возьми эту книгу. Если ты хоть что-нибудь умеешь, то она поможет тебе расшифровывать и изучить чары Дренора. 

Тебе также понадобится подходящее рабочее место. Вот чертежи, надеюсь, ты в состоянии следовать им.

А теперь исчезни. И держись подальше от остального оружия – оно мое.
english.completed: Speak to Arcanist Delath at the Forgotten Shore.

text.title: 胜利在望
text.objectives: 在通天峰副本里消灭兰吉特、阿拉卡纳斯和高阶贤者维里克斯。
text.description: 我们给信徒造成了沉重打击，可战斗还远未结束。$B$B集结你的同伴，准备对通天峰发起最后的总攻吧！$B$B“暗影蔽日，渡鸦吞天。$B$B黑翼遮云，天火湮灭。$B$B安歇吧，我的孩子，安歇吧。就连烈日也要安歇。”$B$B这是鲁克玛的摇篮曲，是她唱给最初的鸦人听的。天哪，我们居然迷失到了如此地步。
text.completion: Perhaps there is now hope for a brighter future. I can only hope some of those in Skyreach have been awakened.
text.completed: Return to Reshad in Veil Terokk.

english.title: Victory is Within Reach
english.objectives: Slay Ranjit, Araknath, Rukhran and High Sage Viryx in the Skyreach dungeon.
english.description: We have dealt a crippling blow to the Adherents, but our fight is not yet finished.$B$BGather your allies and prepare for the final siege on Skyreach!$B$B"Shadows gather when the raven swallows the day.$B$BBurning sky is extinguished as black wings fold gently about the heavens.$B$BRest, my children, rest. For even the sun must sleep."$B$BThis was Rukhmar's lullaby, sung by her to the first arakkoa. My, how we've lost our way.
english.completion: There may now be hope for a brighter future. I can only hope that some of the people in the Celestial Way have come to their senses.
english.completed: Return to Reshad in Veil Terokk.

text.title: 原始狂怒
text.objectives: 在塔拉多的塔纳安之门外与伯德里克·格雷碰面，然后击败高格里克和督军阿祖卡·刃怒。
text.description: 看来情况是这样的，指挥官。$B$B我们必须不惜一切代价阻止钢铁部落。我已经派出了风暴乌鸦前往你的要塞，并让伯德里克·格雷立即将你的军队部署到塔纳安之门。$B$B等你抵达塔拉多北部时，他应该已经率领一整支大军在那等你了……$B$B没时间了，赶快行动。
text.completion: Your feats seem to know no limits, $n. Today, our garrison forces have struck a terrible blow to Warchief Hellscream and the Iron Horde.$B$BHowever, he is not defeated so easily. If anything, his hunger for vengeance will grow.$B$BWe must destroy the root of his operations in Tanaan Jungle, but first, there is much preparation to be done.$B$BUntil then, bask in the glow of our momentous victory.
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant Thorn at your garrison.

english.title: Primal Fury
english.objectives: Meet Bodrick Grey near the Gates of Tanaan in Talador, then defeat Gorgorek and Warlord Azuka Bladefury.
english.description: It looks like this is it, commander.$B$BWe must stop the Iron Horde at all costs. I have sent stormcrows to your garrison, and called for Bodrick Grey to deploy your troops to the Gates of Tanaan at once.$B$BBy the time you get to northern Talador, he should be waiting for you... with an entire army.$B$BThere is no time to delay.
english.completion: Your feats seem to know no limits, $n. Today, our garrison forces have struck a terrible blow to Warchief Hellscream and the Iron Horde.$B$BHowever, he is not defeated so easily. If anything, his hunger for vengeance will grow.$B$BWe must destroy the root of his operations in Tanaan Jungle, but first, there is much preparation to be done.$B$BUntil then, bask in the glow of our momentous victory.
english.completed: Return to Lieutenant Thorn at your garrison.
