text.title: 喂饱一支军队
text.objectives: 在戈尔隆德使用强化钢铁陷阱捕捉一只野猪或淡水兽，然后在你的畜棚里下达一份产品订单。
text.description: 我们已经跟这些野兽打了一阵子交道了，于是研发出了一款全新的陷阱，供你试用。它比原先那种应该要结实得多。$B$B强化钢铁陷阱可以让你捕捉到德拉诺最为肥壮多肉的野兽。你在戈尔隆德随便抓一只淡水兽或野猪，就能喂饱我们许多士兵的肚子了。$B$B捉住之后把它带回来，我们将为你烹制一顿野味大餐。
text.completion: Ah, so the trap held! I can smell the meat already. This will make a great feast for our warriors!
text.completed: Return to Farmer Lok'lub at your garrison.

english.title: Feeding An Army
english.objectives: Use the Improved Iron Trap to capture a Boar or Riverbeast in Gorgrond and then place a Work Order at your Barn.
english.description: We've had a chance to work with these beasts for a while now, and that's allowed us to develop a brand-new trap for you to try out. It should be much sturdier than the last one.$B$BThe Improved Iron Trap will let you capture some of the meatiest beasts on Draenor. You will find that a single riverbeast or boar from Gorgrond can feed many warriors.$B$BTrap one and bring it back, and we will cook you a savage meal.
english.completion: Ловушка выдержала! Уже чувствую запах мяса. Отличный будет пир для наших воинов!
english.completed: Return to Farmer Lok'lub at your garrison.

text.title: 捕猎游戏
text.objectives: 在霜火岭使用钢铁陷阱捕捉一只裂蹄牛或狼，然后在你的畜棚里下达一份产品订单。
text.description: 当我们穿过传送门时，没能带上任何动物。要想生产皮革和毛皮，就得用陷阱诱捕一些当地的野兽，并把它们带到这儿来。$B$B虽然平原都是冰天雪地的，但在霜火岭却生活着不少裂蹄牛和野狼。我们可以从裂蹄牛身上收集皮革，或是从狼身上取得毛皮。$B$B拿上这个钢铁陷阱，对着受伤的成年野兽使用它。把被陷阱困住的野兽带回来，我们就能开始工作了。
text.completion: Very good. We will have your leather or fur ready soon.$B$BNow that you know how to use the trap, it will be available for your use at any time. We can only handle so many beasts in the barn at one time, though. I would not advise taking more from the land than necessary.
text.completed: Return to Farmer Lok'lub at your garrison.

english.title: Breaking into the Trap Game
english.objectives: Use the Iron Trap to capture a Clefthoof or Wolf in Frostfire Ridge and then place a Work Order at your Barn.
english.description: When we came through the portal, we weren't able to bring any of our animals with us. For us to produce leather and furs, we'll need to trap some of the native beasts and bring them back here.$B$BAlthough the plains are frozen, there are many clefthooves and wolves in Frostfire. We can gather leather from the clefthooves, or furs from the wolves.$B$BTake this iron trap and use it on a wounded adult beast. Bring the trapped creature back to us, and we will begin our work.
english.completion: Очень хорошо. Кожа или мех скоро будут готовы.$B$BТеперь ты умеешь обращаться с ловушкой и сможешь использовать ее в любое время. Правда, хлев у нас не резиновый. Не советую брать от земли больше, чем необходимо.
english.completed: Return to Farmer Lok'lub at your garrison.

text.title: 更大的陷阱，更好的奖励
text.objectives: 使用致命的钢铁陷阱捕捉一只铁皮公牛、恐牙头狼或湿地践踏者。
text.description: 啊，指挥官，很高兴再次见到你。有了我们在德拉诺收集到的材料，就能制造出足够坚固的陷阱，哪怕是最为强大的野兽也将难以脱身。$B$B这些巨大的怪物就分布在纳格兰西边肥沃的平原里。$B$B事先提醒你一句：这些野兽体型庞大而又凶猛强力。你最好带上些朋友一起去。
text.completion: Blood and thunder, that must have been quite a battle!$B$BThe materials we obtain from beasts of this magnitude will last us for quite a while.
text.completed: Return to Farmer Lok'lub at your garrison.

english.title: Bigger Trap, Better Rewards
english.objectives: Use the Deadly Iron Trap to capture a Ironhide Bull, Direfang Alpha, or Wetland Trampler.
english.description: Ah, commander, it is good to see you again. With the materials we have gathered here in Draenor, we have been able to construct a trap strong enough to immobilize even the mightiest beast.$B$BThese enormous creatures can be found on the western side of Nagrand, among the most fertile plains.$B$BA word of warning: these beasts are great and powerful. You may want to bring some friends along.
english.completion: Thunder and lightning! I bet it was a hell of a massacre!$B$BThat much material will last us long enough.
english.completed: Return to Farmer Lok'lub at your garrison.

objectiveDetails.description: 下达一份大额产品订单

text.title: 寻找宝石工匠
text.objectives: 在沃高尔寻找吊坠的主人。
text.description: 你确定这个是非卖品吗？我肯定会给你个公道的价格！$B$B好吧，好吧……如果你坚持要找到它的主人，或许可以去沃高尔看看。$B$B有传闻说，那有个工匠大师，专门加工贵金属和宝石。也许他就是你要找的人。
text.completion: $R, how can I repay you for returning this pendant to me?

english.title: Locating the Lapidarist
english.objectives: Search for the owner of the pendant in Wor'gol.
english.description: Are you sure I can't take this off your hands? I'll give you a fair price!$B$BAlright, alright... if you insist on finding the owner, you might want to try visiting Wor'gol.$B$BRumor has it there is a master craftsman there who's skilled in manipulating precious metals and stones. Might be your guy.
english.completion: $R, how can I repay you for returning this pendant to me?

text.title: 看在往日的情分上
text.completion: $n, we've been through hell and back together more times than I can count. You're the Alliance's best chance at defeating the Iron Horde, and you know it.$B$BHow do you feel about me joining your garrison? We can bring the fight to orcish scum together, just like old times.

text.title: 失踪的伐木工
text.objectives: 在丛林之心里找到弗兰娜。
text.description:
所有钻探机在戈尔隆德都表现得很不可靠。我听说有台钻探机可能在丛林之心损毁了。

去试试看能不能找到弗兰娜。她当时应该就在我们追踪到这个位置的那台钻探机里。我会去找找那台钻探机，想办法修好它。
text.completion: Frenna didn't make it out of Tangleheart.

english.title: Lost Lumberjack
english.objectives: Find Frenna within Tangleheart.
english.description:
All o' them mole machines got mighty unreliable here in Gorgrond. I hear tell that one of 'em might've crashed here in Tangleheart.

See if you can find Frenna. She would've been on the one we tracked to this location. I'll go lookin' for the mole machine to see if it can be repaired.
english.completion: Frenna didn't make it out of Tangleheart.

text.description: 要塞下方的大地一直在震颤，而我们的斥候也已经好几个小时没来回报了。
text.progress: We must hold the line!
text.completion: We sent them packing, Commander!

english.progress: We must hold the line!

text.title: 苦尽钻来
text.objectives: 从霜火岭的熔岩软泥怪身上取得粗糙的熔岩宝钻。
text.description: 你想要了解我们宝石的秘密是吗，$r？为了感谢你帮我找回吊坠，我愿意满足你的请求。$B$B但我必须警告你，制作材料可不容易获得。$B$B北边有岩浆池，那里生活着岩浆怪物。你可以在它们体内找到华美的宝钻。$B$B请帮我找几颗这样的宝钻来……
text.progress: Have you obtained the materials I asked for?
text.completion: This diamond is marvelous! I shiver at the mere thought of the massive creature this must have come from...
text.completed: Return to Gem Grinder Orolak in Wor'gol.

english.title: No Pressure, No Diamonds
english.objectives: Acquire Lava Diamonds from the Lava Slimes that reside in Frostfire Ridge.
english.description: You wish to understand the secrets of our gems, $r? In exchange for returning my pendant, I am willing to help.$B$BI must warn you, however, that the materials will not be easy to obtain.$B$BTo the north, you will find magma pools that give birth to living lava creatures. Contained within these, you may find magnificent diamonds.$B$BPlease return to me with a few of these diamonds...
english.progress: Have you obtained the materials I asked for?
english.completion: This diamond is marvelous! I shiver at the mere thought of the massive creature this must have come from...
english.completed: Return to Gem Grinder Orolak in Wor'gol.

text.title: 窥探黑暗之门
text.objectives: 找到斥候帕泽普并使用她的望远镜。
text.description: 我派斥候帕泽普去仔细观察黑暗之门。她现在应该回来了，到底是因为什么耽搁了呢？$b$b她是我最得力的斥候之一，希望她一切平安。
text.completion: Poor Pazerp... this news is unsettling to say the least. The Iron Horde seems to have an unending supply of troops.

english.title: Peeking into the Portal
english.objectives: Find Scout Pazerp and use her telescope.
english.description: I sent Scout Pazerp to get a better look at the portal. She should have reported back by now; what could be taking her so long?$b$bShe is one of my best scouts, I hope she is alright.
english.completion: Poor Pazerp... this news is unsettling to say the least. The Iron Horde seems to have an unending supply of troops.

text.title: 钻石恒久远
text.objectives: 等奥罗拉克完成吊坠制作。
text.description: 看仔细了，$n。我会用这枚宝石为你加工出一件华美的吊坠。$B$B希望你在制作过程中能学习到一点真正的珠宝加工技艺。
text.completion: Thank you for your help $n, please take this pendant along with a copy of my research.$B$BI hope these will prove useful in helping you to better understand the secrets of Draenic gems.$B$BUntil we meet again, friend.
text.completed: Speak to Gem Grinder Orolak in Wor'gol.

english.title: Diamonds Are Forever
english.objectives: Wait for Orolak to finish crafting the pendant.
english.description: Please watch closely $n. I shall craft this jewel into a fine pendant for you.$B$BHopefully you will learn a bit of true jewelcrafting in the process.
english.completion: Thank you for your help $n, please take this pendant along with a copy of my research.$B$BI hope these will prove useful in helping you to better understand the secrets of Draenic gems.$B$BUntil we meet again, friend.
english.completed: Speak to Gem Grinder Orolak in Wor'gol.

objectiveDetails.description: 等奥罗拉克完成吊坠制作

english.title: Spires - Shrine Treasure 01 - Gift of Anzu

text.title: 窥探黑暗之门
text.objectives: 找到斥候帕扎提克并使用她的望远镜。
text.description: 我派斥候帕扎提克去仔细观察黑暗之门。他现在应该回来了，到底是因为什么耽搁了呢？$b$b雇地精做帮手就是避免不了这种麻烦。
text.progress: Разведчица Пазерп так до сих пор и не вернулась.
text.completion: Dis not good. Them Iron Horde be causin' a lot of da trouble round here. We need ta find a way ta deal wit dim.
text.completed: Return to Rokhan at the Shattered Landing in the Blasted Lands.

english.title: Peeking into the Portal
english.objectives: Find Scout Pazaztick and use her telescope.
english.description: I sent Scout Pazaztick to be gettin' a better look at da portal. He shoulda reported back by dis time; what be taking him so long?$b$bDis is what happens when you hire da goblins as help.
english.progress: Разведчица Пазерп так до сих пор и не вернулась.
english.completion: Dis not good. Them Iron Horde be causin' a lot of da trouble round here. We need ta find a way ta deal wit dim.
english.completed: Return to Rokhan at the Shattered Landing in the Blasted Lands.

text.title: 突袭黑石矿坑
text.objectives: 摧毁钢铁部落武器储备，尽可能地制造破坏。
text.description: 钢铁部落把武器和弹药都堆放在铸造厂外面。他们疲于在德拉诺各地作战，使自己的储备物资变得疏于防范。到那去尽可能地制造混乱吧，顺便记得用钢铁部落自己的弹药攻击他们，谁让他们把军火随便乱放！
text.completed: Return to your Garrison.

english.title: Assault on the Pit
english.objectives: Destroy Iron Horde weapons cache and take out as many of them as you can.
english.description: The Iron Horde are stockpiling their weapons and ammunition outside of the Foundry. Their campaign throughout Draenor has left their caches vulnerable. Get in there and cause as much chaos as you can, and while you're at it use some of that ammunition against them if they're just going to leave it lying around!
english.completed: Return to your Garrison.

text.title: 实地试验
text.objectives: 前往宾奇维斯拓殖点，然后把一瓶未经测试的血清用在一名被感染的拳师或被感染的伐木工身上。在完成后回去找克里希·宾奇维斯报告结果。
text.description: 听着，我没把情况如实告诉给基姆兹，因为不想她伤心，我选择继续留在宾奇维斯拓殖点。$b$b你瞧，我正在研制一种血清，应该能治愈那些被感染者，可正当我想要进行试验时却陷入了包围，结果在慌乱逃跑中弄伤了腿。$b$b尽管我也不确定这个疗法是不是百分之百有效，但必须试试看才行。帮我个忙，到外面找个被感染者，然后把这瓶药水用在他身上。
text.completion: The serum did what!??!$b$bI must have used too much growth hormone. Possibly... the mixture just needs to be shaken prior to dosage?

english.title: Field Trial
english.objectives: Venture into Pinchwhistle Point and use the Vial of Untested Serum on an Infected Bruiser or Infected Lumberjack.  Return to Krixel Pinchwhistle to report the results.
english.description: Look, I didn't tell Kimzee about this because I don't want to hurt her feelings, I chose not to leave Pinchwhistle Point.$b$bSee, I've been working on a serum that I think should be able to cure the infected, but when I tried to test it I got surrounded and I injured my leg during the escape.$b$bI know I'm on the right track but I need to test it. Do me a favor and take this vial and go try it out on one of the infected outside.
english.completion: The serum did what!??!$b$bI must have used too much growth hormone. Possibly... the mixture just needs to be shaken prior to dosage?

text.title: 古树的遗产
text.objectives: 收集库鲁克之心、奥图克的树干、洛鲁克的树枝和哈努克的根须。
text.description: 打开面前这个古老的卷轴，你看到那其实根本不是什么卷轴，而是一个容器。里面有四个空格子。$B$B仔细检查后，你发现在每个格子边上都刻着一种独特的德拉诺古树、一些雕文，还有一个用来安放图中古树残片的底托。边上还有说明文字，写出了这些古树分别能在哪里找到：中型木材——影月谷、戈尔隆德、阿兰卡峰林和纳格兰。$B$B这些是暗杀指令。有些树想要谋杀另一些树。
text.progress: What have you got there, commander?
text.completion: So what you're saying is that this here book is actually a container to hold the remains of targets on a hit list? And the assassination was being perpetrated by another... tree?$B$BThis world is crazy.$B$BNow let's see what happens when we put all the pieces into place.
text.completed: Return to the Lumber Mill in your Garrison.

english.title: Legacy of the Ancients
english.objectives: Collect the Heart of Kuruk, the Trunk of Autuk, the Twig of Loruk, and the Roots of Hanuk.
english.description: Opening the ancient tome you see that it's not actually a tome at all, but a container. Inside are four empty slots.$B$BUpon closer inspection each slot has next to it a carving of what appears to be a unique Draenor ancient, some glyphs and a receptacle used to hold a piece of the pictured ancient. There also appear to be directions to where these ancients may be found: medium timber -- Shadowmoon, Gorgrond, the Spires of Arak and Nagrand.$B$BThese are assassination instructions. From trees to kill trees.
english.progress: What have you got there, commander?
english.completion: So what you're saying is that this here book is actually a container to hold the remains of targets on a hit list? And the assassination was being perpetrated by another... tree?$B$BThis world is crazy.$B$BNow let's see what happens when we put all the pieces into place.
english.completed: Return to the Lumber Mill in your Garrison.

text.title: 清理种植园
text.objectives: 消灭8只坠月浣熊。
text.description: 这片空地正好适合供我们的要塞种植草药，但还有个小问题。就是这些可恶的浣熊！$b$b我需要你去消灭它们，好让我们把这里变成种植园。
text.completion: Great work, $n! We will get started planting the garden right away.

english.title: Clearing the Garden
english.objectives: Kill 8 Lunarfall Raccoons.
english.description: This clearing is the perfect spot to grow herbs for our Garrison, there is just one little problem.  All these dang raccoons!$b$bI need you to clear them out and we can get this garden growing.
english.completion: Great work, $n! We will get started planting the garden right away.

text.title: 消失的能量
text.objectives: 在安波里村里寻找精通宝石学与魔法的人。
text.description: <碎片在光下熠熠生辉，环绕它的最后一抹能量脉动倏然消散。>$B$B碎片中的能量似乎已经耗竭。$B$B你记得听旅行者们说起过，在安波里村有位村民，专门研究给宝石灌注法力。
text.completion: What have you got here...$B$BOnly a keen eye would be able to spot the potential of this drained crystal. You may not be familiar with draenei crystals yet, but your familiarity with gems certainly shows.$B$BTell you what... if you would assist me in the troubles we're having with our local defense crystals I'd gladly share some of my own expertise in jewelcrafting with you.

english.title: A Power Lost
english.objectives: Find someone in Embaari Village well-versed in gemology and magic.
english.description: <The fragment gleams in the light as its aura's final pulse fades.>$B$BThe power within the fragment appears to be drained.$B$BYou recall hearing travelers speak of a local in Embaari Village who specializes in imbuing gems with magic.
english.completion: What have you got here...$B$BOnly a keen eye would be able to spot the potential of this drained crystal. You may not be familiar with draenei crystals yet, but your familiarity with gems certainly shows.$B$BTell you what... if you would assist me in the troubles we're having with our local defense crystals I'd gladly share some of my own expertise in jewelcrafting with you.

text.title: 恢复力量
text.objectives: 为技师巴里拉取得样本。
text.description: 我跟你说过，我们较大防护水晶中的能量已经耗竭，在我们的防御阵线上留下了缺口。你给我带来的那枚水晶，只能进一步说明事态的严重性。我能肯定是影月魔法在作祟。$B$B我们有位游侠斥候发现了一个向北逃窜的兽人，他先是经过了白月镇，然后消失在了镇外的山谷中。去把这个兽人找出来，看看能不能从他身上找到什么用来储存能量的容器。如果我们能拿到这个容器，就一定能恢复水晶的力量。
text.progress: The crystal's power pulses as it is carried.
text.completion: You've found it! This crystal is overflowing with energy. This is definitely what we were looking for.$B$BI fear even thinking about what kind of ritual this orc was planning to undergo with the power from this crystal.$B$BYou've done a great thing for us, $C. As promised, I would like to show you my appreciation by teaching you how to work with some of our native gems and crystals. I trust you will put the knowledge to good use.
text.completed: Return to Artificer Baleera in Embaari Village.

english.title: Restoration
english.objectives: Retrieve the sample for Artificer Baleera.
english.description: As mentioned, our larger defense crystals have been drained of power, creating gaps in our defenses. The crystal you brought me is only a reminder of the severity of this situation. It's Shadowmoon magic to blame, I'm sure of it.$B$BOne of our rangari scouts spotted an orc fleeing north, past Palemoon Village, and into the valley beyond. Go, find this orc, and see if you can't retrieve whatever vessel he's storing the power inside of. If we get it back, I'm sure I can restore the crystals.
english.progress: The crystal's power pulses as it is carried.
english.completion: You've found it! This crystal is overflowing with energy. This is definitely what we were looking for.$B$BI fear even thinking about what kind of ritual this orc was planning to undergo with the power from this crystal.$B$BYou've done a great thing for us, $C. As promised, I would like to show you my appreciation by teaching you how to work with some of our native gems and crystals. I trust you will put the knowledge to good use.
english.completed: Return to Artificer Baleera in Embaari Village.

text.title: 影月入侵！
text.objectives: 击退影月氏族对你要塞的入侵。$B$B（再次与克劳勒中士交谈来开始行动）
text.description: 斥候们回报说，影月氏族像被踢翻的马蜂窝一样躁动不安。又该大干一场了吧，指挥官？
text.progress: We must hold the line!
text.completion: You were a blaze amongst our foes, Commander. It looks like we'll see another dawn in Draenor.
text.completed: Speak with Sergeant Crowler in your garrison.

english.title: Shadowmoon Invasion!
english.objectives: Repel the Shadowmoon clan invasion of your garrison.$B$B(Speak with Sergeant Crowler again to begin)
english.description: Scouts report that the Shadowmoon clan is buzzing like a kicked hornets' nest. Time again to earn our pay, Commander?
english.progress: We must hold the line!
english.completion: You were a blaze amongst our foes, Commander. It looks like we'll see another dawn in Draenor.
english.completed: Speak with Sergeant Crowler in your garrison.

text.title: 影月入侵！
text.objectives: 击退影月兽人对你要塞的入侵。$B$B（再次与格里姆加中士交谈来开始行动）
text.description: 据斥候回报，影月氏族已经近在咫尺，巫术也已准备就绪。要是我死了又爬起来的话，尽快把我解决掉，指挥官。我可不想变成个食尸鬼。
text.completion: Nothing like a little righteous bloodshed, to shake the chill from these old bones.
text.completed: Speak with Sergeant Grimjaw in your garrison.

english.title: Shadowmoon Invasion!
english.objectives: Repel the Shadowmoon clan invasion of your garrison.$B$B(Speak with Sergeant Grimjaw again to begin)
english.description: Scouts say the Shadowmoon clan looms close, ready with their necromancy. If I die and rise again, Commander, finish me quickly. I don't want to be a ghoul.
english.completion: Nothing like a little righteous bloodshed, to shake the chill from these old bones.
english.completed: Speak with Sergeant Grimjaw in your garrison.

objectiveDetails.description: 与格里姆加中士谈一谈

text.title: 从他们冰冷的尸体上
text.objectives: 从刀塔食人魔身上取得10块破损的妖纹布。
text.description: 那些食人魔把我的妖纹布全都抢走了！$b$b我把布藏在了包的最底下。他们怎么可能知道那其中的重要性？$b$b如果妖纹布的属性哪怕被他们发现一丁点，我们就都有大麻烦了。$b$b$n，这是霜狼氏族遇到的难题，必须用霜狼氏族的办法去解决。$b$b你愿意帮助我吗？
text.progress: Well, is it done?
text.completion: This looks to be all of the cloth, but it appears that they tried to rip and pull the magic out by physical force. I think I see teeth marks...
text.completed: Return to Trega at Wor'gol.

english.title: From Their Cold Dead Hands
english.objectives: Collect 10 Damaged Hexweave from Bladespire Ogres.
english.description: Those ogres took all of my hexweave!$b$bI kept it hidden at the bottom of my bag. How could they possibly know of its importance?$b$bIf they discover even a portion of hexweave's properties, it means trouble for us all.$b$b$n, this is a Frostwolf problem. It requires a Frostwolf solution.$b$bWill you help me?
english.progress: Well, is it done?
english.completion: This looks to be all of the cloth, but it appears that they tried to rip and pull the magic out by physical force. I think I see teeth marks...
english.completed: Return to Trega at Wor'gol.

text.title: 汁液浸染
text.objectives: 用特瑞佳的捕蝇草汁液，制造一些妖纹布。
text.description: 我真难以相信，那些食人魔居然想用蛮力把魔法从布料上剥离出来！$b$b看来我的秘密从没濒临落入恶人之手的边缘。安全的活着总比死了好……$b$b为了感谢你的帮助，我会与你分享给布料灌注魔法的秘诀。$b$b在这个地方，捕蝇草汁液可是稀罕物，但我刚好留了一点。拿上这块毛织布，放到这汁液里蘸一下。你会亲眼看清楚它的威力。
text.completion: There, you're on the path to becoming a true Hexweave tailor.$B$BDo not share the secrets I've shown you here with anyone.
text.completed: Return to Trega at Wor'gol.

english.title: Dyed in the Fur
english.objectives: Use Trega's Flytrap Ichor to create a Swatch of Hexweave.
english.description: I can't believe they tried to physically rip the magic out of the material!$b$bIt seems we were never in danger of my secrets falling into the wrong hands after all. Better safe than dead...$b$bIn return for your help, I will share with you my methods of fusing magic to cloth.$b$bFlytrap Ichor is very rare in this region, but I do have a bit in reserve. Take this woven fur and dip it in the ichor here. You will see for yourself what all of the fuss is about.
english.completion: There, you're on the path to becoming a true Hexweave tailor.$B$BDo not share the secrets I've shown you here with anyone.
english.completed: Return to Trega at Wor'gol.

text.title: 清理祸害
text.objectives: 击败你要塞里的三个祸害。
text.description: 我一直在努力为你的宠物们准备好这个地方，可我们在建造要塞时发现了一些恼人的祸害。我本想亲自动手解决的，但它们实在是太难对付了。$b$b在花园里有一根愤怒的胡萝卜，另外有只巨大的老鼠正在啃食我们的粮食，还有一个坏脾气的水怪在骚扰我们的渔夫。如果你能解决掉它们的话，我就能顺利无阻的完成我的工作了。
text.completion: Thank you, $n. Let's see if your pets like their new space!
text.completed: Return to Lio the Lioness in your garrison.

english.title: Pets Versus Pests
english.objectives: Defeat the three pests in your garrison.
english.description: I've been trying to get this place ready for your pets, but we've uncovered some rude pests while building the garrison.  I tried to take care of them myself, but they are too tough for my meager team.$b$bThere's an angry carrot in the garden, an enormous rat eating our food rations, and an ornery water creature harassing the fishermen.  If you can take care of them, I'll be free to finish up my work on your menagerie.
english.completion: Thank you, $n. Let's see if your pets like their new space!
english.completed: Return to Lio the Lioness in your garrison.

text.title: 踢蛋
text.objectives: 在棘痕营地里踢掉$1oa枚掠食者的卵。
text.description: <一枚粘乎乎的颤动的蛋——里面肯定是掠食者幼虫。$B$B狠狠踢上一脚应该就够了。>
text.completion: <Strangely satisfying.>

english.title: Egg Punt
english.objectives: Kick $1oa Ravager Eggs in Camp Thornscar.
english.description: <A sweaty, pulsing egg - no doubt flush with ravager larvae.$B$BA swift kick should take care of these.>
english.completion: <Strangely satisfying.>

text.title: 巴罗夫实业集团的兴亡：阿莱克斯·巴罗夫
text.objectives: 接受剑圣纳什拉的血誓。
text.description: [PHYLARCH ACQUISITION TEXT GOES HERE]
text.completion: "The brothers united once more," he said.$B$B"A world full of untold riches to plunder," he said.$B$B"Wealth beyond imaging," he said!$B$BAnd then he proceeded to drop a log on top of me.$B$B"There can only be one CEO of Barov Industries," he said.$B$BAt least we can agree on that...

english.title: The Rise and Fall of Barov Industries: Alexi Barov
english.objectives: Accept the Blood Oath of Blademaster Na'Shra.
english.description: [PHYLARCH ACQUISITION TEXT GOES HERE]
english.completion: "The brothers united once more," he said.$B$B"A world full of untold riches to plunder," he said.$B$B"Wealth beyond imaging," he said!$B$BAnd then he proceeded to drop a log on top of me.$B$B"There can only be one CEO of Barov Industries," he said.$B$BAt least we can agree on that...

text.title: 暴力治疗
text.objectives: 治愈$1oa个被感染的地精。
text.description: 感染的情况日益恶化，所以我做了一些调整，我相当确定，配方已经准确无误了。$b$b药水现在应该能治愈感染，但还是要尽量避免与被感染的血液产生正面对抗，以防出现不良效果。$b$b这意味着你需要在使用血清前削弱被感染者，让药水正常发挥效力。$b$b随着时间的推移，感染细胞已经大大进化，很快就会到无法医治的地步，所以我们只能放手一搏，挽救尽量多的生命。
text.completion: Yea! Great work, $n!$b$bI've already heard from the survivors and they're glad for this second chance at life.$b$bYou made a real difference today!

english.title: Curing With Force
english.objectives: Cure $1oa Infected Goblins.
english.description: The infection is getting stronger so I made some adjustments and I'm pretty sure I have the right formula now.$b$bIt should now work but it needs to have less competition with the infected blood for it to have any effect.$b$bThis means you will need to weaken them before you apply the serum for it to function properly.$b$bThe infection is getting more advanced and will soon be untreatable so we have this one shot to save as many as we can.
english.completion: Yea! Great work, $n!$b$bI've already heard from the survivors and they're glad for this second chance at life.$b$bYou made a real difference today!

text.title: 巴罗夫实业集团的兴亡：维尔顿·巴罗夫
text.objectives: 接受剑圣纳什拉的血誓。

english.title: The Rise and Fall of Barov Industries: Weldon Barov
english.objectives: Accept the Blood Oath of Blademaster Na'Shra.
english.description: [PHYLARCH ACQUISITION TEXT GOES HERE]
english.completion: Он говорил: "Братья вновь объединились".$B$BОн говорил: "Мир полон сокровищ, которые можно присвоить себе".$B$B"Несметных богатств", – так он говорил!$B$BА потом сбросил на меня бревно.$B$B"В "Баров Индастриз" может быть только один генеральный директор", – сказал он.$B$BНу, хоть в этим мы с ним сходимся...

text.title: 寻找斥候
text.objectives: 在戈尔隆德的迪奥诺之劫找到奥塔尔。
text.description: 我们还在寻找在野外执行任务的几名斥候。其中一位名叫奥塔尔，他总是喜欢执行更为危险的任务。$b$b奥塔尔直到现在还没回来报告，我觉得我们应该去看看他，确保他没有过分逞强。
text.completion: D'kaan worried about me? He is more worried I will be chased back to the camp with one of those giant beasts in tow. Still I could use your help here...

english.title: Seeking the Scout
english.objectives: Find Altauur at Dionor's Demise in Gorgrond.
english.description: We are still trying to locate all of our scouts out in the field. One of these, Altauur, enjoys handling the more dangerous missions.$b$bHe has not checked in and I feel we should check to make sure he has not taken on more than he can handle.
english.completion: D'kaan worried about me? He is more worried I will be chased back to the camp with one of those giant beasts in tow. Still I could use your help here...

text.title: 来自天堂的佩妮
text.objectives: 在蛮兽岗哨与佩妮·殴底谈一谈。
text.description:
<杜隆坦好奇地打量着你。>

那些来自你世界的人好像都不怎么细致，是吧？

去跟我们的新伙伴打个招呼。等我们做好准备就会去与你会合。
text.completion: Ahh, there y'are!$b$bPenny Clobberbottom reportin' for duty, commander.

english.title: Penny From Heaven
english.objectives: Speak to Penny Clobberbottom at Beastwatch.
english.description:
<Durotan looks at you curiously.>

Those from your world are not much for subtlety, are they?

Go on ahead and greet our new companion. We will join you as soon as we can make ready.
english.completion: Ahh, there y'are!$b$bPenny Clobberbottom reportin' for duty, commander.

text.title: 难解的情报
text.objectives: 在沃高尔附近寻找能帮忙翻译笔记的人。
text.description: 笔记潦草难辨，但根据以往的经验判断，这种文字似乎跟标准兽人语十分相似。$B$B笔记中可能包含着战略情报，也许对霜狼兽人有着巨大价值。$B$B沃高尔里没准有人能帮你翻译一下。
text.progress: <Raleigh looks up from the scrolls.>$B$BCommander $n, what brings you to Wor'gol?!
text.completion: We have been studying these orcish texts feverishly since our arrival here. Allow me a moment to translate this for you.$B$BHmmm... The notes appear to contain a list of names.

english.title: Unintelligible Intelligence
english.objectives: Look around Wor'gol for someone who can help translate the notes.
english.description: The notes are unreadable, but based on previous experience, the text appears to be very similar to standard Orcish.$B$BIt is possible that the notes could contain strategic information. Perhaps it would be of great value to the Frostwolf Orcs.$B$BSomeone in Wor'gol might be able to help interpret the text.
english.progress: <Raleigh looks up from the scrolls.>$B$BCommander $n, what brings you to Wor'gol?!
english.completion: We have been studying these orcish texts feverishly since our arrival here. Allow me a moment to translate this for you.$B$BHmmm... The notes appear to contain a list of names.

objectiveDetails.description: 在沃高尔里寻找能帮忙翻译字条的人

text.title: 修剪植物
text.objectives: 在迪奥诺之劫消灭$1oa个守卫者。
text.description: 这片异常的密林也许远非看上去那么简单，可我们得先扫清障碍，才能追根究底啊，是吧？$b$b为了安全起见，我建议先消灭掉一些愤怒的防御者。
text.completion: I have slain quite a few as well but they continue to spring up here.$b$bWe will need another solution...
text.completed: Speak to Altauur at Dionor's Demise in Gorgrond.

english.title: Plant Pruning
english.objectives: Kill $1oa defenders at Dionor's Demise.
english.description: There may be more to this aberrant growth than it seems, but we will need to clear the way a bit before we can get to the bottom of this, yes?$b$bI suggest clearing out some of the angrier defenders to be on the safe side.
english.completion: I have slain quite a few as well but they continue to spring up here.$b$bWe will need another solution...
english.completed: Speak to Altauur at Dionor's Demise in Gorgrond.

text.title: 古树大使
text.objectives: 在戈尔隆德的迪奥诺之劫与贝楚斯谈一谈。
text.description: 看来不久前有一头原祖荆兽在这里被杀死了，然后就出现了这个密林。它把当地怪物搅得躁动不安，我很担心我们哨站的安全。$b$b这里有一棵奇怪的古树，总是沉湎于悲伤之中，没什么敌意。也许你能去把它的故事给“套出来”？
text.completion: So the normal ebb and flow of battle has been disrupted by the saberon. I do not think it wise to leave things as such.$b$bWe should see about infiltrating the saberon and setting things right.
text.completed: Speak to Altauur at Dionor's Demise in Gorgrond.

english.title: Ambassador to the Ancient
english.objectives: Talk to Birchus at Dionor's Demise in Gorgrond.
english.description: It appears that a genesaur was killed here not long ago and this growth has sprung up.  It is stirring up the local monsters and I fear for our outpost.$b$bThere is a strange ancient that wallows in grief here and is not hostile. Perhaps you could "harvest" its story?
english.completion: So the normal ebb and flow of battle has been disrupted by the saberon. I do not think it wise to leave things as such.$b$bWe should see about infiltrating the saberon and setting things right.
english.completed: Speak to Altauur at Dionor's Demise in Gorgrond.

text.title: 打脸vs巨石
text.objectives: 让角斗士打脸粉碎巨石障碍物。
text.description: 在遭到贝楚斯的攻击后，虎人们带着财宝跑到了高处，然后设障碍物将自己围了起来。要想进去可没那么容易，但我听说你这边刚好有合适的人手。$b$b其中一个入口被巨石封住了。咱俩可搬不动它，不过也许某个手拿大锤的食人魔能将它打碎。你应该知道我说的是谁……
text.completion: You have strong friends $n. We must make haste before the plants realize the way is open.
text.completed: Meet up with Altauur at Steamscar Rise.

english.title: Beatface vs. Boulder
english.objectives: Break the boulder barrier using Beatface the gladiator.
english.description: The saberon took their treasure up the rise and barricaded themselves in after Birchus attacked. It will be difficult to get in but I hear you have resources to handle this.$b$bOne of their entrances is covered with a large boulder. Too large for you or I, but perhaps an ogre with a large enough hammer could break it. I think you know who I am talking about...
english.completion: Yeah, you have strong friends, $p! You need to hurry until the plants have realized that the path is clear.
english.completed: Meet up with Altauur at Steamscar Rise.

text.title: 切割者大战虎人
text.objectives: 用你的切割机粉碎藤条障碍物。
text.description: 在遭到贝楚斯的攻击后，虎人们带着财宝跑到了高处，然后设障碍物将自己围了起来。要想进去可没那么容易，但我听说你这边刚好有合适的工具。$b$b其中一个入口被坚韧的植物封住了。我相信可以采取机械手段来解决这个难题，比如切割机什么的。你应该知道该怎么做了……
text.completion: Your machine is brutish but effective, well done $p. We must make haste before the plants realize the way is open.
text.completed: Speak with Altauur at Steamscar Rise in Gorgrond.

english.title: Shredder vs. Saberon
english.objectives: Break the vine barrier using your shredder.
english.description: The saberon took their treasure up the rise and barricaded themselves in after Birchus attacked. It will be difficult to get in but I hear you have resources to handle this.$b$bOne of their entrances is covered with tough vegetation. I believe you have a mechanical solution to this problem in the form of a shredder. I think you know what to do...
english.completion: Your machine is brutish but effective, well done $p. We must make haste before the plants realize the way is open.
english.completed: Speak with Altauur at Steamscar Rise in Gorgrond.

objectiveDetails.description: 粉碎藤条障碍物，进入虎人营地

text.title: 整治刃牙虎人
text.objectives: 在汽痕高地消灭$1oa个刃牙虎人。
text.description: 我们距离目标又近了一步，可却被一群牙尖齿利的刃牙虎人挡住了去路。$b$b如果我们想要上去的话，就得先消灭掉一些更具攻击性的敌人才行。
text.completion: Many are finding bolt-holes to weather your storm, friend. That should keep them out of our way.
text.completed: Speak with Altauur at Steamscar Rise in Gorgrond.

english.title: Saberon Population Reduction
english.objectives: Slay $1oa saberon at Steamscar Rise.
english.description: We are closer to our goals but a host of sharp toothed saberon bar our way.$b$bIf we are to get anywhere up here, some of the more aggressive ones will need to be put down I think.
english.completion: Many are finding bolt-holes to weather your storm, friend. That should keep them out of our way.
english.completed: Speak with Altauur at Steamscar Rise in Gorgrond.

text.title: 没收财产
text.objectives: 从汽痕高地的刃牙虎人储物箱里找到$1oa个草药包。
text.description: 你注意到了一个散发着幽幽绿光的草药包。里面有个发光的绿色豆荚，很可能是从下方的林地里偷来的。$b$b最好把这些全都收走，以防虎人继续钻研植物魔法，激怒附近的玛戈隆。
text.progress: The saberon should definitely NOT have any of the herbs you have found!
text.completion: A good catch discovering those herbs $p. We cannot allow them to continue using these. Who knows what it might set off.
text.completed: Bring the herb bundles to Altauur at Steamscar Rise.

english.title: Reclaiming Property
english.objectives: Find $1oa Herb Bundles in saberon stashes at Steamscar Rise.
english.description: You are attracted by a low green glow to the container.  Inside there is a glowing bundle of herbs that was most likely stolen from the overgrowth below.$b$bIt would be best to collect all of these so the saberon don't continue their dabbling in plant magic and irritating the nearby magnaron.
english.progress: Нельзя допустить, чтобы найденные тобой травы достались саблеронам!
english.completion: A good catch discovering those herbs $p. We cannot allow them to continue using these. Who knows what it might set off.
english.completed: Bring the herb bundles to Altauur at Steamscar Rise.

text.title: 夺取凋零之蕾
text.objectives: 从汽痕高地的浓烟之主咆吼身上取得凋零之蕾。
text.description: 你的工作收效显著。在附近的洞穴里住着一位强大的虎人萨满祭司，他正用我们寻找的凋零之蕾学习引导原祖荆兽的魔法。解决方法很简单：杀了他，夺取凋零之蕾，把它还给贝楚斯。那应该能保证我们哨站的安全。
text.progress: Do you have something for me little beast?
text.completion: You have... you have brought me the bloom. At last my purpose can be fulfilled!
text.completed: Speak with Birchus at Dionor's Demise in Gorgrond.
text.giverWindow: 消灭浓烟之主咆吼并夺取凋零之蕾。

english.title: Taking the Death Bloom
english.objectives: Take the Death Bloom from Smokemaster Snarl in Steamscar Rise.
english.description: Your work has born fruit. Inside the nearby cave a powerful saberon shaman is learning to channel the genesaur magic using the Death Bloom we seek. The solution is before us: kill the shaman, take the Death Bloom, return it to Birchus. That should improve the safety of our outpost.
english.progress: У тебя есть что-то для меня?
english.completion: You have... you have brought me the bloom. At last my purpose can be fulfilled!
english.completed: Speak with Birchus at Dionor's Demise in Gorgrond.
english.giverWindow: Kill Smokemaster Snarl and take the Death Bloom.

text.title: 让迪奥诺安息
text.objectives: 观看贝楚斯的仪式。
text.description: 你给了我这朵花，这简直是一份厚礼。我终于能彻底将迪奥诺送回森林中去，结束这场噩梦了。现在剩下的就是举行仪式……待在边上见证你一生难得一见的场面吧……
text.completion: At last it is done.  Dionor has left and his spawn shall follow him in due time.$b$bI grow weary of this conflict and the desire to return to the Overgrowth has left me.$b$bPerhaps I will travel beyond these lands and see what other surprises you little beasts have to share...
text.completed: Speak with Birchus at Dionor's Demise in Gorgrond.

english.title: Laying Dionor to Rest
english.objectives: Watch Birchus's ritual.
english.description: You have given me a tremendous gift with this bloom. I can finally send Dionor back to the Overgrowth for good and end this nightmare. All that remains is the ritual... stay and behold something you will never see again in your lifetime...
english.completion: At last it is done.  Dionor has left and his spawn shall follow him in due time.$b$bI grow weary of this conflict and the desire to return to the Overgrowth has left me.$b$bPerhaps I will travel beyond these lands and see what other surprises you little beasts have to share...
english.completed: Speak with Birchus at Dionor's Demise in Gorgrond.

text.title: 强制缩编
text.objectives: 取得阿莱克斯·巴罗夫的徽记。
text.description: 在争夺巴罗夫家族财产遭到惨败后，我就不该再相信他！我真后悔没能在第一时间把他除掉。$B$B现在他认为自己能独占这片土地上的所有财富，把我一脚踢出局？！$B$B别做梦了，我亲爱的兄弟，这次绝不可能！巴罗夫实业集团只能有一位老板，那就是我。$B$B我的农夫朋友，你必须帮我这个忙。去找到我的兄弟阿莱克斯，把解雇通知书丢给他！$B$B他应该就在野外的小型木料附近。
text.progress: Did you deliver the... notice of termination?
text.completion: <Weldon holds Alexi's head up to his face and begins speaking.>$B$BYou no-good, backstabbing son-of-a-goat! Your greed is only surpassed by my own!$B$BAs for you my peasant friend, you have served me well. Here are your just rewards!
text.completed: Return to Weldon Barov at the Lumber Mill.
text.giverWindow: 曾经的兄弟，卑鄙的叛徒。

english.title: Reduction in Force
english.objectives: Collect the Head of Alexi Barov.
english.description: I was a fool to trust him after the fiasco over the Barov family fortune! What I should have done is killed him the first chance I had.$B$BAnd now he thinks he's going to plumb this land for all that it's worth and cut me out?!$B$BNo, dear brother, not this time! There can only be one CEO of Barov Industries and it will be me.$B$BMy peasant friend, you must do me this service. Find my brother, Alexi, and serve him a notice of termination!$B$BYou will likely find him out in the wilds, near small timber.
english.progress: Did you deliver the... notice of termination?
english.completion: <Weldon holds Alexi's head up to his face and begins speaking.>$B$BYou no-good, backstabbing son-of-a-goat! Your greed is only surpassed by my own!$B$BAs for you my peasant friend, you have served me well. Here are your just rewards!

text.title: 浑水摸鱼
text.objectives: 用拉林夫的信誉卡渗透进格罗姆加尔。
text.description: 噢，天哪！$B$B这是一份俘虏名单，他们似乎即将被贩卖……甚至是处死。$B$B名单上有个我熟悉的名字，那是我师傅！$B$B我一直在等他回来，现在看来他是落在了敌人的手里。$B$B这简直是灾难！拜托你了，$n，我们一定要救他。$B$B根据笔记中的内容判断，他被带到了遥远东边的格罗姆加尔。$B$B等等……我这刚好有样东西，能帮你神不知鬼不觉地混进去……
text.completion: You know the trick to fooling a bunch of Orcs? Every once in a while you've got to be holding all the cards!
text.completed: Return to Nicholaus Page in Grom'gar.

english.title: Bypassing Security
english.objectives: Infiltrate Grom'gar using Raleigh's Prestige Card.
english.description: Oh, my goodness!$B$BThis is a list of captives, it appears they may be awaiting transfer... or possibly even execution.$B$BThere is one name on this list that I do recognize: my master!$B$BI have been awaiting his return, but now it appears that he may have fallen into enemy hands.$B$BThis is a disaster! Please, $n, we must rescue him.$B$BAccording to the notes, he has been taken to Grom'gar, located far east of here.$B$BOne moment... I think I may have just the thing to help you break in undetected...
english.completion: You know the trick to fooling a bunch of Orcs? Every once in a while you've got to be holding all the cards!
english.completed: Return to Nicholaus Page in Grom'gar.

text.title: 在墙上多开一个洞而已
text.objectives: 用佩妮的起爆器炸毁岩墙。
text.description:
给，拿上这个。

在我飞进去时，我趁机找了找防御位置。

在这些大石头的另一边有片合适的空地，用来藏身再合适不过了。我甚至还带上了一整套设计图，打算把我们所有人都安置到那去！

这想法不算太天马行空吧？

不管怎样，等你准备好就按下起爆器吧！
text.completion: Perhaps this little creature will earn her keep after all.
text.completed: Speak with Durotan at Beastwatch.

english.title: Just Another Stick in the Wall
english.objectives: Use Penny's Plunger to blow up the Rock Wall.
english.description:
So, get this.

As I was flyin' in, I took the opportunity to scope out what might be a defensible position.

Just on the other side o' these boulders is an ideal clearing to hole up in. I even brought a set of blueprints to get us all settled in!

That's not too presumptuous, is it?

Anyway, whenever you're ready just hit this plunger!
english.completion: Perhaps this little creature will earn her keep after all.
english.completed: Speak with Durotan at Beastwatch.

text.title: Locating the Lapidarist
text.objectives: Search for the owner of the pendant in Wor'gol.
text.description: Are you sure I can't take this off your hands? I'll give you a fair price!$B$BAlright, alright... if you insist on finding the owner, you might want to try visiting Wor'gol.$B$BRumor has it, there is a master craftsman, skilled in manipulating precious metals and stones.$B$BBut, if you change your mind, you know where to find me....

english.title: Locating the Lapidarist
english.objectives: Search for the owner of the pendant in Wor'gol.
english.description: Are you sure I can't take this off your hands? I'll give you a fair price!$B$BAlright, alright... if you insist on finding the owner, you might want to try visiting Wor'gol.$B$BRumor has it, there is a master craftsman, skilled in manipulating precious metals and stones.$B$BBut, if you change your mind, you know where to find me....

text.title: 清理祸害
text.objectives: 击败你要塞里的三个祸害。
text.description: 我一直在努力为你的宠物们准备好这个地方，可我们在建造要塞时发现了一些恼人的祸害。我本想亲自动手解决的，但它们实在是太难对付了。$b$b在花园里有一根愤怒的胡萝卜，另外有只巨大的老鼠正在啃食我们的粮食，还有一个坏脾气的水怪在骚扰我们的渔夫。如果你能解决掉它们的话，我就能顺利无阻的完成我的工作了。
text.completion: Nice job, brudda. I hope your pets be likin' dere new home.
text.completed: Return to Serr'ah in your garrison.

english.title: Pets Versus Pests
english.objectives: Defeat the three pests in your garrison.
english.description: I been tryin' ta get dis place ready for your pets, but we uncovered some rude pests while buildin' da garrison.  I tried takin' care o' dem myself, but they be too tough for my little friends.$b$bBeat da angry carrot in da garden, da rat eatin' our food, and da ornery water creature harassing da fishermen.  If you can do it, I be free to finish up da work on your menagerie.
english.completion: Nice job, brudda. I hope your pets be likin' dere new home.
english.completed: Return to Serr'ah in your garrison.

text.title: 全新的暗月挑战者！
text.objectives: 在一场宠物对战中击败克里斯托弗·冯·费瑟尔。
text.description: 看看我，再看看我的马，再看看我，我难道不是你所见过最令人难忘的宠物战将吗？$B$B你仔细瞧瞧那边那位我的同胞。他骑在马背上吗？当然没有！他的帽子是由焰火制成的吗？简直做梦！我所拥有的一切都更为显赫，从我外衣的颜色到我伟大的姓氏，都是我亲力亲为给自己打造的。$B$B你胆敢走上前来挑战头号选手克里斯托弗·维利肯斯·丹尼斯·拉格纳罗斯·冯·费瑟尔的力量吗？$B$B我看你已经吓得瑟瑟发抖了！
text.completion: Next time I won't go so easy on you!

english.title: A New Darkmoon Challenger!
english.objectives: Defeat Christoph VonFeasel in a pet battle.
english.description: Look at me, now look at my horse, now look back at me, are I not the most impressive battler of pets that you have ever seen?$B$BLook now at my compatriot over there. Is he on a horse? Of course not! Is his hat made of fireworks? Not in a million years! Everything about me is more impressive, from my coat color to my last name, which I made myself.$B$BDare you step up to the might of Christoph Willikens Dennis Ragnaros VonFeasel the First?$B$BI can see you trembling!
english.completion: Next time I won't go so easy on you!

objectiveDetails.description: 击败克里斯托弗·冯·费瑟尔

text.title: 刀叶林地
text.objectives: 在刀叶林地找到德拉卡和卡兹。
text.description: 当我们赶来这里时，那位名叫卡兹的嘲颅萨满祭司跑掉了。$b$b她说自己要到南边的丛林里寻找更多族人。$b$b德拉卡坚持要跟着她，以防遭到任何背叛。$b$b指挥官，如果卡兹说的是真话，那她和德拉卡一定急需任何可获得的帮助。$b$b你愿意去加入她们吗？她们应该还没走远。$b$b这也许是对你的新式切割机和伐木资源的一次完美考验。
text.completion: My husband sent you, didn't he?$b$bNormally I would laugh at that, but seeing these horrors, Kaz and I could use all the help we can get.
text.completed: 在刀叶林地与德拉卡谈一谈。

english.title: The Razorbloom
english.objectives: Find Draka and Kaz at the Razorbloom.
english.description: The Laughing Skull shaman Kaz ran off while we were coming here.$b$bShe claimed to be looking for more of her people in the jungles to the south.$b$bDraka insisted on following her to safeguard us against betrayal.$b$bCommander, if Kaz is telling the truth, then she and Draka are going to need all the help they can get.$b$bWill you join them? They could not have gotten far.$b$bThis could prove to be the perfect test for your new shredder and lumber mill resources.
english.completion: My husband sent you, didn't he?$b$bNormally I would laugh at that, but seeing these horrors, Kaz and I could use all the help we can get.
english.completed: Speak with Draka at the Razorbloom.

text.title: 顺手牵羊
text.objectives: 拿取攻城锻造大师乌拉托克保险箱中的东西。
text.description: 指挥官，多谢你跟拉林夫找到了我，可我必须留在这。$B$B我们自从来到这里就在不眠不休地工作，希望能够破解这些德拉诺文字的内容。$B$B我当时真觉得自己差一点就能拿到卷轴了，结果却在最后一刻被他们逮住了！$B$B拜托，你一定要帮帮我……攻城锻造大师的帐篷就在东边的山上。$B$B要是你能从他的箱子里找到文件，也许还有钥匙，我就能翻译出他们的语言了。
text.progress: A book of poems? I'll let you hang onto that one for now....
text.completion: $n, this is it, THIS IS IT! Just give me a moment while I look through these.$B$BHmm... I think there are a few things here that you may find very useful. Here, take these plans with you.$B$BDon't worry about me, commander. I'm just gonna take another look around before I sneak out of here.
text.completed: Return to Nicholaus Page at Grom'gar.

english.title: Stealing the Declaration
english.objectives: Loot the contents of Master Siegesmith Uratok's Strongbox.
english.description: Commander, you and Raleigh did a great job finding me, but I'm exactly where I need to be.$B$BWe've been working tirelessly since we got here, trying to crack these Draenic texts.$B$BI really thought I was gonna get the scrolls, but they nabbed me at the last possible second!$B$BPlease, you've gotta help me out... up the hill to the east, you'll find the Master Siegesmith's tent.$B$BIf you can grab the documents out of his chest, possibly this key too, I'll finally have enough to translate their languages.
english.progress: A book of poems? I'll let you hang onto that one for now....
english.completion: $n, this is it, THIS IS IT! Just give me a moment while I look through these.$B$BHmm... I think there are a few things here that you may find very useful. Here, take these plans with you.$B$BDon't worry about me, commander. I'm just gonna take another look around before I sneak out of here.
english.completed: Return to Nicholaus Page at Grom'gar.

objectiveDetails.description: 收集偷来的德莱尼文稿

text.title: 破碎誓言
text.objectives: 在暗月马戏团里寻找对指环感兴趣的人。
text.description: 一枚磨损严重的指环，表面还沾了几丝血迹。$B$B暗月马戏团里也许有人知道关于这样物品的更多信息。
text.completion: Ah, I see that you've found my lovelies. Beautiful, aren't they? It's a shame that the process drives them so... insane.$B$BThe ring is yours to keep, of course. Can you hear them whisper? Marvelous.

english.title: Broken Promises
english.objectives: Find someone at the Darkmoon Faire that might be interested in the ring.
english.description: A heavily-scratched ring, faintly stained with blood.$B$BSomeone at the Darkmoon Faire might be able to provide more information about this item.
english.completion: Ah, I see that you've found my lovelies. Beautiful, aren't they? It's a shame that the process drives them so... insane.$B$BThe ring is yours to keep, of course. Can you hear them whisper? Marvelous.

text.title: 不死鸟大挑战
text.objectives: 在飞行中穿过15个圆环。
text.description: 你准备好展翅高飞，在不死鸟大挑战中大显身手了吗？太棒了！$B$B穿过15只圆环即为获胜！等你准备好就跟我说一声！
text.completion: Wow, great flying out there, ace! Here's your prize!

english.title: Firebird's Challenge
english.objectives: Collect 15 rings while flying.
english.description: You're ready to fly high and give the Firebird's challenge a shot? That's great!$B$BSimply collect 15 rings to win! Speak to me when you're ready for takeoff!
english.completion: Wow, great flying out there, ace! Here's your prize!

text.title: 绿皮肤的独眼魔？
text.objectives: 消灭被感染的独眼魔。
text.description: 卡兹常常告诫我说绿皮肤的独眼魔都是坏的。$b$b这里的木精养了只绿皮肤的独眼魔，它简直邪恶至极。$b$b它的力量大到足以消灭掉我爸爸的整支狩猎小队。$b$b你有能耐除掉它吗？
text.completion: Yay! Burn the bad guy! Burn him a lot!
text.completed: Speak with Cutter at Evermorn Springs.
text.giverWindow: 木精领地中更具危险性的被感染生物之一。

english.title: A Green Ogron?
english.objectives: Kill the Infested Ogron.
english.description: Kaz always told me green ogron are bad.$b$bThe botani here have a green ogron and it is mean.$b$bIt was strong enough to take out my dad's entire hunting party.$b$bAre you strong enough to kill it?
english.completion: Yay! Burn the bad guy! Burn him a lot!
english.completed: Speak with Cutter at Evermorn Springs.
english.giverWindow: One of the more dangerous infested creatures in the botani arsenal.

text.title: 战斗宠物大比拼
text.objectives: 在战斗区域内击败宠物。
text.description: 看来今天有客人造访我们的战斗区域了，它们很想较量一番。你不如让他们瞧瞧正牌宠物对战大师的身手？
text.progress: Those pets looked tough. How'd you do?
text.completion: I knew you could do it, kid.
text.completed: Return to Lio the Lioness in your garrison.

english.title: Battle Pet Roundup
english.objectives: Defeat the pets in the battle area.
english.description: Looks like we've got some visitors in the battle pen today, and they're looking for a fight.  Why don't you show 'em how a master of pet battles handles $Ghimself:herself;?
english.progress: Those pets looked tough. How'd you do?
english.completion: I knew you could do it, kid.
english.completed: Return to Lio the Lioness in your garrison.

text.title: 矮人窃贼
text.objectives: 在棱堡高地找到快刀。
text.description: 快刀正在追踪那件被矮人偷走的神器。当他在丛林里狩猎时，鼻子像狼一样灵敏。$b$b沿着峡谷向南行进，直到你找到他为止。$b$b看来我跟狼后还得大肆破坏一番才能离开这里。$b$B我们会尽快追上来的。
text.completion: Wow. Those... "dwarves"... sure do know how to make both botani AND goren mad.
text.completed: 在棱堡高地找到快刀。

english.title: Thieving Dwarves
english.objectives: Find Cutter at Bastion Rise.
english.description: Cutter is on the trail of the artifact the dwarves stole. He has the nose of a wolf when it comes to hunting in the jungle.$b$bFollow the canyons south until you find him.$b$bIt would seem the wolf queen and I are going to do more damage here before we leave.$b$BWe will follow as quickly as we can.
english.completion: Wow. Those... "dwarves"... sure do know how to make both botani AND goren mad.
english.completed: Find Cutter at Bastion Rise.

text.title: 突袭黑石矿坑
text.objectives: 摧毁钢铁部落武器储备，尽可能地制造破坏。
text.description: 钢铁部落把武器和弹药都堆放在铸造厂外面。他们疲于在德拉诺各地作战，使自己的储备物资变得疏于防范。到那去尽可能地制造混乱吧，顺便记得用钢铁部落自己的弹药攻击他们，谁让他们把军火随便乱放！
text.completed: Return to your Garrison.

english.title: Assault on the Pit
english.objectives: Destroy Iron Horde weapons cache and take out as many of them as you can.
english.description: The Iron Horde are stockpiling their weapons and ammunition outside of the Foundry. Their campaign throughout Draenor has left their caches vulnerable. Get in there and cause as much chaos as you can, and while you're at it use some of that ammunition against them if they're just going to leave it lying around!
english.completed: Return to your Garrison.

objectiveDetails.description: 打倒 - 過場 / 稀有菁英

text.title: Tracking Quest: Can Open Othaar's Door

english.title: Tracking Quest: Can Open Othaar's Door

text.title: 来自塔拉多的消息
text.objectives: 到你在霜火岭的要塞与洛坎交谈。
text.description: 洛坎捎信说让你赶去霜寒晶壁。钢铁部落已经在塔拉多海岸上登陆了。
text.completion: Welcome back, mon.

english.title: News from Talador
english.objectives: Speak to Rokhan at your garrison in Frostfire Ridge.
english.description: Rokhan sends word that you are needed at Frostwall. The Iron Horde have landed on the shores of Talador.
english.completion: Welcome back, mon.

text.title: 来自塔拉多的消息
text.objectives: 到你在影月谷的要塞与伯德里克·格雷谈一谈。
text.description: 伯德里克·格雷从你的要塞捎信来说，他们在塔拉多海岸上发现了一支钢铁部落舰队。$b$b我们决不能让他们摧毁沙塔斯。
text.completion: Welcome back, $n.

english.title: News from Talador
english.objectives: Speak to Bodrick Grey at your garrison in Shadowmoon Valley.
english.description: Bodrick Grey sends word from your garrison that they have spotted a fleet of Iron Horde at the shores of Talador.$b$bWe must not allow them to destroy Shattrath.
english.completion: C возвращением, $n.

text.title: The Lumber Mill
text.objectives: Speak to Glirin outside Tangleheart.
text.description:
The Rangari have been here for a tick, and they hear tell from the Laughing Skull o' a place called Tangleheart.

Seems some really bad ancients come from there, and botani use a kind o' sap to grow them quickly.

I think we could use that for yer outpost. Hey, wood is wood, right?

I'll meet ya there.

english.description:
The Rangari have been here for a tick, and they hear tell from the Laughing Skull o' a place called Tangleheart.

Seems some really bad ancients come from there, and botani use a kind o' sap to grow them quickly.

I think we could use that for yer outpost. Hey, wood is wood, right?

I'll meet ya there.

text.title: The Lumber Mill
text.objectives: Speak to Penny Clobberbottom outside Tangleheart.
text.description:
Hey there, peach. We've got the lumber mill good and ready, but we gotta find a way of choppin' wood fast out here.

The Laughing Skull talked about Tangleheart, where the botani grow things quick as a quark.

I'm headin' there now.

text.title: 钢铁部落的入侵
text.objectives: 到诅咒之地的破碎滩头与守备官玛尔拉德谈一谈。
text.description: 奉瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王陛下之命，联盟所有身强力壮的公民都要到诅咒之地的破碎滩头向守备官玛尔拉德报到。$B$B穿过暴风城巫师圣殿中的传送门，即可直接抵达前线。$b$b这一全新的威胁被称作钢铁部落。他们已经夺取了黑暗之门的控制权，必须立即加以阻止。$B$B为了联盟的光荣与荣耀！
text.completion: The situation here is dire, $n. We have much to discuss.

english.title: Iron Horde Invasion
english.objectives: Speak with Vindicator Maraad at the Shattered Beachhead in Blasted Lands.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Vindicator Maraad at the Shattered Beachhead in Blasted Lands.$B$BUse the portal at the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind to head directly to the front line.$b$bThis new threat is known only as the Iron Horde. They have taken over the Dark Portal and must be stopped.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: The situation here is dire, $n. We have much to discuss.

text.title: 钢铁部落的入侵
text.objectives: 到诅咒之地的破碎码头与萨尔谈一谈。
text.description: 部落所有身强力壮的成员都必须奉命到诅咒之地向萨尔报到。$B$B穿过奥格瑞玛位于暗影裂口的传送门，即可直接抵达前线。$b$b这一全新的威胁被称作钢铁部落。他们已经夺取了黑暗之门的控制权，必须立即加以阻止。$B$B命运在召唤！
text.completion: The situation here is dire, $n. We have much to discuss.

english.objectives: Speak with Thrall at the Shattered Landing in Blasted Lands.
english.description: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Thrall in Blasted Lands.$B$BUse the portal at the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar to head directly to the front line.$b$bThis new threat is known only as the Iron Horde. They have taken over the Dark Portal and must be stopped$B$BDestiny calls!
english.completion: The situation here is dire, $n. We have much to discuss.

text.title: 荣耀的证明：拜奥兰特
text.objectives: 把战利品带到戈尔隆德的高山走廊，交给玛尔拉德。
text.description: 击败拜奥兰特后，你获得了一件值得去岗哨炫耀的战利品。$b$b把它交还给玛尔拉德，来提升你的荣耀！
text.completion: I've seen plant life mimic the vicious hydra before, but to improve on the design? Only in Gorgrond... excellent work $n.

english.title: Trophy of Glory: Biolante
english.objectives: Take the trophy to Maraad at Highpass in Gorgrond.
english.description: Defeating Biolante has yielded you a trophy worthy of showing off at your outpost. $b$bReturn this to Maraad to increase your glory!
english.completion: Мне доводилось видеть растения, имитирующие гидр, но чтобы имитация была лучше оригинала? Такое только в Горгронде возможно. Отличная работа, $p.

text.title: 荣耀的证明：拜奥兰特
text.objectives: 把战利品带到戈尔隆德的蛮兽岗哨，交给杜隆坦。
text.description: 击败拜奥兰特后，你获得了一件值得拾取的战利品。$b$b把它带到蛮兽岗哨交给杜隆坦。
text.completion: In this land even the plants turn into vicious monsters. Biolante was one of the worst, still as a plant until you were too close.$B$BA fitting end to such a beast...

english.title: Trophy of Glory: Biolante
english.objectives: Take the trophy to Durotan at Beastwatch in Gorgrond.
english.description: Defeating Biolante has yielded you a trophy worthy of acclaim.$b$bTake this to Durotan at Beastwatch.
english.completion: In these parts even plants turn into bloodthirsty monsters. Biogor was one of the most dangerous; it was motionless, like a plant, waiting in an ambush until the victim came too close. This monster deserved to die...

text.title: 战士的披风
text.objectives: 在沃高尔里找到一位能够帮助你的霜狼制皮匠。
text.description: 虽然这件披风如今已经失去了往日的风采，但精良的制作工艺还是让人过目难忘。如果换作是普通的披风，现在肯定已经破碎得不成样子了。$B$B也许沃高尔里的某位霜狼兽人会愿意帮你修补好它。
text.progress: Greetings, $R. do you require any repairs?
text.completion: This is a fine cloak! Sadly, we no longer have the resources to make them like this.

english.title: A Warrior's Shroud
english.objectives: Locate a Frostwolf leatherworker in Wor'gol that can help you.
english.description: Although this cloak has seen better days, the workmanship is still quite impressive. Any normal cloak would have most certainly fallen apart by now.$B$BPerhaps one of the Frostwolf orcs within Wor'gol would be willing to help you repair it.
english.progress: Greetings, $R. do you require any repairs?
english.completion: Славный плащ! Жаль только, что у нас больше нет ресурсов, чтобы делать такие.

text.title: 这是你的同伴吗？
text.objectives: 与雷克萨交谈，并为游侠艾达妮做担保。
text.description: 我发现这家伙躲在附近。她号称是你的同伴。$b$b这是真的吗？还是说她只是在我的篝火附近炖东西吃？
text.completion: Thank you for vouching for me, commander.
text.completed: Speak to Rangari Erdanii at Breaker's Crown.

english.title: Is This One of Yours?
english.objectives: Talk to Rexxar and vouch for Rangari Erdanii.

text.title: 越大越好
text.objectives: 使用建筑设计桌选择议政厅，并将你的要塞升至2级。
text.description:
听我说，头儿，我想我知道该怎么把这地方提高一个档次。更高的围墙。更多的建筑。让你在结束一整天的冒险之后，可以在舒适的空间内放松疲惫的身躯。

不过可别幻想免费午餐，这需要用到大量资源，但资源不就是派这个用的吗？

等你准备好，我们就在绘图桌上规划一下。肯定雄伟极了。
text.completion:
Now THAT'S what I'm talkin' about! Look at this place!

We've even got a pool out back. Little cold, sure, but ya can't always have a tropical paradise.

english.title: Bigger is Better
english.objectives: Use the Architect Table to select your Town Hall and upgrade your garrison to Tier 2.
english.description:
Ya know boss, I think I know how we can take this place to the next level. Bigger walls. More buildings. Some space to stretch your arms after a long day of adventuring.

Don't get me wrong, it's going to take a lot of resources, but what else are these things for?

We can plot it out on the drafting table whenever you're ready. It's going to be GLORIOUS.
english.completion:
Now THAT'S what I'm talkin' about! Look at this place!

We've even got a pool out back. Little cold, sure, but ya can't always have a tropical paradise.

text.objectives: 与游侠拉洁丝交谈，飞往铁港入口，攻击钢铁部落。
text.description: 有了玛戈隆之心，我们就有了对抗钢铁部落的利器。$b$b他们正在遥远北边的铁港入口处集结。虽然难度很高，但我们必须趁神器在手，抓住机会重挫钢铁部落。$b$b我们已经整装待发，只等你一声令下了。等你做好准备就去跟游侠拉洁丝谈一谈吧。
text.completion: We have dealt a great blow to the Iron Horde, commander. We will defeat them yet.

text.title: 重型武器
text.objectives: 在要塞附近寻找能帮忙修理的人。
text.description: 这是某种大规模杀伤性武器被烧毁的外壳。也许应该到你的要塞四处打听一下，看看有没有人能帮忙修好它。
text.progress: Yo, boss. Whatchya got for me?
text.completion: I think we could get into some serious trouble with this beauty!

text.title: 越大越好
text.objectives: 使用建筑设计桌选择议政厅，并将你的要塞升至2级。
text.description:
指挥官，我在研究图纸，你也许有兴趣了解下。

你觉得把围墙外扩，在这腾出空间造些别的建筑怎么样？我们军队的规模日渐扩大，地方显得有些狭小了，而且我也真心希望能把那些额外的图纸派上用场。

要是可以的话，请你看看桌上的图纸。只要一得到你的首肯，我就立即组织大家开工。
text.completion:
MUCH better!  A lot less bumping into walls to be sure.

There should be room to get in another building or two now. We can get the additional construction going whenever you're ready - just point me at anything you're interested in on the table here.
text.completed: Speak to Baros Alexston in your garrison.

english.title: Bigger is Better
english.objectives: Use the Architect Table to select your Town Hall and upgrade your garrison to Tier 2.
english.description:
Commander, I've been working on schematics that you might be interested in.

What do you think about pushing out the walls and making room to get some additional structures in here? Our forces have been growing, and things are getting a little cramped, and I'd really like us to put some of those additional blueprints to use.

If you could, take a look at the plans on the table here. As soon as I have your go ahead, I'll get everyone to work immediately.
english.completion:
MUCH better!  A lot less bumping into walls to be sure.

There should be room to get in another building or two now. We can get the additional construction going whenever you're ready - just point me at anything you're interested in on the table here.

text.description: 我还从没见过这样的东西！不过别担心，头儿，要是它真能把东西炸开，我就一定能修好它。$B$B我们肯定要用到一些零件，还得找来些弹药才行，放心，不会误伤自己人的。$B$B听上去那边的钢铁部落成员应该对爆炸这种事并不陌生。$B$B带上这些工具，我们去试试能不能搞到些备用零件吧！

If it can be used to blow things up, I can get it working again.$B$BWe are definitely going to need some parts--some sort of ammunition wouldn't hurt either.$B$BSounds like those Iron Horde guys over yonder are no stranger to things that go boom.$B$BTake these tools with you and let's see if we can't commandeer us some spare parts!
english.progress: Got the stuff yet boss?
english.completion: What did you think of my rapid disassembly tech? Pretty effective, yeah?

text.title: 他惹上了……植物怪
text.objectives: 找到黑铁坦克的驾驶员。
text.description: 你所看到的是那个名叫艾韵的原祖荆兽留下的踪迹。它当时正在追这只机械怪物和坐在里面的驾驶者。$b$b我相信驾驶员一定还活着，肯定被困在营地的废墟间了。$b$b如果你还想找到他们的话，最好马上行动。

english.title: He Drew Aggro...culture
english.objectives: Find the pilot of the Dark Iron tank.
english.description: What you saw was the wake of the genesaur, Iyu. It was chasing this mechanical monstrosity and the person who drove it.$b$bI believe the pilot of this vessel is still alive and trapped within the ruins of the camp.$b$bIf you wish them to be recovered, I recommend doing so now.
english.completion: Ah perfect. I'll get this up an' runnin' in no time.

text.title: 寻找纳特·帕格
text.objectives: 前往卡桑琅丛林的渔人码头，与纳特·帕格谈一谈。
text.description:
既然你有了证明，我们也许有机会说服纳特·帕格加入我们。

我之前听说他正在潘达利亚卡桑琅丛林的海岸边，跟当地的垂钓翁一起钓鱼，在那之后就再也没有他的消息了。到那去看看，向他展示你的收获，看看能不能把他带回来！

english.objectives: Travel to the Angler's Wharf in Krasarang Wilds and talk to Nat Pagle.
english.description:
Now that you have proof, we might just have a shot at convincing Nat Pagle to join us out here.

Last I heard, he was in fishing with the local Angler's faction out in Pandaria.  Somewhere off the coast of  Krasarang Wilds.  Head out there, show him your catch and see if you can get him to come back with you!

text.title: 伟大钓客的复出
text.objectives: 把纳特的日记书页交给拉克金，作为你找到他的证明。
text.description:
这是什么鱼种，你说是熔火鲶鱼？我还从没听说过，更别提亲眼看看了！

我得去找更多这样的鱼，那正是我生活的动力！如果钓这种鱼的过程真像你形容的那么美妙，我就更没理由放弃这个机会了。我把日记本里的这一页送给你，作为你找到我的证明，我稍后会回你的要塞找你的。
text.progress: You found Nat? The real Nat Pagle?!
text.completion: We should really catch some big one's when Nat's gets here!
text.giverWindow: 来自德拉诺霜火岭的罕见鱼种。

english.title: The Great Angler Returns
english.objectives: Return to Rak'jin with Nat's journal page as proof that you found him.
english.description:
What's this species, a molten catfish you say? I have never even heard of a fish like this, much less seen one in person!

I have to find more fish like this, it's what I live for! And if the fishing is as good as you say it is, there is just no way I can pass this opportunity up.  Take this page from my journal as proof that you found me and I will meet you back at your Garrison.
english.progress: Это правда Нат? ТОТ САМЫЙ Нат Пэгл?!
english.completion: Чтобы произвести на Пэгла впечатление, нам нужно поймать что-то очень-очень большое!
english.giverWindow: A rare species of fish from Frostfire Ridge in Draenor.

text.title: 正牌德拉诺垂钓翁
text.objectives: 在德拉诺的每个地区各捕捉一条巨鱼，然后带给纳特·帕格。
text.description:
如果你想让我永久性地为你提供帮助，就得先给我找来几种德拉诺的大鱼。到野外去，把你从所有周边区域里找到的最大的鱼带回来交给我。

这是我亲自为你制作的鱼饵，善加利用吧，我用它还从没失过手！
text.progress: What did you catch?
text.completion: These fish are exquisite, $n. Great job!
text.completed: Return to Nat Pagle at your Garrison.

english.title: A True Draenor Angler
english.objectives: Catch a Lunker in each of the  Draenor zones and bring them back to Nat Pagle.
english.description:
If you want me to help you permanently, you have to show me a few of these big Draenor catches first.  Head out into the wild and bring me back the biggest fish you can find from all the surrounding areas.

I made this custom lure for you to use, please take care of it, it's never let me down!
english.progress: Ну, каков твой улов?
english.completion: That's the fish, $n! All fish fish fish! You're doing great!
english.completed: Return to Nat Pagle at your Garrison.

text.title: 吸引纳特
text.objectives: 在霜火岭捕捉到一条熔火鲶鱼，然后交给拉克金。
text.description:
既然你已经在德拉诺充分锻炼了钓鱼技能，现在也许有机会说服纳特·帕格加入我们。

如果我们想让纳特不辞辛苦地到这儿来，就得把德拉诺最不可思议的珍稀鱼种作为能力的明证拿给他看。到霜火岭的熔岩池去，看看你能做些什么吧。你在德拉诺苦练了这么久，现在是检验成果的时候了。
text.progress: Any luck near those lava pools?
text.completion: This will do nicely... A fish like this would be hard for anyone to deny, especially Nat!
text.completed: Return to Rak'jin at your Garrison.

english.title: Luring Nat
english.objectives: Catch a Molten Catfish in Frostfire Ridge and bring it back to Rak'jin.
english.description:
Now that you are experienced enough with Draenor fishing, we might have a shot at convincing Nat Pagle to join us out here.

If we want Nat to actually come all the way out here, we are going to have to show him real proof of the incredible catches on Draenor.  Head out to the lava lakes here in Frostfire and see what you can do.  All that time you spend honing your skill here in Draenor should pay off now.
english.progress: Ну что, как там твоя рыбалка у лавовых озер?
english.completion: That's good... Such a fish will impress even those who are far from fishing, and Nata!

text.title: 我自己的要塞
text.objectives: 收集2000份要塞资源，然后用绘图桌选择你的议政厅，并将要塞升至3级。
text.description:
头儿！你猜怎么着？！我们刚到这里时，我订购了一张更大的新绘图纸，现在终于到货了。你知道更大的绘图纸意味着什么吗？

那等于是说我能画出一座更大的要塞！

要是我能把它画出来，建造当然也不在话下了！简而言之就是，只要你给我准备好几千块石头和木料就行。

你觉得怎么样啊，头儿？我们这就开工吗？
text.completion:
I think I could just fall over and die happy right now. It's a dream come true!

I already ordered some even larger draft paper, boss. Don't you worry...

english.objectives: Gather 2000 Garrison Resources and then use the Architect Table to select your Town Hall and upgrade your garrison to Tier 3.

It means I can draw a bigger fortress!

And if I can draw it, I can certainly make it! Making's the easy part, as long as you've got a few thousand stones and logs lying around.

So whada'ya say, boss? Shall we get building?

text.description: 希望我们的设施能够达到你的高标准。$b$b这里的旅馆是由加西亚·悦花经营的，在我心目中算得上是德拉诺最舒服的休憩之所。$b$b每天都有新成员通过传送门加入我们。其实有一位名叫柯比·麦格林的新成员今天才刚刚抵达传送门的这一侧。$b$b如果你想要买卖武器或护甲的话，守备官努瑞姆很愿意为你提供帮助。

In fact our latest recruit, Knewbie McGreen just came through the portal today.$b$bIf you are looking to trade for weapons or armor, Vindicator Nuurem will be happy to help.

If you speak with the flight master they should be able to provide you safe passage to the Wash.

text.title: Assault on Shattrath Harbor
text.objectives: Assault the Sargerei forces at Shattrath City in Talador.
text.description:
Shattrath City is in the hands of Sargerei forces under the leadership of the once Exarch, Socrethar.

The Shadow Council forces in the eastern portion of the city are gaining in power through the aid of demons from the Nether, and need to be culled before they become a threat to all of our operations.
text.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

text.title: 突袭石怒崖
text.objectives: 突袭霜火岭石怒崖的血槌食人魔。
text.description:
来自霜火岭的血槌食人魔一直在整个大陆的各条贸易路线上伏击往来商人，还强迫被俘的士兵在他们的炉渣矿井里工作。

暗影猎手洛坎下令救出那些被囚禁在石怒崖血槌大本营里的友方军队士兵。
text.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

english.title: Assault on Stonefury Cliffs
english.objectives: Assault the Bloodmaul ogres at Stonefury Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge.
english.description:
Bloodmaul ogres from Frostfire Ridge have been ambushing trade routes throughout the continent, and are putting captured soldiers to work in their slag mines.

Shadow Hunter Rokhan has requested the rescue of friendly troops that have been taken prisoner in the main Bloodmaul compound at Stonefury Cliffs.
english.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

objectiveDetails.description: 突袭石怒崖的血槌军队

text.title: The Ring of Blood: Skull Chewer!
text.objectives: Defeat Skull Chewer in the Ring of Blood.
text.description: Welcome to Nagrand's one and only Ring of Blood, where hopefuls become gladiators and gladiators become discarded piles of meat on the arena floor!$B$BTalk to me to start a fight, hop down into the ring, and fight for your life. It's positively brutal - and the crowd loves it!$B$BYou'll face off against an ogron that has a hankering for freshly severed heads. You'll be fine... and I'll be rich!
text.end: Defeat Skull Chewer in the Ring of Blood.

text.title: Assault on the Iron Siegeworks
text.objectives: Assault the Iron Horde forces at the Iron Siegeworks in Frostfire Ridge.
text.description:
Iron Horde war machines are being shipped onto battlefields by the dozens, and our forces are struggling to hold their ground. Most of these machines seem to be originating from the Iron Siegeworks in eastern Frostfire Ridge.

A strategic attack to disrupt and dismantle the Iron Horde at the siegeworks could be just what we need to turn the tide of the war.
text.completion: Word of the assault has already made it back, as have some spoils from the fight.$B$BWell done sir, if you don't mind me saying.

text.title: Assault on Magnarok
text.objectives: Assault the stone monstrosities at Magnarok in Frostfire Ridge.
text.description:
Colossal magnaron, gronn, and other stone monstrosities have been threatening our outposts in the west. Most seem to originate from Magnarok in Frostfire Ridge.

If we strike at them at their home, we should be able to force them back. It's risky, but it may be our best move. While you're there, see if you can recover any of our supplies.
text.completion: Word of the assault has already made it back, as have some spoils from the fight.$B$BWell done sir, if you don't mind me saying.

text.title: 突袭永茂丛林
text.objectives: 突袭戈尔隆德永茂丛林的木精部队。
text.description:
木精和它们召唤出的植物畸兽一直在渐渐蚕食着我们北边的哨站。我们每杀死一个植物怪，似乎都会生出新的来顶替它的位置。

伯德里克·格雷想出了一个直捣敌人腹地——永茂丛林的计划。他认为这样一来就能把敌人引回戈尔隆德的荒野，给我们争取到更多与之周旋的余地。
text.completion: Word of the assault has already made it back, as have some spoils from the fight.$B$BWell done sir, if you don't mind me saying.

english.title: Assault on the Everbloom Wilds
english.objectives: Assault the botani forces in the Everbloom Wilds of Gorgrond.
english.description:
Botani and the plant monstrosities they conjure have been slowly encroaching on our outposts in the north. For every plant we kill, new ones seem to rise in its place.

Bodrick Grey has put together a plan for striking at the heart of their lands, in Everbloom Wilds. He thinks this will draw them back into the wilds of Gorgrond, giving us more room to maneuver around them.
english.completion: Word of the assault has already made it back, as have some spoils from the fight.$B$BWell done sir, if you don't mind me saying.

objectiveDetails.description: 突袭永茂丛林的木精部队

text.title: Assault on the Broken Precipice
text.objectives: Assault the ogron forces at the Broken Precipice in Nagrand.
text.description:
Massive ogron have been battering our frontlines, and no matter how many we down, there seem to be more to replace them.

Most of these ogron appear to be coming from the Broken Precipice, deep in western Nagrand. If we're to stand a chance in the coming battles, we need to find a way to remove these ogron from the battlefield.
text.completion: Word of the assault has already made it back, as have some spoils from the fight.$B$BWell done sir, if you don't mind me saying.

text.title: Assault on Mok'gol Watchpost
text.objectives: Assault the Warsong forces at Mok'gol Watchpost in Nagrand.
text.description:
Warsong raiders out of Mok'gol Watchpost have been terrorizing anything and everything not behind a tall wall. We've warned travelers not to stray out alone, but many don't listen.

If we were to launch an assault on Mok'gol Watchpost, we would almost certainly put the Warsong back on the defensive, restricting most of their riders to Nagrand.
text.completion: Word of the assault has already made it back, as have some spoils from the fight.$B$BWell done sir, if you don't mind me saying.

text.title: 突袭黑潮栖木
text.objectives: 突袭影月谷黑潮栖木的钢铁部落军队。
text.description:
双头飞龙又重新出现在了我们对抗钢铁部落的战场上。倘若我们不从源头上遏制它们的话，很快就会失去对道路的控制权，被迫撤回哨站。

这些多出来的双头飞龙很有可能是从影月谷东南部的黑潮栖木飞来的。如果我们赶快行动，应该还来得及解决这个麻烦。
text.completion: Word of the assault has already made it back, as have some spoils from the fight.$B$BWell done sir, if you don't mind me saying.

english.title: Assault on Darktide Roost
english.objectives: Assault the Iron Horde forces at Darktide Roost in Shadowmoon Valley.
english.description:
There's been a resurgence of rylaks on the battlefield in our skirmishes against the Iron Horde. If we don't stop them at the source, we'll quickly lose control of the roads and be pushed back into our outposts.

The most likely source of these additional rylaks is in southeastern Shadowmoon Valley, at Darktide Roost. If we move quickly, we should still have time to get ahead of the problem.
english.completion: Word of the assault has already made it back, as have some spoils from the fight.$B$BWell done sir, if you don't mind me saying.

text.description:
Recent reports suggest a notable rise of activity by Sargerei forces at Socrethar's Rise in southern Shadowmoon Valley.

Socrathar's disciples pose a threat to draenei and our garrison alike. We need to quell them at our soonest convenience.

text.objectives: Join the battle in Ashran.
text.description:
As we do battle all across Draenor, the cowardly Horde try to seize our territory within Ashran.

Our men would be inspired to see you join the battlefield, striking terror into the hearts of the Horde.

text.objectives: 突袭塔拉多沙塔斯城中的萨格雷军队。
text.description:
沙塔斯城中的萨格雷军力每天都在增强，而且变得越来越大胆。我们决不能再对他们的威胁置之不理了。

如果你想到城市深处去对抗萨格雷的话，记得叫上几个同伴。
text.completion: Word of the assault has already made it back, as have some spoils from the fight.$B$BWell done sir, if you don't mind me saying.

english.objectives: Assault the Sargerei forces deep within Shattrath City in Talador.
english.description:

Bring allies if you wish to face the Sargerei so deep within the city.

text.title: 突袭黑石矿坑
text.objectives: 突袭戈尔隆德黑石矿坑中的黑石兽人。
text.description:
来自戈尔隆德黑石矿坑中的黑石大军是钢铁部落军队的中坚力量。如果我们能在他们自己的土地上粉碎他们的话，钢铁部落的其余成员就几乎没有跟我们抗衡的希望了。

要是你决意战斗，记得带上朋友一同前往。黑石氏族可没那么容易对付。
text.completion: Word of the assault has already made it back, as have some spoils from the fight.$B$BWell done sir, if you don't mind me saying.

english.title: Assault on the Pit
english.objectives: Assault the Blackrock orcs at the Pit in Gorgrond.
english.description:
The Blackrock forces based out of the Pit in Gorgrond make up the bulk of the Iron Horde army. If we crush them on their home soil, the rest of the Iron Horde will have little hope of standing against us.

If you choose the battle, bring friends. The Blackrock won't be defeated easily.

Rokhan has requested any available resources be dispatched to identify the threat and see if any of our men yet remain alive within the ruins.

text.title: 突击索克雷萨高地
text.objectives: 攻击影月谷索克雷萨高地的萨格雷军队。
text.description:
近来有情报显示，在影月谷南边索克雷萨高地的萨格雷军队呈现出了日渐频繁的活动之势。

索克雷萨的门徒对整个德拉诺都构成了威胁。决不能让那些家伙在我们鞭长莫及的地方建立落脚点。
text.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

english.title: Assault on Socrethar's Rise
english.objectives: Assault the Sargerei forces at Socrethar's Rise in Shadowmoon Valley.
english.description:
Recent reports suggest a notable rise of activity by Sargerei forces at Socrethar's Rise in southern Shadowmoon Valley.

Socrathar's disciples pose a threat all over Draenor. We must not allow them to gain a foothold so far from our reach.
english.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

text.title: 突袭黑潮栖木
text.objectives: 突袭影月谷黑潮栖木的钢铁部落军队。
text.description:
双头飞龙又重新出现在了我们对抗钢铁部落的战场上。倘若我们不从源头上遏制它们的话，很快就会失去对道路的控制权，被迫撤回哨站。

这些多出来的双头飞龙很有可能是从影月谷东南部的黑潮栖木飞来的。如果我们赶快行动，应该还来得及破坏敌人的行动。
text.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

english.title: Assault on Darktide Roost
english.objectives: Assault the Iron Horde forces at Darktide Roost in Shadowmoon Valley.
english.description:
There's been a resurgence of rylaks on the battlefield in our skirmishes against the Iron Horde. If we don't stop them at the source, we'll quickly lose control of the roads and be pushed back into our outposts.

The most likely source of these additional rylaks is in southeastern Shadowmoon Valley, at Darktide Roost. If we move quickly, we should be able to stop their operation cold.
english.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

text.title: Assault on Mok'gol Watchpost
text.objectives: Assault the Warsong force at Mok'gol Watchpost in Nagrand.
text.description:
Warsong raiders out of Mok'gol Watchpost have been terrorizing anything and everything not behind a tall wall. We've warned travelers not to stray out alone, but many don't listen.

If we were to launch an assault on Mok'gol Watchpost, we would almost certainly put the Warsong back on the defensive, restricting most of their riders to Nagrand.
