text.objectives: 突袭纳格兰破碎悬崖的独眼魔部队。
text.description:
巨大的独眼魔一直在冲击着我们的前线，而且不管我们干掉多少个，敌人似乎都会前仆后继的不断涌来。

这些独眼魔大多数都是从纳格兰遥远西部的破碎悬崖来的。如果我们想在接下来的战斗中立于不败之地，就必须想办法把这些独眼魔从战场上赶走。
text.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

english.title: Assault on the Broken Precipice
english.objectives: Assault the ogron forces at the Broken Precipice in Nagrand.
english.description:
Massive ogron have been battering our frontlines, and no matter how many we down, there seem to be more to replace them.

Most of these ogron appear to be coming from the Broken Precipice, deep in western Nagrand. If we're to stand a chance in the coming battles, we need to find a way to remove these ogron from the battlefield.
english.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

text.title: 突袭永茂丛林
text.objectives: 突袭戈尔隆德永茂丛林的木精部队。
text.description:
木精和它们召唤出的植物畸兽一直在渐渐蚕食着我们北边的哨站。我们每杀死一个植物怪，似乎都会生出新的来顶替它的位置。

洛坎想出了一个直捣敌人腹地——永茂丛林的计划。他认为这样一来就能把敌人引回戈尔隆德的丛林里，给我们争取到更多与之周旋的余地。
text.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

english.title: Assault on the Everbloom Wilds
english.objectives: Assault the Botani forces in the Everbloom Wilds in Gorgrond.
english.description:
Botani and the plant monstrosities they conjure have been slowly encroaching on our outposts in the north. For every plant we kill, new ones seem to rise in its place.

Rokhan has put together a plan for striking at the heart of their lands, in Everbloom Wilds. He thinks this will draw them back into the jungles of Gorgrond, giving us more room to maneuver around them.
english.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

objectiveDetails.description: 突袭永茂丛林的木精部队

text.title: Assault on the Iron Siegeworks
text.objectives: Assault the Iron Horde forces at the Iron Siegeworks in Frostfire Ridge.
text.description:
Iron Horde war machines are being shipped onto battlefields by the dozens, and our forces are struggling to hold their ground. Most of these machines seem to be originating from the Iron Siegeworks in eastern Frostfire Ridge.

A strategic attack to disrupt and dismantle the Iron Horde at the siegeworks could be just what we need to turn the tide of the war.

If we strike at them at their home, we should be able to force them back. It's risky, but it may be our best move. While you're there, see if you can recover any of our supplies.

text.description:
来自戈尔隆德黑石矿坑中的黑石大军是钢铁部落军队的中坚力量。如果我们能在他们自己的土地上粉碎他们的话，钢铁部落的其余成员就几乎没有跟我们抗衡的希望了。

要是你决意战斗，记得带上朋友一同前往。黑石氏族可没那么容易对付。
text.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

english.objectives: Assault the Blackrock forces at the Pit in Gorgrond.
english.description:
The Blackrock forces based out of the Pit in Gorgrond make up the bulk of the Iron Horde army. If we crush them on their home soil, the rest of the Iron Horde will have little hope of standing against us.

If you choose the battle, bring friends. The Blackrock won't be defeated easily.

text.objectives: Defeat Mogor in the Ring of Blood.
text.description: You've really done it this time, champ. Mogor has challenged you to uphold his title as lord of the ring!$B$BI wish I could give you tips to help you make it out of there in one piece, but I've never seen Mogor fight. Nobody's ever gotten this far!$B$BGood luck.
text.completion: You did it. You really did it! You're the new lord of the ring!
text.end: Defeat Mogor in the Ring of Blood.

text.objectives: 在阿什兰的战争之矛与列兵重蹄谈一谈。
text.description: 我们在阿什兰的基地就快完成了，指挥官。$b$b要是你能到那去，对他们的集结区表示认可的话，兄弟们一定会士气大振。$b$b如果你愿意，我可以为你安排飞行。
text.completion: Commander! I am humbled to be able to serve you. The Lieutenant requests your presence.

english.title: Ashran Appearance
english.objectives: Speak with Private Stomphoof at Warspear in Ashran.
english.description: Our base on Ashran is almost complete, commander.$b$bIt would be a huge show of support if you could make a trip out there and put your stamp of approval on their staging area.$b$bI can arrange a flight if you are interested.
english.completion: Commander! I am humbled to be able to serve you. The Lieutenant requests your presence.

text.objectives: 与克拉吉尔中尉谈一谈
text.description: 克拉吉尔中尉说你也许会来。$b$b我奉命带你前往旅馆。
text.completion: Throm-Ka, commander. I am pleased to finally meet you in person.
text.completed: 在阿什兰的战争之矛与克拉吉尔中尉谈一谈。

text.title: 激励阿什兰
text.objectives: 与娜宁·晨光、贝斯卡·赤牙和扎林谈一谈。
text.description: 希望我们的设施能够达到你的高标准。$b$b这里的旅馆是由娜宁·晨光经营的，在我心目中算得上是德拉诺最舒服的休憩之所。$b$b每天都有新成员通过传送门加入我们。其实有一位名叫扎林的新成员今天才刚刚抵达传送门的这一侧。$b$b如果你想要买卖武器或护甲的话，贝斯卡·赤牙很愿意为你提供帮助。
text.completion: Thank you again for taking the time to visit, commander. You have no idea how much it means to us.
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant Kragil at Warspear in Ashran.

english.title: Inspiring Ashran
english.objectives: Speak with Narnin Dawnglow, Beska Redtusk, and Zarjhin.
english.description: I hope you will find our facilities to be up to your high standards.$b$bThis inn is run by Narnin Dawnglow, in my opinion this is the best place to hearth in Draenor.$b$bWe have new recruits coming through the portal daily. In fact one of out latest recruits, Zarjhin, just came through the portal today.$b$bIf you are looking for weapons or armor Beska Redtusk will be happy to help.
english.completion: Thank you again for taking the time to visit, commander. You have no idea how much it means to us.
english.completed: Return to Lieutenant Kragil at Warspear in Ashran.

text.title: 烈焰美人
text.objectives: 与薇薇安谈一谈
text.description: 在你离开之前，应该去见一个人。$b$b她也许会把你的东西给点着，但我相信她绝对是德拉诺这一边最出色的法师。$b$b你应该带她一起上前线，指挥官。
text.completion: So, you are the commander? Sylvanas sent me to find you.
text.completed: 在阿什兰的战争之矛与薇薇安谈一谈。

text.title: 新兵的复仇
text.objectives: 消灭18个血鬃刃牙虎人。
text.description: 我……我不行了。我的灵魂很快就会回到鸦母的身边。$b$b求你了，陌生人……一定要为我复仇！干掉这些肮脏的野兽。
text.completion: The lives of all the flock are precious.$BI'm glad to know that his murderers have been brought to justice.$B$BThank you, $n, you have done us a great honor.
text.completed: Return to Vakora of the Flock within the Nest of the Ravenspeakers.

english.title: The Initiate's Revenge
english.objectives: Kill 18 Bloodmane Saberon.
english.description: I... I'm finished. My spirit will be with the Raven Mother soon.$b$bI beg of you, stranger... avenge me! Slay these filthy beasts.
english.completion:
Наши жизни слишком ценны.
Приятно знать, что убийцы понесли заслуженную кару.

Спасибо тебе, $n, ты $gоказал:оказала; нам великую честь.
english.completed: Return to Vakora of the Flock within the Nest of the Ravenspeakers.

text.title: Phantom Potion
text.objectives: Bring Gimlett Ginfizz 10 Ghost Truffles.
text.description: Every turn you take in Ashran you run into danger. But don't fret $n, I've developed the perfect solution. It's my very own riff on the popular Invisibility Potion. $B$BI'm just missing one of the ingredients: cave mushrooms. $B$BLuckily, a variety grows right here in Ashran.
text.progress: Are those the truffles?
text.completion: Here she is! Careful with her, these potions have a reputation for mysteriously disappearing.
text.completed: Return to Gimlett Ginfizz in Stormshield Stronghold.

text.title: The Flock's Revenge
text.objectives: Kill 18 Bloodmane Saberon.
text.description: The Bloodmane took several of our initiates when they ambushed our ritual in Ravenskar. They must be taught that the flock will never allow such a deed to go unpunished!$b$bWe will kill one of their tribe for each of the flock that has fallen!$b$bhead into their accursed home of Bloodmane Valley and slaughter as many of them as you can find.
text.completed: Return to High Ravenspeaker Krikka within the Nest of the Ravenspeakers.

text.title: 抢先一步
text.objectives: 在救赎之地与守备官玛尔拉德谈一谈。
text.description: 指挥官，守备官玛尔拉德跟塞林·暗砧还有伊瑞尔一起去追踪钢铁部落在附近森林里的行动了。$B$B他们正在西南边的一处小高地上等着你呢。
text.completion: Ah, Commander $n. Good to see you. Now our party is complete.

english.title: One Step Ahead
english.objectives: Speak to Vindicator Maraad at Redemption Rise.
english.description: Commander, Vindicator Maraad set off with Yrel and Thaelin Darkanvil to track the Iron Horde's movements in the nearby forest.$B$BThey await your arrival on a small rise to the southwest.
english.completion: Ah, Commander $n. Good to see you. Now our party is complete.

text.title: 侵蚀感染
text.objectives: 在永茂林地里找到菲拉克的研究成果、艾里塔克的毒腺和3枚枯竭的永茂之种，然后回去找长青的菲拉克。
text.description: 身为永茂林地之主，我的任务就是对大自然进行武器化改造。$B$B你可能已经在游览我领地的旅途中见识到了我的劳动果实。$B$B通过破坏性的感染，我的发现已经让同类控制了德拉诺的侵略物种。我说的是对于侵略生物体完全而系统的控制——身心兼备。$B$B既然你成了我的主人，我愿意把这些礼物送给你，但首先你必须从永茂林地里将我的研究成果和工具找回来。$B$B完成之后，这伟大的力量就归你了。
text.progress: Retrieve what I have asked for, master. I will show you the true strength of nature.
text.completion: Within this pouch I have placed three Everbloom seeds. You merely have to crush the seed to release the spores within. Inhale deeply and let the subversive infestation take hold.$B$BOnce empowered you will become an unstoppable force of nature; though be warned, I have modified these seeds to cause you minimal harm, thus their potency is somewhat reduced.$B$BYou must not undergo the transformation too frequently.$B$BShould you require more seeds I will offer them to you - for a small price.
text.completed: Return to Phylarch the Evergreen at your garrison.

english.title: Subversive Infestation
english.objectives: Recover Phylarch's Research, Xeri'tac's Venom Gland, and 3 Depleted Everbloom Seeds from the Everbloom and return to Phylarch the Evergreen.
english.description: As lord of the Everbloom my charge was the weaponization of nature.$B$BYou have likely seen the fruits of my labor in your journeys across my world.$B$BMy discoveries have allowed my kind to control the invasive species of Draenor through subversive infestation. I speak of total systemic control of the invading organism - the mind and the body.$B$BNow that you are my master I offer these gifts to you, but first you must retrieve my research and tools from the Everbloom.$B$BDo this and great power is yours.
english.progress: Retrieve what I have asked for, master. I will show you the true strength of nature.
english.completion: Within this pouch I have placed three Everbloom seeds. You merely have to crush the seed to release the spores within. Inhale deeply and let the subversive infestation take hold.$B$BOnce empowered you will become an unstoppable force of nature; though be warned, I have modified these seeds to cause you minimal harm, thus their potency is somewhat reduced.$B$BYou must not undergo the transformation too frequently.$B$BShould you require more seeds I will offer them to you - for a small price.
english.completed: Return to Phylarch the Evergreen at your garrison.

text.objectives: 消灭掉尽可能多的影月兽人和他们的虚空爪牙。
text.description: [PH]Commander! You just missed a group of rangari with some disturbing news. The Shadowmoon Orcs have been spotted in the hills above Anguish Fortress. Those orcs must be up there trying to summon more minions from the Void!$B$BIf we do not intervene all we have gained in Shadowmoon Valley might be lost!

text.title: 暗影议会入侵！
text.objectives: 击退暗影议会对你要塞的入侵。$B$B（再次与克劳勒中士交谈来开始行动）
text.description: 恶魔已经近在咫尺了，指挥官。连牛奶都是酸的。一只老母羊今天早上还白了我一眼。天空看着也不太……对劲。
text.completion: They're defeated! I'm glad we came here, Commander. To Draenor. Fighting against demons reminds me why we fight for the Alliance.
text.completed: Speak with Sergeant Crowler in your garrison.

english.title: Shadow Council Invasion!
english.objectives: Repel the Shadow Council invasion of your garrison.$B$B(Speak with Sergeant Crowler again to begin)
english.description: The demons are at our heels, Commander. Cow's milk is sour. A crone gave me an evil look this morning. The sky just doesn't seem... right.
english.completion: They're defeated! I'm glad we came here, Commander. To Draenor. Fighting against demons reminds me why we fight for the Alliance.
english.completed: Speak with Sergeant Crowler in your garrison.

text.title: 暗影议会入侵！
text.objectives: 击退暗影议会对你要塞的入侵。$B$B（再次与格里姆加中士交谈来开始行动）
text.description: 在我的血液中燃起了冷焰，指挥官。就像术士的魔爪攫住了我的心。让暗影议会自食苦果吧！
text.completion: Waugh! We beat back the demons, Commander. My blood's still boiling from it. My eyes aren't turning red, are they?
text.completed: Speak with Sergeant Grimjaw in your garrison.

english.title: Shadow Council Invasion!
english.objectives: Repel the Shadow Council invasion of your garrison.$B$B(Speak with Sergeant Grimjaw again to begin)
english.description: There's a cold fire in my blood, Commander. Like a warlock has my heart in his claw. Let the Shadow Council show themselves!
english.completion: Уфф! Мы отбились от этих проклятых демонов, командир. Но моя кровь до сих пор словно кипит. Посмотри – у меня глаза не красные?
english.completed: Speak with Sergeant Grimjaw in your garrison.

text.title: 从天而降
text.objectives: 在塔拉多的阿鲁纳附近找到塑晶者巴伦。
text.description: 拜托了，旅行者，我需要你的帮助。$B$B我的家园阿鲁纳被鸦人毁了。它们从峰林猛扑下来，杀死了所有想要逃走的人。我的家人……没能逃出来。$B$B我的兄弟巴伦留在后面寻找他在混乱中走散的女儿。算我求你了，到阿鲁纳去找找巴伦吧。$B$B我就只剩下他唯一一个亲人了。
text.completion: Akhan is alive? Light bless us - some good news!

english.title: They Came From Above
english.objectives: Find Crystal-Shaper Barum near Aruuna in Talador.
english.description: Please, traveler, I need your help.$B$BAruuna, my home, has been destroyed by the arakkoa. They swooped down from their spires and killed anyone who tried to escape. My family... did not make it out.$B$B My brother Barum stayed behind to find his daughter amidst the chaos. I beseech you, please, go to Aruuna and find Barum.$B$BHe is the only family I have left.
english.completion: Is Ahan alive? Bless us, Light, that's the good news!

text.title: 食人魔传送门
text.objectives: 在德拉诺收集25块食人魔道标石，并用它们激活一道食人魔传送门。
text.description: 在塔拉多总共有六道特殊的传送门，是食人魔法师在很久以前建造的。我们发现这些传送门的力量并未随着时间的流逝而衰减。$b$b要是你能收集到足够多的食人魔道标石，就能激活这些古老的传送门了，我们可以建造一道单程传送门，从你的要塞通往那个位置。
text.completion: Your efforts will be well rewarded, $n. The ancient waygates now serve you.
text.completed: Return to the Mage Tower in your Garrison.
text.giverWindow: 这些传送门是食人魔在德拉诺建立的古老旅行枢纽，现在能够为我们所用了。

english.title: Ogre Waygates
english.objectives: Collect 25 Ogre Waystones and use them to activate an Ogre Waygate in Draenor.
english.description: Six unique gates exist in Draenor, built by ogre magi in ages past.  We've discovered their potency has not diminished over the millennia.$b$bIf you can collect enough ogre waystones to activate one of these ancient waygates, we can build a one-way portal from your garrison to that location.
english.completion: Your efforts will be well rewarded, $n. The ancient waygates now serve you.
english.completed: Return to the Mage Tower in your Garrison.
english.giverWindow: Once an ancient travel network for the Ogres of Draenor, these waygates are now available for our use.

text.title: 宾奇维斯零件工厂
text.objectives: 与杜加尔·朗德瑞克交谈，飞往宾奇维斯零件工厂。
text.description: 指挥官，今天早上来了一位地精信使。$b$b他说自己是从阿兰卡峰林一个名叫宾奇维斯零件工厂的地方来的。他们那遭遇了某种生态灾难，急需我们的帮助。$b$b如果我们能赢得他们的信任，那就值了。到那去看看我们能做些什么吧。$b$b我已经跟飞行管理员谈过了，他会为你提供特殊飞行服务。
text.completion: Hey, you're from that Alliance base right?$B$BGlad you made the trip because we really could use your help!

english.description: Commander, a goblin courier arrived this morning.$b$bHe mentioned that he is from a settlement in the Spires of Arak called the Pinchwhistle Gearworks. They have requested our assistance with some sort of ecological disaster.$b$bIf we can earn their trust it'll be worth the effort. Head down there and see what sort of assistance we can provide.$b$bI've already spoken to the flight master and he's set up a special flight to get you out there.
english.completion: Hey, you're from that Alliance base right?$B$BGlad you made the trip because we really could use your help!

text.description: 指挥官，今天早上来了一位信使。$b$b他说自己是从阿兰卡峰林一个名叫宾奇维斯零件工厂的地精居住地来的。他们那遭遇了某种生态灾难，急需我们的帮助。$b$b我们眼下人手不足，可如果能赢得他们的信任，也许就能获得宝贵的盟友。$b$b到那去看看我们能做些什么吧。我已经跟飞行管理员谈过了，他会为你提供特殊飞行服务。

I've already spoken to the flight master and he's set up a special flight to get you out there.

text.title: 吸引纳特
text.objectives: 在影月谷里捕捉到一条魔法鲑鱼，并交给萨古米。
text.description:
既然你已经在德拉诺充分锻炼了钓鱼技能，现在也许有机会说服纳特·帕格加入我们。

如果我们想让纳特不辞辛苦地到这儿来，就得把德拉诺最不可思议的珍稀鱼种作为能力的明证拿给他看。到影月谷当地的水域中去，看看你能做些什么吧。你在德拉诺苦练了这么久，现在是检验成果的时候了。
text.progress: Find anything worth keeping?
text.completion: This will do nicely... A fish like this would be hard for anyone to deny, especially Nat!
text.completed: Return to Segumi at your Garrison.

english.title: Luring Nat
english.objectives: Catch an Arcane Trout in Shadowmoon Valley and bring it back to Segumi.
english.description:
Now that you are experienced enough with Draenor fishing, we might have a shot at convincing Nat Pagle to join us out here.

If we want Nat to actually come all the way out here, we are going to have to show him real proof of the incredible catches on Draenor.  Head out to local waters here in Shadowmoon Valley and see what you can do.  All that time you spend honing your skill here in Draenor should pay off now.
english.progress: Find anything worth keeping?
english.completion: This will do nicely... A fish like this would be hard for anyone to deny, especially Nat!
english.completed: Return to Segumi at your Garrison.

text.objectives: Obtain 2 Stone Hunks O' Gargoyle from Carrion Gargoyles in the Eastern Carrion Fields.  Return to Lord Bevis when the task is complete.
text.description: You there... you look the fighting type.  I want some sweet Revenge on the Scourge that killed my family.  Go get me 2 Stone Hunks O' Gargoyle so that I can throw them on the ground and stomp on them violently until they are mashed into itty bitty pebbly bits. $b$bYes. Go. Kill.

text.title: 德拉诺之王
text.objectives: 在PvP战斗中消灭敌对玩家，获得20块破碎骨骼，然后在白骨祭坛放置一份祭品，赢取一份胜利者的礼物。
text.description: 杜隆坦……$B$B<拉扎库尔啐了一口。>$B$B他只会躲在那面求和的白旗后面，靠所谓外交手段把我们不共戴天的死敌争取过去。$B$B就是那些敌人夺取了我们的家园，还把我们从祖祖辈辈生活过的土地上赶走。$B$B对付那些德莱尼和他们新结交的懦夫联盟只有一个办法——那就是以血还血。$B$B跟我一起粉碎我们的敌人吧。我们会用联盟的白骨祭奠这片神圣的土地，并赢得给酋长的献礼！$B$B等你嗜血的欲望得到满足后再回来吧。
text.completion: We may kill from sky break to sky fall and still our work will never be done. Yet at the end of days when we are measured for our accomplishments, only the bloody wake that we have left behind us will show our true strength. For this reason you must never stop the slaughter of those that would seek to harm us and our loved ones.$B$BPromise me, $n.$B$BNever. Stop.

english.title: Warlord of Draenor
english.objectives: Kill Enemy Players in Player versus Player combat to earn 20 Broken Bones then place an offering at the Altar of Bones to Earn a Conqueror's Tribute.
english.description: Durotan...$B$B<Raza'kul spits.>$B$BHe cowers behind the white flag of peace, relying upon diplomacy to win over our sworn enemies.$B$BEnemies that have taken our homes and driven us from our ancestral lands.$B$BThere is only one way to deal with the draenei and their newfound alliance of cowards - blood for blood.$B$BJoin me in crushing our enemies. Together we will flood this hallowed ground with the bones of the Alliance and earn tributes fit for a warchief!$B$BReturn here when your bloodthirst is sated.
english.completion: We may kill from sky break to sky fall and still our work will never be done. Yet at the end of days when we are measured for our accomplishments, only the bloody wake that we have left behind us will show our true strength. For this reason you must never stop the slaughter of those that would seek to harm us and our loved ones.$B$BPromise me, $n.$B$BNever. Stop.

text.title: 德拉诺之王
text.objectives: 在PvP战斗中消灭敌对玩家，获得20块破碎骨骼，然后在白骨祭坛放置一份祭品，赢取一份胜利者的礼物。
text.description: 当我们的族人被兽人渣滓毁去家园的时候 ，那些大主教们却无动于衷地为琐事争执不休。如果他们不肯对我们的敌人举起反抗的拳头，那就让我来吧。$B$B我想要加入你的联盟，将部落从这个世界上抹去。我指的是所有部落——不管是“钢铁”还是什么。$B$B我脚下的这个祭坛，代表着对抗我们部落敌人的战斗荣耀。把祭品放上去，赢取一份你用战斗换来的胜利者的礼物吧。$B$B干掉他们，一个不留。
text.completion: It is a start, to be certain, but there is much work to be done if Draenor is to be saved. Show no mercy, for they will show none to you.$B$BThe only warlords left upon Draenor will be you and I.

english.title: Warlord of Draenor
english.objectives: Kill Enemy Players in Player versus Player combat to earn 20 Broken Bones then place an offering at the Altar of Bones to Earn a Conqueror's Tribute.
english.description: The Exarchs do nothing but squabble amongst themselves over petty issues while our people are slaughtered in their homes by orc filth. If they will not raise a fist of defiance against our enemies, I will.$B$BI wish to join your Alliance and rid this world of Horde. ALL HORDE - "Iron" or otherwise.$B$BThis Altar of Bones that I stand upon represents glory in battle against our Horde enemy. Place an offering upon it and earn a conqueror's tribute worthy of your unrelenting bloodthirst.$B$BKill. Them. All.
english.completion: It is a start, to be certain, but there is much work to be done if Draenor is to be saved. Show no mercy, for they will show none to you.$B$BThe only warlords left upon Draenor will be you and I.

text.title: 黑暗之门
text.objectives: 到诅咒之地的黑暗之门下方与大法师卡德加谈一谈。
text.description: 你是$n对吧？欢迎来到这里。我们需要调动所有身强力壮的$c一起行动。$b$b我正在集结艾泽拉斯最强大的勇士穿越这道黑暗之门，阻止钢铁部落的入侵。这也许是拯救艾泽拉斯的唯一机会了。$b$b你愿意加入我们吗？
text.completion: Looks to me like we ended up in the right place.

english.title: The Dark Portal
english.objectives: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at the foot of the Dark Portal in Blasted Lands.
english.description: $n, is it? I'm glad you're here. We can use every able-bodied $c that we can get.$b$bI am assembling a coalition of Azeroth's strongest to step through this Dark Portal and stop the Iron Horde invasion. This may be the only way to save Azeroth.$b$bWill you join us?
english.completion: Looks to me like we ended up in the right place.

text.title: 伟大钓客的复出
text.objectives: 把纳特的日记书页交给萨古米，作为你找到他的证明。
text.description:
这是什么鱼种，你说是魔法鲑鱼？我还从没听说过，更别提亲眼看看了！

我得去找更多这样的鱼，那正是我生活的动力！如果钓这种鱼的过程真像你形容的那么美妙，我就更没理由放弃这个机会了。我把日记本里的这一页送给你，作为你找到我的证明，我稍后会去你的要塞找你的。
text.progress: You found Nat? The real Nat Pagle?!
text.completion: We should really catch some big one's when Nat's gets here!
text.giverWindow: 来自德拉诺影月谷的罕见鱼种。

english.title: The Great Angler Returns
english.objectives: Return to Segumi with Nat's journal page as proof that you found him.
english.description:
What's this species, an arcane trout you say? I have never even heard of a fish like this, much less seen one in person!

I have to find more fish like this, it's what I live for! And if the fishing is as good as you say it is, there is just no way I can pass this opportunity up.  Take this page from my journal as proof that you found me and I will meet you back at your Garrison.
english.progress: You found Nat? The real Nat Pagle?!
english.completion: We should really catch some big one's when Nat's gets here!
english.giverWindow: A rare species of fish from Shadowmoon Valley in Draenor.

text.title: 宿敌：猎人与猎物
text.objectives: 在角斗士圣殿烧毁一个宿敌雕像，然后跟拉扎库尔谈一谈。
text.description: 敌人包围着我们，而且他们的人数每一天都在增长。是时候向他们的大军发动决定性打击了，勇士。$B$B在我身边矗立着我们最憎恨的敌人的雕像。你将给他们带去毁灭，$n。你将成为他们的宿敌，令敌人一看见你就抱头鼠窜。$B$B现在选出你想要宣泄怒火的目标，并烧毁你要灭除的种族雕像吧。等你做好选择之后，就来跟我谈谈。
text.completion: A last warning: once you have accepted this choice you cannot reverse it or make a new choice until you complete your mission$B$BIf your choice is certain, your aim will be true.$B$BStrike fear in the hearts and minds of the enemy! For the Horde. For Draenor.
text.completed: Return to Raza'kul at the Gladiator's Sanctum.

english.title: Nemesis: Hunter - Hunted
english.objectives: Burn a Nemesis Effigy at the Gladiator's Sanctum then speak to Raza'kul.
english.description: Our enemies surround us, and with each passing day their numbers grow. It is time to make a decisive strike against their armies, champion.$B$BAround me stand effigies of our most hated adversaries. You will be their downfall, $n. You will become nemesis and they will run in fear at the sight of you.$B$BNow select the target of your rage and burn in effigy that race which you mean to eradicate. Speak to me when you have made your selection.
english.completion: A last warning: once you have accepted this choice you cannot reverse it or make a new choice until you complete your mission$B$BIf your choice is certain, your aim will be true.$B$BStrike fear in the hearts and minds of the enemy! For the Horde. For Draenor.
english.completed: Return to Raza'kul at the Gladiator's Sanctum.

text.title: 宿敌：化为死神
text.objectives: 在德拉诺的PvP战斗中击败一名人类玩家，并夺取他们身上的人类之心。
text.description: 你已经选好了目标，他们很快就能感受到你无情的怒火，但首先，你必须深入德拉诺的荒野，在一场生死大战中将一位人类跳动的心挖出来。带着你的战利品回来找我吧。$B$B通过敌人的心，灵魂将与你的感知力相协调，使你获得超人的视野与敏锐的听觉——更加便于你追踪猎物，占尽优势。
text.progress: Have you recovered the heart of a worthy foe?
text.completion: With this heart you will see and hear things as only the great spirits can. Your enemy will be unable to hide from your unrelenting assaults.
text.completed: Return to Raza'kul at the Gladiator's Sanctum.

english.title: Nemesis: Becoming Death
english.objectives: Kill a Human Player in Player versus Player combat while in Draenor and retrieve their Human Heart.
english.description: You have chosen your quarry and surely soon they will feel your merciless wrath, but first you must venture out into the wilds of Draenor and rip out the still-beating heart of a human in mortal combat. Return here with your prize.$B$BThrough the heart of your enemy the spirits will attune your senses, granting you second sight and keenness in hearing - all to stalk your prey and claim dominance.
english.progress: Have you recovered the heart of a worthy foe?
english.completion: With this heart you will see and hear things as only the great spirits can. Your enemy will be unable to hide from your unrelenting assaults.
english.completed: Return to Raza'kul at the Gladiator's Sanctum.

text.title: Tracking Quest: Defense of Karabor - Celebration Scene Finished

english.title: Tracking Quest: Defense of Karabor - Celebration Scene Finished

text.title: 驯服塔布羊
text.objectives: 对一只幼年银鬃塔布羊使用塔布羊套索，然后跟着它，直到将它驯服。
text.description: 如果我们想在这片荒野里派遣巡逻兵，就得给我们的军队配备迅捷的坐骑才行。我们可以捕捉幼兽，带回这里训练，最终把它们打造成令人生畏的战争巨兽。$B$B塔布羊是德拉诺速度最快的生物，因此捕捉它们的难度也要大得多。拿上这个塔布羊套索，前往影月谷。骑上坐骑，套住一只幼年塔布羊，跟着它直到将它驯服为止。别让它跑得离你太远！
text.completion: That talbuk's already settled down for the night. It will need some rest and grooming before it's ready for the next stage in its training.
text.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Taming a Talbuk
english.objectives: Use the Talbuk Lasso on a Young Silverpelt and follow it until it is tamed.
english.description: If we're going to start sending out patrols in this wilderness, we'll need swift mounts for our troops. We can capture young beasts and bring them back here for training, eventually turning them into formidable beasts of war.$B$BThe talbuk is one of Draenor's fastest creatures, and that makes them just that much more difficult to capture. Take this talbuk lasso and head out to Shadowmoon Valley. Mount up and rope one of the young talbuk, and follow it until it's tamed. Don't let it get too far from you!
english.completion: That talbuk's already settled down for the night. It will need some rest and grooming before it's ready for the next stage in its training.
english.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 捕捉裂蹄牛
text.objectives: 对一只幼年冰蹄牛使用裂蹄牛套索，然后跟着它，直到将它驯服。
text.description: 你好啊，朋友。我听说你刚好要找一位野兽大师。我从诺森德冰封雪飘的高山上而来，现在终于能抖落这一身白雪了。$B$B在这片荒蛮的土地上生活着许多可供驯服的生物，我们可以将它们打造成令人生畏的战争巨兽，骑在我们士兵们的胯下。强大的裂蹄牛让我想起了我家乡那边的猛犸象。拿上这个套索，前往霜火岭的北部区域吧。骑上坐骑，用它捕捉一只幼年裂蹄牛。
text.completion: I have bedded the clefthoof down for the night, it will need rest before it is ready for training.
text.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

english.title: Capturing a Clefthoof
english.objectives: Use the Clefthoof Lasso on a Young Icehoof and follow it until it is tamed.
english.description: Greetings, friend. I have been told that you are in need of a master of beasts. I come from the icy slopes of Northrend to finally shake this snow from my fur.$B$BThis savage land holds many creatures that we may tame so that our forces may ride on formidable war mounts. The mighty clefthoof reminds me of the mammoths from my home. Take this lasso and head out to the northern reaches of Frostfire Ridge. Mount up and use it to capture one of the young beasts.
english.completion: I have bedded the clefthoof down for the night, it will need rest before it is ready for training.
english.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

text.title: 驯服野猪
text.objectives: 对一只幼年石牙野猪使用野猪套索，跟着它直到将它驯服。
text.description: 你看见他们这的野猪了吗？个头比我还要大！我们干嘛不弄只来呢？$B$B你得前往戈尔隆德去完成这项任务。在那荒无人烟的地方，你会找到我们的目标。
text.completion: That boar has taken to the hay. We'll let it rest up a bit before more training.
text.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Besting a Boar
english.objectives: Use the Boar Lasso on a Young Rocktusk and follow it until it is tamed.
english.description: Have you seen the boars they have here? Bigger than I am! Let's get one of them, why not?$B$BYou're going to have to head to Gorgrond for that task. Way out in the desolate regions, you'll find the ones we're lookin' for.
english.completion: That boar has taken to the hay. We'll let it rest up a bit before more training.
english.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 驯服野狼
text.objectives: 对一只幼年啸狼使用野狼套索，跟着它直到将它驯服。
text.description: 接下来的这项任务将要挑战你的极限了，指挥官。狼是德拉诺最凶蛮的野兽。$B$B纳格兰的狼群尤其凶猛，强大的战歌氏族将它们豢养成坐骑，能在几秒钟之内把人撕成碎片。而且比你之前见过的任何猛兽都更加迅速和矫捷。$B$B这是给你的套索。祝你好运，别让自己命丧狼口！
text.completion: It almost bit me, but I've got it bedded down and happy. A wolf, in my stables! Who'd have thought?
text.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Wrangling a Wolf
english.objectives: Use the Wolf Lasso on a Young Snarler and follow it until it is tamed.
english.description: This next one will test you to your very limits, commander. The wolf is the most savage beast in all of Draenor.$B$BThe wolves of Nagrand, mounts of the fabled Warsong clan, can rend a man to bits in seconds. They're also faster and more agile than anything you've seen yet.$B$BHere's your lasso. Good luck, and don't get yourself killed!
english.completion: It almost bit me, but I've got it bedded down and happy. A wolf, in my stables! Who'd have thought?
english.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 驯服雷象
text.objectives: 对一只幼年草地践踏者使用雷象套索，跟着它直到将它驯服。
text.description: 嗯，看来你很擅长驯服野兽。下一个目标选什么好呢？$B$B大块头的也抓过，尖牙利齿的也试过，那我们这次就找个块头又大，牙齿又尖利的好了。我说的是雷象。$B$B在纳格兰肥沃的平原上，住着这个星球上最引人注目的野兽。去抓一只幼年雷象来，我们瞧瞧能不能像德莱尼那样驯服它。
text.completion: Quite a big one, but it fits! It's resting, we'll talk about training it tomorrow.
text.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Entangling an Elekk
english.objectives: Use the Elekk Lasso on a Young Meadowstomper and follow it until it is tamed.
english.description: Well, you're pretty good at this whole taming thing. What's next?$B$BWe've done big, and we've done pointy. Let's do big AND pointy. I'm talking Elekks.$B$BWay out on the fertile plains of Nagrand, you'll find the finest specimens of beast this world has to offer. Grab one of the younger elekks, and we'll see if we can't get it trained like the Draenei used to.
english.completion: Quite a big one, but it fits! It's resting, we'll talk about training it tomorrow.
english.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 捕捉裂蹄牛
text.objectives: 对一只幼年冰蹄牛使用裂蹄牛套索，然后跟着它，直到将它驯服。
text.description: 在霜火岭北边冰雪覆盖的群山中，你会找到长满毛皮的裂蹄牛。$B$B它们不但十分健壮，被逼到绝境时还会变得凶猛非常。别想不费吹灰之力就将它们制服。$B$B这套索是给你的，看看你能不能在裂蹄牛把绳子从你手里拽跑之前驯服一只吧。
text.completion: Was it cold up there? This guy seems to appreciate the warmth, he's already snoozin'!
text.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Capturing a Clefthoof
english.objectives: Use the Clefthoof Lasso on a Young Icehoof and follow it until it is tamed.
english.description: Way up north in the frozen peaks of Frostfire Ridge, you'll find the wooly clefthoof.$B$BThey're sturdy, for sure, and fierce when you corner them. Don't expect them to be tamed without a fight.$B$BHere's a lasso, see if you can't manage to tame one before it tugs the rope out of your hands.
english.completion: Was it cold up there? This guy seems to appreciate the warmth, he's already snoozin'!
english.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 驯服塔布羊
text.objectives: 对一只幼年银鬃塔布羊使用塔布羊套索，然后跟着它，直到将它驯服。
text.description: 接下去要捕获的野兽是德拉诺最快的野兽，与此同时，它还将考验你潜入敌方领土的能力。$B$B你可以在影月谷的花丘上找到年幼的塔布羊，带上这根塔布羊套索出发吧！$B$B找到塔布羊后，你就跨上坐骑并丢出这个套索，然后一路跟着它跑，直到你驯服对方。祝你狩猎愉快！
text.completion: The talbuk appears to be doing well. Allow it to rest before you continue the beast's training.
text.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

english.title: Taming a Talbuk
english.objectives: Use the Talbuk Lasso on a Young Silverpelt and follow it until it is tamed.
english.description: The next beast is one of the fastest in Draenor, but will test your skills at infiltrating into enemy territory.$B$BThe young talbuk can be found on the flowery hills of Shadowmoon Valley. Take this talbuk lasso and head out.$B$BWhen you encounter one, mount up and throw this rope, then follow it until it is tamed. Good hunting!
english.completion: The talbuk appears to be doing well. Allow it to rest before you continue the beast's training.
english.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

text.title: 征用淡水兽
text.objectives: 对一只幼年淡水兽使用淡水兽套索，然后跟着它，直到将它驯服。
text.description: 我不知道我们为什么要捕淡水兽，但这可能是出于什么战略目的吧。淡水兽非常擅长在水中行动！$B$B你可以在塔拉多的暮秋岛找到最好的淡水兽。不知道它们长啥样？只管往水里瞅，那些大个的，浮在水面的河马便是。$B$B就是别把自己弄太湿了！
text.completion: I've gone and dried it off already. We'll see about training this thing tomorrow.
text.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Requisition a Riverbeast
english.objectives: Use the Riverbeast Lasso on a Young Riverwallow and follow it until it is tamed.
english.description: I wasn't sure about this next beast, but it turns out that they've got a key strategic purpose. The riverbeast is quite at home in the water!$B$BYou'll find the best ones around in Talador, around about Duskfall Island. Look for the huge, floating lumps out in the water.$B$BTry not to get wet!
english.completion: I've gone and dried it off already. We'll see about training this thing tomorrow.
english.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 从内部瓦解
text.objectives: 在法罗纳尔的征服岗哨寻找考瓦斯·血棘。
text.description:
我们恶魔猎手里，考瓦斯·血棘和赛娅娜·夜刃带领着一小支伊利达雷队伍前往了法罗纳尔。他们的任务是从内部削弱燃烧军团。

我已经有一段时间没有收到他们的消息了。

如果你能找到他们，并带领他们走向胜利，那就再好不过了。没问题吧？
text.completion:
A friend it would seem.

Kayn did not think we could handle this? He might have been right this time.

english.title: From Within
english.objectives: Find Kor'vas Bloodthorn on Faronaar at Vanquish Point.
english.description:
A few of our demon hunters, Kor'vas Bloodthorn and Cyana Nightglaive, took a small force of the Illidari across to Faronaar. Their mission was to weaken the Legion from within.

I haven't heard from them in a while.

It would be best if you could find and lead them to success. Agreed?
english.completion:
A friend it would seem.

Kayn did not think we could handle this? He might have been right this time.

text.title: 宿敌：人类斩杀者
text.objectives: 在德拉诺的PVP战斗中消灭500名人类玩家。
text.description: <拉扎库尔把血淋淋的心脏交到你手上。>$B$B仪式已经完成。你的敌人已经被打上了死亡标记。$B$B你现在可以正式开始肃清这个世界上的敌人了。消灭所有胆敢反抗部落的人类。用他们的死来警告联盟的其他成员——要么离开德拉诺，要么只有死路一条。$B$B等你用人类的鲜血浇灭自己的怒火后再回来吧。$B$B征服你的敌人，成就自己人类斩杀者的身份。只许成功，不许失败。
text.completion: The truth of your deeds is in your eyes. Your hunger for the enemy sated with cries for mercy and rivers of blood.$B$BTake now your place as manslayer.
text.completed: Return to Raza'kul at the Gladiator's Sanctum.

english.title: Nemesis: Manslayer
english.objectives: Kill 500 Human Players in Player versus Player combat across Draenor.
english.description: <Raza'kul hands you the bloody heart.>$B$BThe ritual is complete. Your nemesis is marked for death.$B$BNow your work to rid this world of the enemy truly begins. Kill all humans that stand defiantly against the Horde. Let their deaths serve as a warning to the rest of the Alliance: they will leave Draenor or they will die.$B$BReturn when you have quenched your rage with the blood of man.$B$BConquer our enemy and be known as manslayer. Fail and be nothing.
english.completion: The truth of your deeds is in your eyes. Your hunger for the enemy sated with cries for mercy and rivers of blood.$B$BTake now your place as manslayer.
english.completed: Return to Raza'kul at the Gladiator's Sanctum.

text.title: Phantom Potion
text.objectives: Bring Tyra Silverblood 10 Ghost Truffles.
text.description: Every turn you take in Ashran you run into danger. But don't fret $n, I've developed the perfect solution. It's my very own riff on the popular Invisibility Potion. $B$BI'm just missing one of the ingredients: cave mushrooms. $B$BLuckily, a variety grows right here in Ashran.
text.progress: Are those the truffles?
text.completion: Here she is! Careful with her, these potions have a reputation for mysteriously disappearing.
text.completed: Return to Tyra Silverblood in Warspear Outpost.

text.title: Talador - Bladefury Treasure - Burning Blade Cache

english.title: Talador - Bladefury Treasure - Burning Blade Cache

text.title: 警告奥格瑞玛
text.objectives: 与萨鲁法尔大王交谈。
text.description: 我们拖住了钢铁部落，但这场战争还远未结束……我会在这里继续领军抵御钢铁部落。$b$b但我们必须尽快把今天的战果和我们未来将面临的威胁报告给萨鲁法尔大王。$b$b我觉得由你亲自去一趟最合适了，$c。
text.completion: This is more trouble than I first tink. Da Iron Horde be strong, but we are da true Horde, and we be stronger.$b$bI fear this is da start of much bloodshed, before we go ta war, we be needin' a plan.

english.title: Warning Orgrimmar
english.objectives: Speak with High Overlord Saurfang.
english.description: We have slowed the Iron Horde down, but this war is far from over... I'll stay here and continue our efforts to hold back the Iron Horde.$b$bThe Warchief needs to know about what we have accomplished here today, and the threat we face in the future.$b$bIt is probably best if you report to High Overlord Saurfang yourself, $c.
english.completion: This is more trouble than I first tink. Da Iron Horde be strong, but we are da true Horde, and we be stronger.$b$bI fear this is da start of much bloodshed, before we go ta war, we be needin' a plan.

text.title: 向国王报告
text.objectives: 与安度因·乌瑞恩国王交谈。
text.description: 我们拖住了钢铁部落，但这场战争还远未结束……我会在这里继续领军抵御钢铁部落。$B$B但我们必须尽快把今天的战果和我们未来将面临的威胁报告给国王。$B$B我觉得由你亲自去一趟最合适了，$n。
text.completion: This is worse than I imagined.$b$bThe Iron Horde is proving to be a massive threat to our people... I don't want anymore bloodshed, but I fear we are out of options.$b$bWe need a plan before we strike.
text.completed: 去艾尔文森林的暴风城与安度因·乌瑞恩国王谈一谈。

english.objectives: Speak with King Anduin Wrynn.

I'll stay here and continue our efforts to hold back the Iron Horde.$b$bThe King needs to know about what we have accomplished here today, and the threat we face in the future.$b$bIt is probably best if you report to King Wrynn yourself, $n.

text.title: 驯服野猪
text.objectives: 对一只幼年石牙野猪使用野猪套索，跟着它直到将它驯服。
text.description: 戈尔隆德的大野猪既可当成美味的食物又可以充作坐骑。在这座要塞里养上几只绝对是明智的选择。$B$B我又给你准备了一根套索，你有兴趣的话可以去抓一只。不过要当心那附近的钢铁部落。
text.completion: The boar has taken to the stables quite quickly. They appear to be nearly domesticated already. It will need some time to rest.
text.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

english.title: Besting a Boar
english.objectives: Use the Boar Lasso on a Young Rocktusk and follow it until it is tamed.
english.description: The great boars of Gorgrond appear to serve as both a mount and an excellent source of food. Having a few of them in the garrison would not be an unwise idea.$B$BI have created for you another rope, should you wish to ride one down. Be wary of the Iron Horde presence nearby.
english.completion: The boar has taken to the stables quite quickly. They appear to be nearly domesticated already. It will need some time to rest.
english.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

text.title: 征用淡水兽
text.objectives: 对一只幼年淡水兽使用淡水兽套索，然后跟着它，直到将它驯服。
text.description: 我见过一些体型巨大的野兽漂浮在塔拉多的河面上。我记得它们应该是叫“淡水兽”来着。$B$B它们的皮像石头一样硬，却能轻易地浮在水面上。假如你要去那边的话，我希望你能抓一只过来让我仔细看看。有兴趣的话就去找托尔玛克，他给你准备了一条新的套索。
text.completion: Quite a sight, I must say. Big and powerful, yet full of so much air. It will be ready for training tomorrow.
text.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

english.title: Requisition a Riverbeast
english.objectives: Use the Riverbeast Lasso on a Young Riverwallow and follow it until it is tamed.
english.description: I have seen great beasts floating slowly along the rivers of Talador. The 'riverbeasts,' I believe they are called.$B$BTheir hides are solid, like rock, and yet they float along the waters easily. I would quite like to see one of these up close, if you should head that way. Tormak has created for you another rope, if you are interested.
english.completion: Quite a sight, I must say. Big and powerful, yet full of so much air. It will be ready for training tomorrow.
english.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

text.title: 驯服雷象
text.objectives: 对一只幼年草地践踏者使用雷象套索，跟着它直到将它驯服。
text.description: 纳格兰平原是我见过的最肥沃，最葱翠的土地。你可以在那里看到这片大陆上最强大的一些野兽。$B$B雷象就是其中之一。这种巨兽的一根长牙都可能长得比你我都要巨大。$B$B假如你对驯服这种野兽有兴趣的话，这是我准备的套索。
text.completion: A powerful creature, it nearly took down the wooden posts of the stable. We will begin training it as soon as it wakes.
text.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

english.title: Entangling an Elekk
english.objectives: Use the Elekk Lasso on a Young Meadowstomper and follow it until it is tamed.
english.description: The plains of Nagrand are the most lush and fertile that I have ever seen. Should you ever see them, you will come upon the mightiest beasts that this place has to offer.$B$BAmong them, the great elekk. A magnificent beast with horns that can grow larger than you or I.$B$BHere is another rope, should you wish to tangle with such a beast.
english.completion: A powerful creature, it nearly took down the wooden posts of the stable. We will begin training it as soon as it wakes.
english.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

text.title: Wrangling a Wolf
text.objectives: Use the Wolf Lasso on a Young Snarler and follow it until it is tamed.
text.description: The wolves of this land have jaws of steel. It is no wonder that the orcs have taken them as their own.$B$BYet, deep in Nagrand, there are young wolves, ripe for taming. They will present a great challenge to you, as they are more fast and agile than any beast in this land.$B$BHere is your final rope, may luck be with you.
text.completion: Quite the catch, commander. It will need to rest for some time, but will surely be hungry for combat soon.
text.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

text.title: 逃亡的鸦人
text.objectives: 与阿兰卡峰林的阿兹克谈一谈。
text.description:
我想你一定很熟悉鸦人吧，指挥官？鸦人是会飞的鸟人，身形巨大。极具领地意识。

然而，有些鸦人的翅膀萎缩了——或许是患上了某种疾病。他们似乎是被赶出了鸦人社会。你有时候会看见他们蹲在被遗忘的遗迹间，或是在路边叫卖饰品。

看来钢铁部落进驻鸦人领地的举动刺激到了他们，那些被放逐者纷纷离开了。

$B$B我们应该与这些被放逐者建立联系——他们手上可能会有宝贵的情报。
text.completion: <The arakkoa merchant looks you up and down.>$B$BWell-equipped, aren't we? Azik is betting you are someone of importance to your people.$B$BCome closer, friend. Speak with me for just a moment.
text.completed: 与阿兰卡峰林的阿兹克谈一谈。

english.title: Arakkoa Exodus
english.objectives: Speak with Azik in Spires of Arak.
english.description:
I assume you're familiar with the arakkoa, commander? Great, flying birdfolk. Extremely territorial.

Some, however, have withered wings - a disease, maybe. They seem to be outcast from arakkoa society. You find them now and then, squatting in forgotten ruins or peddling trinkets on the roadside.

It seems the Iron Horde has incited the arakkoa by moving into their lands, and the outcasts are fleeing in droves.

We should make contact with these outcasts - they could have valuable information.
english.completion: <The arakkoa merchant looks you up and down.>$B$BWell-equipped, aren't we? Azik is betting you are someone of importance to your people.$B$BCome closer, friend. Speak with me for just a moment.
english.completed: Speak with Azik in Spires of Arak.

text.title: 纳格兰的战火
text.objectives: 与纳格兰车队的石头守卫布罗克斯谈一谈。
text.description:
**指挥官$n亲启**

杜隆坦建议我们在纳格兰建立一处据点，所以我擅自做主派出了一些人手。

据萨尔报告，哨站已接近完工。他让我转告你，他们已经在等你了。

我已经为你准备好了一只双足飞龙，等你准备好了就可以随时出发，它会把你送到驮满最新物资的车队那里，$g先生:女士;。

——洛坎
text.completion: They came at us... from... nowhere.$B$B<The stoneguard nearly passes out.>

english.title: Taking the Fight to Nagrand
english.objectives: Speak with Stone Guard Brox at the caravan in Nagrand.
english.description:
**Eyes Only -- Commander $n**

Durotan recommended dat we be gettin' a foothold in Nagrand, so I taken the liberty of dispatchin' some of da boys.

Thrall's already reportin' the new outpost be nearly complete. He been askin' me to let ya know they be ready for ya.

A windrider be waitin' to catch ya up with the latest caravan shipment whenever you be ready, $g sir:ma'am;.

-- Rokhan
english.completion: They came at us... from... nowhere.$B$B<The stoneguard nearly passes out.>

text.title: 策略问题
text.objectives: 与布罗恩·天角谈一谈，飞往塔拉多。
text.description:
**指挥官$n亲启**

钢铁部落用行动证明自己是强大的对手。$B$B他们设法把舰队从戈尔隆德转移到了塔拉多，而我的探子们居然毫无察觉。塔拉多位于整个大陆的十字路口。我们决不能让他们夺取它。$B$B别担心，头儿，我们有计划了。就在我们说话间，工头格罗巴什正在为我们的军队建造哨站。等你抵达时应该已经准备好了，指挥官。$b$b——洛坎
text.completion: Your will be done. I require your advisement, commander.

english.title: It's a Matter of Strategy
english.objectives: Speak to Bron Skyhorn to secure a flight to Talador.
english.description:
**Eyes Only -- Commander $n**

The Iron Horde have proved themselves worthy foes.$B$BThey managed to get their fleet moving to Talador from Gorgrond without my spies seeing a thing. Talador be a crossroads for the whole continent. We can't let them have it.$B$BDon't worry boss, we got a plan. Foreman Grobash be setting up an outpost for our forces as we speak. They be ready for you when you arrive, commander.$b$b--Rokhan
english.completion: Твоя воля будет исполнена. Нужно сделать выбор, командир.

text.title: 宿敌：猎人与猎物
text.objectives: 在角斗士圣殿烧毁一个宿敌雕像，然后跟库卢斯谈一谈。
text.description: 敌人包围着我们，而且他们的人数每一天都在增长。是时候向他们的大军发动决定性打击了，勇士。$B$B在我身边矗立着我们最憎恨的敌人的雕像。你将给他们带去毁灭，$n。你将成为他们的宿敌，令敌人一看见你就抱头鼠窜。$B$B现在选出你想要宣泄怒火的目标，并烧毁你要灭除的种族雕像吧。等你做好选择之后，就来跟我谈谈。
text.completion: A last warning: once you have accepted this choice you cannot reverse it or make a new choice until you complete your mission$B$BIf your choice is certain, your aim will be true.$B$BStrike fear in the hearts and minds of the enemy! Glory to the Alliance! For Draenor!
text.completed: Return to Kuros at the Gladiator's Sanctum.

english.title: Nemesis: Hunter - Hunted
english.objectives: Burn a Nemesis Effigy at the Gladiator's Sanctum then speak to Kuros.
english.description: Our enemies surround us, and with each passing day their numbers grow. It is time to make a decisive strike against their armies, champion.$B$BAround me stand effigies of our most hated adversaries. You will be their downfall, $n. You will become nemesis and they will run in fear at the sight of you.$B$BNow select the target of your rage and burn in effigy that race which you mean to eradicate. Speak to me when you have made your selection.
english.completion: A last warning: once you have accepted this choice you cannot reverse it or make a new choice until you complete your mission$B$BIf your choice is certain, your aim will be true.$B$BStrike fear in the hearts and minds of the enemy! Glory to the Alliance! For Draenor!
english.completed: Return to Kuros at the Gladiator's Sanctum.

text.title: 宿敌：化为死神
text.objectives: 在德拉诺的PvP战斗中击败一名血精灵玩家，并夺取他们身上的血精灵之心。
text.description: 你已经选好了目标，他们很快就能感受到你无情的怒火，但首先，你必须深入德拉诺的荒野，在一场生死大战中将一位血精灵跳动的心挖出来。带着你的战利品回来找我吧。$B$B通过敌人的心，灵魂将与你的感知力相协调，使你获得超人的视野与敏锐的听觉——更加便于你追踪猎物，占尽优势。
text.progress: Have you recovered the heart of a worthy foe?
text.completion: With this heart you will see and hear things as only the great spirits can. Your enemy will be unable to hide from your unrelenting assaults.
text.completed: Return to Kuros at the Gladiator's Sanctum.

english.title: Nemesis: Becoming Death
english.objectives: Kill a Blood Elf Player in Player versus Player combat while in Draenor and retrieve their Blood Elf Heart.
english.description: You have chosen your quarry and surely soon they will feel your merciless wrath, but first you must venture out into the wilds of Draenor and rip out the still-beating heart of a blood elf in mortal combat. Return here with your prize.$B$BThrough the heart of your enemy the spirits will attune your senses, granting you second sight and keenness in hearing - all to stalk your prey and claim dominance.

english.completion: With this heart you will see and hear things as only the great spirits can. Your enemy will be unable to hide from your unrelenting assaults.

text.title: 宿敌：辛多雷斩杀者
text.objectives: 在德拉诺的PVP战斗中消灭500名血精灵玩家。
text.description: <库卢斯把血淋淋的心脏交到你手上。>$B$B仪式已经完成。你的敌人已经被打上了死亡标记。$B$B你现在可以正式开始肃清这个世界上的敌人了。消灭所有胆敢反抗联盟的血精灵。用他们的死来警告部落的其他成员——要么离开德拉诺，要么只有死路一条。$B$B等你用血精灵的鲜血浇灭自己的怒火后再回来吧。$B$B征服你的敌人，成就自己辛多雷斩杀者的身份。只许成功，不许失败。
text.completion: The truth of your deeds is in your eyes. Your hunger for the enemy sated with cries for mercy and rivers of blood.$B$BTake now your place as slayer of Sin'dorei.
text.completed: Return to Kuros at the Gladiator's Sanctum.

english.objectives: Kill 500 Blood Elf Players in Player versus Player combat across Draenor.
english.description: <Kuros hands you the bloody heart.>$B$BThe ritual is complete. Your nemesis is marked for death.$B$BNow your work to rid this world of the enemy truly begins. Kill all blood elves that stand defiantly against the Alliance. Let their deaths serve as a warning to the rest of the Horde: they will leave Draenor or they will die.$B$BReturn when you have quenched your rage with the blood of blood elf.$B$BConquer our enemy and be known as slayer of Sin'dorei. Fail and be nothing.

english.description: <Kuros hands you the bloody heart.>$B$BThe ritual is complete. Your nemesis is marked for death.$B$BNow your work to rid this world of the enemy truly begins. Kill all trolls that stand defiantly against the Alliance. Let their deaths serve as a warning to the rest of the Horde: they will leave Draenor or they will die.$B$BReturn when you have quenched your rage with the blood of troll.$B$BConquer our enemy and be known as troll hunter. Fail and be nothing.
english.completion: The truth of your deeds is in your eyes. Your hunger for the enemy sated with cries for mercy and rivers of blood.$B$BTake now your place as troll hunter.
english.completed: Return to Kuros at the Gladiator's Sanctum.

text.title: 宿敌：化为死神
text.objectives: 在德拉诺的PvP战斗中击败一名熊猫人玩家，并夺取他们的熊猫人之心。
text.description: 你已经选中了你的猎物，他们必定会感受到你无情的愤怒。但首先你必须先前往德拉诺的野外地区，寻找一个熊猫人对手并与之性命相搏，把他跳动的心带回来。$B$B敌人的灵魂将会通过这颗心与你的感官发生共鸣，使你的意志变得更为敏锐——让你可以更轻易地追踪你的猎物并称霸野外。
text.progress: Have you recovered the heart of a worthy foe?
text.completion: With this heart you will see and hear things as only the great spirits can. Your enemy will be unable to hide from your unrelenting assaults.
text.completed: Return to Kuros at the Gladiator's Sanctum.

english.title: Nemesis: Becoming Death
english.objectives: Kill a Pandaren Player in Player versus Player combat while in Draenor and retrieve their Pandaren Heart.
english.description: You have chosen your quarry and surely soon they will feel your merciless wrath, but first you must venture out into the wilds of Draenor and rip out the still-beating heart of a pandaren in mortal combat. Return here with your prize.$B$BThrough the heart of your enemy the spirits will attune your senses, granting you second sight and keenness in hearing - all to stalk your prey and claim dominance.
english.progress: Have you recovered the heart of a worthy foe?
english.completion: With this heart you will see and hear things as only the great spirits can. Your enemy will be unable to hide from your unrelenting assaults.
english.completed: Return to Kuros at the Gladiator's Sanctum.

text.title: 宿敌：火金天敌
text.objectives: 在德拉诺的PVP战斗中消灭500名熊猫人玩家。
text.description: <库卢斯把血淋淋的心脏交到你手上。>$B$B仪式已经完成。你的敌人已经被打上了死亡标记。$B$B你现在可以正式开始肃清这个世界上的敌人了。消灭所有胆敢反抗联盟的熊猫人。用他们的死来警告部落的其他成员——要么离开德拉诺，要么只有死路一条。$B$B等你用熊猫人的鲜血浇灭自己的怒火后再回来吧。$B$B征服你的敌人，成就自己火金天敌的身份。只许成功，不许失败。
text.completion: The truth of your deeds is in your eyes. Your hunger for the enemy sated with cries for mercy and rivers of blood.$B$BTake now your place as Huojin's fall.
text.completed: Return to Kuros at the Gladiator's Sanctum.

Let their deaths serve as a warning to the rest of the Horde: they will leave Draenor or they will die.$B$BReturn when you have quenched your rage with the blood of pandaren.$B$BConquer our enemy and be known as Huojin's fall. Fail and be nothing.

text.objectives: 在德拉诺的PvP战斗中击败一名地精玩家，并夺取他们身上的地精之心。
text.description: 你已经选中了你的猎物，他们必定会感受到你无情的愤怒。但首先你必须先前往德拉诺的野外地区，寻找一个地精对手并与之性命相搏，把他跳动的心带回来。$B$B敌人的灵魂将会通过这颗心与你的感官发生共鸣，使你的意志变得更为敏锐——让你可以更轻易地追踪你的猎物并称霸野外。

text.objectives: 在德拉诺的PVP战斗中消灭500名地精玩家。
text.description: <库卢斯把血淋淋的心脏交到你手上。>$B$B仪式已经完成。你的敌人已经被打上了死亡标记。$B$B你现在可以正式开始肃清这个世界上的敌人了。消灭所有胆敢反抗联盟的地精。用他们的死来警告部落的其他成员——要么离开德拉诺，要么只有死路一条。$B$B等你用地精的鲜血浇灭自己的怒火后再回来吧。$B$B征服你的敌人，成就自己科赞杀手的身份。只许成功，不许失败。

text.title: 塔布羊训练：巨齿
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的塔布羊去击败巨齿。
text.description: 训练战斗坐骑的第一步是要让它熟悉战斗的情景和声音。假如处理不当，它就会受到惊吓并抛下你逃走。$B$B带上这头小塔布羊，然后骑着它去影月谷平原地区找最大的一头野兽。你们要是能一起解决掉它，一定能提升它的自信心。
text.completion: That should do it a world of good. We'll let 'er rest for tonight, and take on some bigger targets tomorrow.
text.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Talbuk Training: Great-Tusk
english.objectives: Defeat Great-Tusk while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
english.description: The first step in training your mount for war will be getting it used to the sights and sounds of combat. If it's not trained properly, it might get spooked and run.$B$BTake this little talbuk out to the plains of Shadowmoon Valley and take on the biggest beast you can find, together. That should raise its confidence!
english.completion: That should do it a world of good. We'll let 'er rest for tonight, and take on some bigger targets tomorrow.
english.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 塔布羊训练：拉基尔
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的塔布羊去击败拉基尔。
text.description: 现在你的塔布羊已经熟悉了战斗，我们这次要带它去一个陌生的环境。$B$B遍布冰壁的霜火岭值得一试。去那找最大最凶狠的野兽，并骑着你的塔布羊干掉它吧。
text.completion: Oi! That talbuk's performin' admirably. Let's let 'er rest.
text.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Talbuk Training: Rakkiri
english.objectives: Defeat Rakkiri while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
english.description: Now that your talbuk has got a taste for combat, let's take it out into an environment it may not be familiar with.$B$BThe icy bluffs of Frostfire Ridge should be a good test. Find yourself a big, mean beast out there and take it down with your talbuk.
english.completion: Oi! That talbuk's performin' admirably. Let's let 'er rest.
english.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 塔布羊训练：裂鞭
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的塔布羊去击败裂鞭。
text.description: 大部分的坐骑在见到凶残的捕食者的时候会掉头就跑。而在戈尔隆德荒凉的峭壁间，有着世上最凶残的捕食者。$B$B我们这就让你的塔布羊去试上一试。看看你们两个有没有本事干掉那头叫裂鞭的强力迅猛龙。
text.completion: Those were some mighty big claws to tangle with. Your talbuk will need a nap after that one.
text.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Talbuk Training: Riplash
english.objectives: Defeat Riplash while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
english.description: Now plenty of mounts have been known to run away at the sight of a fierce predator. Way out in the desolate cliffs of Gorgrond, they've got some of the fiercest.$B$BLet's put your talbuk to the test. See if the two of you can't take down the mighty raptor known as Riplash.
english.completion: Those were some mighty big claws to tangle with. Your talbuk will need a nap after that one.
english.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 塔布羊训练：格兹兰
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的塔布羊去击败格兹兰。
text.description: 德拉诺的野外还有各种各样的动物可以用来给你钟爱的坐骑当消遣。在这当中，最狡猾的要数潜伏者。$B$B这种怪物可以潜伏在环境之中，潜行并偷取附近猎物的蛋。这次让我们瞧瞧你的塔布羊能否识破这种天然的伪装。你可以在塔拉多找到一些凶猛的潜伏者。
text.completion: Ye did it! I'm sure your talbuk's enjoyin' this sort of one-on-one attention. We'll let it rest up a bit.
text.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Talbuk Training: Gezz'ran
english.objectives: Defeat Gezz'ran while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
english.description: There's plenty more beasts out in the wild that can make a snack of your favorite mount. One of the most cunning on Draenor is the stalker.$B$BStalkers can blend into their environments, allowing them to sneak in and steal the eggs of nearby prey. See if you and your talbuk can't overcome this natural defense mechanism. You'll find some mean stalkers out in Talador.
english.completion: Ye did it! I'm sure your talbuk's enjoyin' this sort of one-on-one attention. We'll let it rest up a bit.
english.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 塔布羊训练：布巴波尔
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的塔布羊去击败布巴波尔。
text.description: 在阿兰卡峰林最南边，来自水下的蘑菇正在不断地侵蚀着陆地。你问结果是什么？古怪的真菌生物现在已经在那里到处漫步了。$B$B其中有一个真菌巨人叫布巴波尔，这是个好机会，让我们瞧瞧你的塔布羊会如何面对它并不熟悉的捕食者。
text.completion: I'll bet that was quite a fight! Great job, let's let it rest for tonight.
text.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Talbuk Training: Bulbapore
english.objectives: Defeat Bulbapore while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
english.description: Way down south in the Spires of Arak, the land's being overtaken by the mushrooms that grow underwater. The result? Strange fungal creatures sprouting up all over the place.$B$BTaking on a strange creature, like the fungal giant Bulbapore, gives us a great chance to expose your talbuk to predators it's unfamiliar with.
english.completion: I'll bet that was quite a fight! Great job, let's let it rest for tonight.
english.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 塔布羊训练：凶残的食人魔
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的塔布羊去击败高里亚驱兽者。
text.description: 在纳格兰居住着德拉诺最强大的野兽，而且那里的食人魔使用一种非常残忍的手段驯养他们。$B$B其中，又数那个叫高里亚驱兽者的尤为凶残。他浑身充满了血腥和恐惧的气息。让我们瞧瞧你的塔布羊面对他是否还能面不改色。
text.completion: Those poor beasts! I'm glad you two put that ogre out of commission. Check back in tomorrow and we can continue the training.
text.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Talbuk Training: Cruel Ogres
english.objectives: Defeat the Gorian Beast-Lasher while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
english.description: Nagrand is home to the mightiest beasts in Draenor, and the ogres of the region have learned to tame them using brutal techniques.$B$BThere is one ogre in particular, the Gorian Beast-Lasher, that smells of blood and fear. Go on and see how your talbuk reacts to that.
english.completion: Those poor beasts! I'm glad you two put that ogre out of commission. Check back in tomorrow and we can continue the training.
english.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 塔布羊训练：暗翼大鹏
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的塔布羊去击败暗翼大鹏。
text.description: 纳格兰的风鹏是一种非常聪明的捕食者，它们经常成群结队地突袭猎物。要是你的坐骑不时刻注意着天空的话，就可得跟它这双眼睛说再见了。$B$B去纳格兰干掉那里最凶猛的风鹏——暗翼大鹏。这对你们俩来说都是个试炼。
text.completion: From now on, I'm sure your mount will always remember to keep one eye on the skies. Great job!
text.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Talbuk Training: Darkwing Roc
english.objectives: Defeat the Darkwing Roc while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
english.description: The windrocs of Nagrand are a smart predator, often swooping down on unwary prey in packs. If your beast doesn't keep an eye on the sky, it's likely to lose both of 'em.$B$BHead on out to Nagrand and take on the fiercest windroc of the bunch, the Darkwing Roc. That'll be a good test for the both of ye.
english.completion: From now on, I'm sure your mount will always remember to keep one eye on the skies. Great job!
english.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 塔布羊训练：暴怒飞蛾
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的塔布羊去击败暴怒飞蛾。
text.description: 在纳格兰的森林中有许多善于躲避捕食者的动物。但其中又要属那只名叫暴怒飞蛾的蛾子做的最好，它浑身覆满了充满恶臭的飞蛾之尘。$B$B如果它能让附近的野狼都不得不退避三舍，这对你的塔布羊来说一定是一次非常美妙的试炼。看看你能不能让它保持专注，干掉那只飞蛾吧。
text.completion: Glad to see you two make it back. It'll need a bit of time to brush that dust off.
text.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Talbuk Training: Moth of Wrath
english.objectives: Defeat the Moth of Wrath while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
english.description: Deep in the forests of Nagrand are some beasts capable of evading almost any predator. The greatest of them all, the Moth of Wrath, is coated with a foul-smelling dust.$B$BIf the moth dust is enough to keep wolves at bay, it'll probably be a pretty good test for your talbuk. See if you can't keep it focused and take down that moth.
english.completion: Glad to see you two make it back. It'll need a bit of time to brush that dust off.
english.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: Talbuk Training: Thundercall
text.objectives: Defeat Thundercall while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
text.description: The elements can sometimes pose a problem for some beasts. Ever seen a ram in a thunderstorm? They'll hide behind anything larger than themselves. I'm not sure if they think the world is ending or what, but it's not great if you're atop one at the time.$B$BIn Nagrand, off on a windswept cliff high above the shore, is a creature made of pure thunderstorms. Hop atop your talbuk and face off against Thundercall, and we'll see if it gets spooked.
text.completion: Well, it's a bit wet, but seems to be in good spirits. I'll get 'er dried off and into bed.
text.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Talbuk Training: Thundercall
english.objectives: Defeat Thundercall while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
english.description: The elements can sometimes pose a problem for some beasts. Ever seen a ram in a thunderstorm? They'll hide behind anything larger than themselves. I'm not sure if they think the world is ending or what, but it's not great if you're atop one at the time.$B$BIn Nagrand, off on a windswept cliff high above the shore, is a creature made of pure thunderstorms. Hop atop your talbuk and face off against Thundercall, and we'll see if it gets spooked.
english.completion: Well, it's a bit wet, but seems to be in good spirits. I'll get 'er dried off and into bed.
english.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: Talbuk Training: Ironbore
text.objectives: Defeat Ironbore while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
text.description: Alright, we've taken on foes in the sky and on land, and even in the rain. What happens when the beasts are below your feet, though? We're about to find out!$B$BThe rockworm is a cunning predator, striking at prey from below the sands. Many beasts of Nagrand have grown wary of the rumbling of the earth. Take your talbuk on out to the sandy shores and see if you can't take down one of the elder rockworms: Ironbore.
text.completion: The sand worm's bit the dust? Well done, I'll get this beast bedded down for the night.
text.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Talbuk Training: Ironbore
english.objectives: Defeat Ironbore while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
english.description: Alright, we've taken on foes in the sky and on land, and even in the rain. What happens when the beasts are below your feet, though? We're about to find out!$B$BThe rockworm is a cunning predator, striking at prey from below the sands. Many beasts of Nagrand have grown wary of the rumbling of the earth. Take your talbuk on out to the sandy shores and see if you can't take down one of the elder rockworms: Ironbore.
english.completion: The sand worm's bit the dust? Well done, I'll get this beast bedded down for the night.
english.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 塔布羊训练：兽人猎手
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的塔布羊去击败狩猎大师卡拉克。
text.description: 纳格兰的战歌氏族算是一批非常优秀的猎人，我以前还栽他们手里过，真是倒霉。假如你想给你未来的坐骑找点真正的试炼的话，那就应该去会会他们当中的首席猎人。$B$B你能在纳格兰找到一位名叫卡拉克的兽人，死在他手上的凶残动物的数量是他们整个氏族里最多的，所以他们都叫他“狩猎大师”。骑上你的塔布羊去干掉他，为那些可怜的小动物报仇！
text.completion: Hunted the hunter, eh? Your beast doesn't seem any worse for wear, either! I'll brush it down.
text.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Talbuk Training: Orc Hunters
english.objectives: Defeat Karak the Great Hunter while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
english.description: The Warsong Clan of Nagrand are some of the best hunters I've ever had the misfortune of meeting. If anyone can pose a real test for your future mount, it's one of their chief beast-killers.$B$BOut in Nagrand, you'll find an orc by the name of Karak. They call him the Great Hunter, and he's taken down more fierce beasts than any other in the clan. Get astride your talbuk and bring him down. In the name of the poor wee beasts!
english.completion: Hunted the hunter, eh? Your beast doesn't seem any worse for wear, either! I'll brush it down.
english.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 塔布羊训练：铁颚狼
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的塔布羊去击败残爪。
text.description: 指挥官，我还有最后一项挑战要给你，这次可没那么简单。$B$B在德拉诺有一种狼，他们的皮肤像夜晚一样漆黑，他们体型比一般的狼要大上一倍，人们称他们为铁颚狼。它们转眼间就能把一个大活人撕成两半，任何脑子正常的动物遇到它们都会吓得腿软。$B$B有一头孤独的铁颚狼离开了它们世代居住的霜火岭跑到了纳格兰定居。骑上你的塔布羊去干掉它，如果你们两个能够生还，你的塔布羊才能成为一头真正的战兽。
text.completion: Your talbuk has grown from a wee silverpelt into a fine specimen of war beast, and it's all due to your diligence.$B$BI'm happy to hand over the reins of this fully-trained mount to you, commander. Ride it with pride!
text.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Talbuk Training: The Garn
english.objectives: Defeat Maimclaw while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
english.description: I've got one last challenge for ye, commander, but if it isn't a doozy.$B$BThey call them the garn. Wolves as black as night, and twice the size of a normal wolf, they can tear a man apart in seconds. Any beast in their right mind would be scared witless at the sight of such a predator.$B$BThere's a lone garn that's made it from their usual home in Frostfire, all the way over to Nagrand. Take your talbuk, mount up, and bring it down. If the two of you survive, your talbuk will truly be ready for war.
english.completion: Your talbuk has grown from a wee silverpelt into a fine specimen of war beast, and it's all due to your diligence.$B$BI'm happy to hand over the reins of this fully-trained mount to you, commander. Ride it with pride!
english.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 裂蹄牛训练：巨齿
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练裂蹄牛去击败巨齿。
text.description: 训练战斗坐骑的第一步是要让它熟悉战斗的情景和声音。假如处理不当，它就会受到惊吓并抛下你逃走。$B$B带上这头小裂蹄牛，然后骑着它去影月谷平原地区找最大的一头野兽。你们要是能一起解决掉它，一定能提升它的自信心。
text.completion: That should do it a world of good. We'll let 'er rest for tonight, and take on some bigger targets tomorrow.
text.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Clefthoof Training: Great-Tusk
english.objectives: Defeat Great-Tusk while riding your Clefthoof -In-Training.
english.description: The first step in training your mount for war will be getting it used to the sights and sounds of combat. If it's not trained properly, it might get spooked and run.$B$BTake this little clefthoof out to the plains of Shadowmoon Valley and take on the biggest beast you can find, together. That should raise its confidence!
english.completion: That should do it a world of good. We'll let 'er rest for tonight, and take on some bigger targets tomorrow.
english.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 裂蹄牛训练：拉基尔
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的裂蹄牛去击败拉基尔。
text.description: 现在你的裂蹄牛已经熟悉了战斗，我们这次要带它去一个更严酷的环境。$B$B带你的裂蹄牛前往遍布冰壁的霜火岭，去干掉那里强大的捕食者拉基尔。让我们瞧瞧她能不能受的住。
text.completion: Oi! That clefthoof's performin' admirably. Let's let 'er rest.
text.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Clefthoof Training: Rakkiri
english.objectives: Defeat Rakkiri while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
english.description: Now that the clefthoof has a taste for combat, let's take it out into a harsher environment.$B$BTake your clefthoof out to the icy hills of Frostfire Ridge, and take on the great predator Rakkiri. We'll really put 'er toughness to the test.
english.completion: Oi! That clefthoof's performin' admirably. Let's let 'er rest.
english.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 裂蹄牛训练：裂鞭
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的裂蹄牛去击败裂鞭。
text.description: 大部分的坐骑在见到凶残的捕食者的时候会掉头就跑。而在戈尔隆德的大峡谷中，我们有世上最凶残的捕食者。$B$B我们这就让你的塔布羊去试上一试。让我们看看你们两个有没有本事干掉那头叫裂鞭的大迅猛龙。
text.completion: Those were some mighty big claws to tangle with. Your clefthoof will need a nap after that one.
text.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Clefthoof Training: Riplash
english.objectives: Defeat Riplash while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
english.description: Now plenty of mounts have been known to run away at the sight of a fierce predator. Way out in the desolate cliffs of Gorgrond, they've got some of the fiercest.$B$BLet's put your talbuk to the test. See if the two of you can't take down the mighty raptor known as Riplash.
english.completion: Those were some mighty big claws to tangle with. Your clefthoof will need a nap after that one.
english.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 裂蹄牛训练：格兹兰
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的裂蹄牛去击败格兹兰。
text.description: 德拉诺的野外还有各种各样的动物可以用来给你钟爱的坐骑当消遣。在这当中，最狡猾的要数潜伏者。$B$B这种怪物可以潜伏在环境之中，潜行并偷取附近猎物的蛋。这次让我们瞧瞧你的裂蹄牛能否识破这种天然的伪装。你可以在塔拉多找到一些凶猛的潜伏者。
text.completion: Ye did it! I'm sure your clefthoof's enjoyin' this sort of one-on-one attention. We'll let it rest up a bit.
text.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Clefthoof Training: Gezz'ran
english.objectives: Defeat Gezz'ran while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
english.description: There's plenty more beasts out in the wild that can make a snack of your favorite mount. One of the most cunning on Draenor is the stalker.$B$BStalkers can blend into their environments, allowing them to sneak in and steal the eggs of nearby prey. See if you and your clefthoof can't overcome this natural defense mechanism. You'll find some mean stalkers out in Talador.
english.completion: Ye did it! I'm sure your clefthoof's enjoyin' this sort of one-on-one attention. We'll let it rest up a bit.
english.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 裂蹄牛训练：布巴波尔
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的裂蹄牛去击败布巴波尔。
text.description: 在阿兰卡峰林最南边，来自水下的蘑菇正在不断地侵蚀着陆地。你问结果是什么？古怪的真菌生物现在已经在那里到处漫步了。$B$B其中有一个真菌巨人叫布巴波尔，这是个好机会，让我们瞧瞧你的裂蹄牛会如何面对它并不熟悉的捕食者。
text.completion: I'll bet that was quite a fight! Great job, let's let it rest for tonight.
text.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Clefthoof Training: Bulbapore
english.objectives: Defeat Bulbapore while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
english.description: Way down south in the Spires of Arak, the land's being overtaken by the mushrooms that grow underwater. The result? Strange fungal creatures sprouting up all over the place.$B$BTaking on a strange creature, like the fungal giant Bulbapore, gives us a great chance to expose your clefthoof to predators it's unfamiliar with.
english.completion: I'll bet that was quite a fight! Great job, let's let it rest for tonight.
english.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 裂蹄牛训练：凶残的食人魔
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的裂蹄牛去击败高里亚驱兽者。
text.description: 纳格兰是德拉诺许多强力生物的原产地。那里的食人魔使用一种非常残忍的手段驯养他们。$B$B其中，又数那个叫高里亚驱兽者的尤为凶残。他浑身充满了血腥和恐惧的气息。让我们瞧瞧你的裂蹄牛面对他是否还能面不改色。
text.completion: Those poor beasts! I'm glad you two put that ogre out of commission. Check back in tomorrow and we can continue the training.
text.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Clefthoof Training: Cruel Ogres
english.objectives: Defeat the Gorian Beast-Lasher while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
english.description: Nagrand is home to the mightiest beasts in Draenor, and the ogres of the region have learned to tame them using brutal techniques.$B$BThere is one ogre in particular, the Gorian Beast-Lasher, that smells of blood and fear. Go on and see how your clefthoof reacts to that.
english.completion: Those poor beasts! I'm glad you two put that ogre out of commission. Check back in tomorrow and we can continue the training.
english.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 裂蹄牛训练：暗翼大鹏
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的裂蹄牛去击败暗翼大鹏。
text.description: 纳格兰的风鹏是一种非常聪明的捕食者，它们经常成群结队地突袭猎物。要是你的坐骑不时刻注意着天空的话，就可得跟它这双眼睛说再见了。$B$B去纳格兰干掉那里最凶猛的风鹏——暗翼大鹏。这对你们俩来说都是个试炼。
text.completion: From now on, I'm sure your mount will always remember to keep one eye on the skies. Great job!
text.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Clefthoof Training: Darkwing Roc
english.objectives: Defeat the Darkwing Roc while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
english.description: The windrocs of Nagrand are a smart predator, often swooping down on unwary prey in packs. If your beast doesn't keep an eye on the sky, it's likely to lose both of em.'$B$BHead on out to Nagrand and take on the fiercest windroc of the bunch, the Darkwing Roc. That'll be a good test for the both of ye.
english.completion: From now on, I'm sure your mount will always remember to keep one eye on the skies. Great job!
english.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: Clefthoof Training: Moth of Wrath
text.objectives: Defeat the Moth of Wrath while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
text.description: Deep in the forests of Nagrand are some beasts capable of evading almost any predator. The greatest of them all, the Moth of Wrath, is coated with a foul-smelling dust.$B$BIf the moth dust is enough to keep wolves at bay, it'll probably be a pretty good test for your clefthoof. See if you can't keep it focused and take down that moth.
text.completion: Glad to see you two make it back. It'll need a bit of time to brush that dust off.
text.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Clefthoof Training: Moth of Wrath
english.objectives: Defeat the Moth of Wrath while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
english.description: Deep in the forests of Nagrand are some beasts capable of evading almost any predator. The greatest of them all, the Moth of Wrath, is coated with a foul-smelling dust.$B$BIf the moth dust is enough to keep wolves at bay, it'll probably be a pretty good test for your clefthoof. See if you can't keep it focused and take down that moth.
english.completion: Glad to see you two make it back. It'll need a bit of time to brush that dust off.
english.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: Clefthoof Training: Thundercall
text.objectives: Defeat Thundercall while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
text.description: The elements can sometimes pose a problem for some beasts. Ever seen a ram in a thunderstorm? They'll hide behind anything larger than themselves. I'm not sure if they think the world is ending or what, but it's not great if you're atop one at the time.$B$BIn Nagrand, off on a windswept cliff high above the shore, is a creature made of pure thunderstorms. Hop atop your clefthoof and face off against Thundercall, and we'll see if it gets spooked.
text.completion: Well, it's a bit wet, but seems to be in good spirits. I'll get 'er dried off and into bed.
text.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Clefthoof Training: Thundercall
english.objectives: Defeat Thundercall while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
english.description: The elements can sometimes pose a problem for some beasts. Ever seen a ram in a thunderstorm? They'll hide behind anything larger than themselves. I'm not sure if they think the world is ending or what, but it's not great if you're atop one at the time.$B$BIn Nagrand, off on a windswept cliff high above the shore, is a creature made of pure thunderstorms. Hop atop your clefthoof and face off against Thundercall, and we'll see if it gets spooked.
