english.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 裂蹄牛训练：铁钻
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的裂蹄牛去击败铁钻。
text.description: 很好，我们解决掉了陆地和天空的敌人，甚至还有雷雨。接下来试试你脚底下的动物如何？答案即将揭晓！$B$B岩虫是一种狡猾的捕食者，它们喜欢从沙土底下钻出来袭击敌人。在纳格兰，很多野兽都学会了注意脚底下的动静。骑上你的裂蹄牛去那边的沙滩试试，看看你们能不能干掉那里最古老的一只岩虫：铁钻。
text.completion: The sand worm's bit the dust? Well done, I'll get this beast bedded down for the night.
text.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Clefthoof Training: Ironbore
english.objectives: Defeat Ironbore while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
english.description: Alright, we've taken on foes in the sky and on land, and even in the rain. What happens when the beasts are below your feet, though? We're about to find out!$B$BThe rockworm is a cunning predator, striking at prey from below the sands. Many beasts of Nagrand have grown wary of the rumbling of the earth. Take your clefthoof on out to the sandy shores and see if you can't take down one of the elder rockworms: Ironbore.
english.completion: The sand worm's bit the dust? Well done, I'll get this beast bedded down for the night.
english.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 裂蹄牛训练：兽人猎手
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的裂蹄牛去击败狩猎大师卡拉克。
text.description: 纳格兰的战歌氏族算是一批非常优秀的猎人，我以前还栽他们手里过，真是倒霉。假如你想给你未来的坐骑找点真正的试炼的话，那就应该去会会他们当中的首席猎人。$B$B你能在纳格兰找到一位名叫卡拉克的兽人，死在他手上的凶残动物的数量是他们整个氏族里最多的，所以他们都叫他“狩猎大师”。骑上你的裂蹄牛去干掉他，为那些可怜的小动物报仇！
text.completion: Hunted the hunter, eh? Your beast doesn't seem any worse for wear, either! I'll brush it down.
text.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Clefthoof Training: Orc Hunters
english.objectives: Defeat Karak the Great Hunter while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
english.description: The Warsong Clan of Nagrand are some of the best hunters I've ever had the misfortune of meeting. If anyone can pose a real test for your future mount, it's one of their chief beast-killers.$B$BOut in Nagrand, you'll find an orc by the name of Karak. They call him the Great Hunter, and he's taken down more fierce beasts than any other in the clan. Get astride your clefthoof and bring him down. In the name of the poor wee beasts!
english.completion: Hunted the hunter, eh? Your beast doesn't seem any worse for wear, either! I'll brush it down.
english.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 裂蹄牛训练：铁颚狼
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的裂蹄牛去击败残爪。
text.description: 指挥官，我还有最后一项挑战要给你，这次可没那么简单。$B$B在德拉诺有一种狼，他们的皮肤像夜晚一样漆黑，他们体型比一般的狼要大上一倍，人们称他们为铁颚狼。它们转眼间就能把一个大活人撕成两半，任何脑子正常的动物遇到它们都会吓得腿软。$B$B有一头孤独的铁颚狼离开了它们世代居住的霜火岭跑到了纳格兰定居。骑上你的裂蹄牛去干掉它，如果你们两个能够生还，你的裂蹄牛才能成为一头真正的战兽。
text.completion: Your clefthoof is now fully-trained, and it's all thanks to you! I'm going to tear up here if I don't just hand you these reins and send you on your way. Great job, commander!
text.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Clefthoof Training: The Garn
english.objectives: Defeat Maimclaw while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
english.description: I've got one last challenge for ye, commander, but if it isn't a doozy.$B$BThey call them the garn. Wolves as black as night, and twice the size of a normal wolf, they can tear a man apart in seconds. Any beast in their right mind would be scared witless at the sight of such a predator.$B$BThere's a lone garn that's made it from their usual home in Frostfire, all the way over to Nagrand. Take your clefthoof, mount up, and bring it down. If the two of you survive, your clefthoof will truly be ready.
english.completion: Your clefthoof is now fully-trained, and it's all thanks to you! I'm going to tear up here if I don't just hand you these reins and send you on your way. Great job, commander!
english.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 野猪训练：裂鞭
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的石牙野猪去击败裂鞭。
text.description: 那头野猪似乎在戈尔隆德经历过一些战斗，这样我们训练起来也会比较容易。和其它动物一样，我们先从它的家乡开始。$B$B看看你们两个能否干掉那头叫裂鞭的强力迅猛龙。
text.completion: Those were some mighty big claws to tangle with. Your boar will need a nap after that one.
text.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Boar Training: Riplash
english.objectives: Defeat Riplash while riding your Boar-In-Training.
english.description: That boar's seen it's share of combat out in Gorgrond, so it'll be a bit easier to train. We'll start off in it's home, as you've done with yer other beasties.$B$BSee if the two of you can't take down the mighty raptor known as Riplash.
english.completion: Those were some mighty big claws to tangle with. Your boar will need a nap after that one.
english.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的石牙野猪去击败格兹兰。

text.title: 野豬訓練：殘酷的巨魔
text.objectives: 在騎乘訓練中的野豬時打敗戈利安笞獸者。
text.description: 德拉諾最強大的野獸就棲息於納葛蘭，而這個地區的巨魔學會如何使用殘暴的技巧來馴服牠們。$B$B其中有個叫做戈利安笞獸者的巨魔十分特別，渾身散發血腥和恐懼的味道。去看看你的野豬有什麼反應。
text.completion: Those poor beasts! I'm glad you two put that ogre out of commission. Check back in tomorrow and we can continue the training.
text.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

english.objectives: Defeat the Gorian Beast-Lasher while riding your Boar-In-Training.

text.title: 野猪训练：暴怒飞蛾
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的石牙野猪去击败暴怒飞蛾。
text.description: 在纳格兰的森林中有许多善于躲避捕食者的动物。但其中又要属那只名叫暴怒飞蛾的蛾子做的最好，它浑身覆满了充满恶臭的飞蛾之尘。$B$B如果它能让附近的野狼都不得不退避三舍，这对你的野猪来说一定是一次非常美妙的试炼。看看你能不能让它保持专注，干掉那只飞蛾吧。
text.completion: Glad to see you two make it back. It'll need a bit of time to brush that dust off.
text.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Boar Training: Moth of Wrath
english.objectives: Defeat the Moth of Wrath while riding your Boar-In-Training.
english.description: Deep in the forests of Nagrand are some beasts capable of evading almost any predator. The greatest of them all, the Moth of Wrath, is coated with a foul-smelling dust.$B$BIf the moth dust is enough to keep wolves at bay, it'll probably be a pretty good test for your boar. See if you can't keep it focused and take down that moth.
english.completion: Glad to see you two make it back. It'll need a bit of time to brush that dust off.
english.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: Boar Training: Thundercall
text.objectives: Defeat Thundercall while riding your Boar-In-Training.
text.description: The elements can sometimes pose a problem for some beasts. Ever seen a ram in a thunderstorm? They'll hide behind anything larger than themselves. I'm not sure if they think the world is ending or what, but it's not great if you're atop one at the time.$B$BIn Nagrand, off on a windswept cliff high above the shore, is a creature made of pure thunderstorms. Hop atop your boar and face off against Thundercall, and we'll see if it gets spooked.
text.completion: Well, it's a bit wet, but seems to be in good spirits. I'll get 'er dried off and into bed.
text.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: Boar Training: Ironbore
text.objectives: Defeat Ironbore while riding your Boar-In-Training.
text.description: Alright, we've taken on foes in the sky and on land, and even in the rain. What happens when the beasts are below your feet, though? We're about to find out!$B$BThe rockworm is a cunning predator, striking at prey from below the sands. Many beasts of Nagrand have grown wary of the rumbling of the earth. Take your boar on out to the sandy shores and see if you can't take down one of the elder rockworms: Ironbore.
text.completion: The sand worm's bit the dust? Well done, I'll get this beast bedded down for the night.
text.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 野猪训练：兽人猎手
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的石牙野猪去击败狩猎大师卡拉克。
text.description: 纳格兰的战歌氏族算是一批非常优秀的猎人，我以前还栽他们手里过，真是倒霉。假如你想给你未来的坐骑找点真正的试炼的话，那就应该去会会他们当中的首席猎人。$B$B你能在纳格兰找到一位名叫卡拉克的兽人，死在他手上的凶残动物的数量是他们整个氏族里最多的，所以他们都叫他“狩猎大师”。骑上你的野猪去干掉他，为那些可怜的小动物报仇！
text.completion: Hunted the hunter, eh? Your beast doesn't seem any worse for wear, either! I'll brush it down.
text.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Boar Training: Orc Hunters
english.objectives: Defeat Karak the Great Hunter while riding your Boar-In-Training.
english.description: The Warsong Clan of Nagrand are some of the best hunters I've ever had the misfortune of meeting. If anyone can pose a real test for your future mount, it's one of their chief beast-killers.$B$BOut in Nagrand, you'll find an orc by the name of Karak. They call him the Great Hunter, and he's taken down more fierce beasts than any other in the clan. Get astride your boar and bring him down. In the name of the poor wee beasts!
english.completion: Hunted the hunter, eh? Your beast doesn't seem any worse for wear, either! I'll brush it down.
english.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: Boar Training: The Garn
text.objectives: Defeat Maimclaw while riding your Boar-In-Training.
text.description: I've got one last challenge for ye, commander, but if it isn't a doozy.$B$BThey call them the garn. Wolves as black as night, and twice the size of a normal wolf, they can tear a man apart in seconds. Any beast in their right mind would be scared witless at the sight of such a predator.$B$BThere's a lone garn that's made it from their usual home in Frostfire, all the way over to Nagrand. Take your boar, mount up, and bring it down. If the two of you survive, your boar will truly be ready.
text.completion: Your rocktusk is now ready to see combat, commander. Here's the reins, you'll need 'em ridin' this bucket of muscle!$B$BGreat job with the training!
text.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 淡水兽训练：格兹兰
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的淡水兽去击败格兹兰。
text.description: 这头动物在塔拉多生活过一段时间，我们不如就从那里开始展开训练。这家伙看起来挺温驯的，和其它坐骑相比的话，我想训练它不会花太多时间。$B$B你可能已经知道了，潜伏者擅长隐匿在环境中，靠近并偷窃附近猎物的蛋。让我们瞧瞧你的淡水兽能否识破这天然的伪装。
text.completion: Ye did it! I'm sure your riverbeast's enjoyin' this sort of one-on-one attention. We'll let it rest up a bit.
text.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Riverbeast Training: Gezz'ran
english.objectives: Defeat Gezz'ran while riding your Riverbeast-In-Training.
english.description: This beast's spent quite a few years out in the wilds of Talador, I'd say we start the training there. It's fairly docile, as well. I don't think it will take quite as long to train as the others.$B$BAs ye probably know, stalkers can blend into their environments, allowing them to sneak in and steal the eggs of nearby prey. See if you and your riverbeast can't overcome this natural defense mechanism.
english.completion: Ye did it! I'm sure your riverbeast's enjoyin' this sort of one-on-one attention. We'll let it rest up a bit.
english.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 淡水兽训练：布巴波尔
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的淡水兽去击败布巴波尔。
text.description: 在阿兰卡峰林最南边，来自水下的蘑菇正在不断地侵蚀着陆地。你问结果是什么？古怪的真菌生物现在已经在那里到处漫步了。$B$B其中有一个真菌巨人叫布巴波尔，这是个好机会，让我们瞧瞧你的淡水兽会如何面对它并不熟悉的捕食者。
text.completion: I'll bet that was quite a fight! Great job, let's let it rest for tonight.
text.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Riverbeast Training: Bulbapore
english.objectives: Defeat Bulbapore while riding your Riverbeast-In-Training.
english.description: Way down south in the Spires of Arak, the land's being overtaken by the mushrooms that grow underwater. The result? Strange fungal creatures sprouting up all over the place.$B$BTaking on a strange creature, like the fungal giant Bulbapore, gives us a great chance to expose your riverbeast to predators it's unfamiliar with.
english.completion: I'll bet that was quite a fight! Great job, let's let it rest for tonight.
english.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 河獸訓練：殘酷的巨魔
text.objectives: 在騎乘訓練中的河獸時打敗戈利安笞獸者。
text.description: 德拉諾最強大的野獸就棲息於納葛蘭，而這個地區的巨魔學會如何使用殘暴的技巧來馴服牠們。$B$B其中有個叫做戈利安笞獸者的巨魔十分特別，渾身散發血腥和恐懼的味道。去看看你的河獸有什麼反應。
text.completion: Those poor beasts! I'm glad you two put that ogre out of commission. Check back in tomorrow and we can continue the training.
text.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Riverbeast Training: Cruel Ogres
english.objectives: Defeat the Gorian Beast-Lasher while riding your Riverbeast-In-Training.
english.description: Nagrand is home to the mightiest beasts in Draenor, and the ogres of the region have learned to tame them using brutal techniques.$B$BThere is one ogre in particular, the Gorian Beast-Lasher, that smells of blood and fear. Go on and see how your riverbeast reacts to that.
english.completion: Those poor beasts! I'm glad you two put that ogre out of commission. Check back in tomorrow and we can continue the training.
english.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 淡水兽训练：暗翼大鹏
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的淡水兽去击败暗翼大鹏。
text.description: 纳格兰的风鹏是一种非常聪明的捕食者，它们经常成群结队地突袭猎物。要是你的坐骑不时刻注意着天空的话，就可得跟它这双眼睛说再见了。$B$B去纳格兰干掉那里最凶猛的风鹏——暗翼大鹏。这对你们俩来说都是个试炼。
text.completion: From now on, I'm sure your mount will always remember to keep one eye on the skies. Great job!
text.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Riverbeast Training: Darkwing Roc
english.objectives: Defeat the Darkwing Roc while riding your Riverbeast-In-Training.
english.description: The windrocs of Nagrand are a smart predator, often swooping down on unwary prey in packs. If your beast doesn't keep an eye on the sky, it's likely to lose both of em.'$B$BHead on out to Nagrand and take on the fiercest windroc of the bunch, the Darkwing Roc. That'll be a good test for the both of ye.
english.completion: From now on, I'm sure your mount will always remember to keep one eye on the skies. Great job!

text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的淡水兽去击败暴怒飞蛾。
text.description: 在纳格兰的森林中有许多善于躲避捕食者的动物。但其中又要属那只名叫暴怒飞蛾的蛾子做的最好，它浑身覆满了充满恶臭的飞蛾之尘。$B$B如果它能让附近的野狼都不得不退避三舍，这对你的淡水兽来说一定是一次非常美妙的试炼。看看你能不能让它保持专注，干掉那只飞蛾吧。
text.completion: Glad to see you two make it back. It'll need a bit of time to brush that dust off.
text.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

text.description: 很好，我们解决掉了陆地和天空的敌人，甚至还有雷雨。接下来试试你脚底下的动物如何？答案即将揭晓！$B$B岩虫是一种狡猾的捕食者，它们喜欢从沙土底下钻出来袭击敌人。在纳格兰，很多野兽都学会了注意脚底下的动静。骑上你的淡水兽去那边的沙滩试试，看看你们能不能干掉那里最古老的一只岩虫：铁钻。
text.completion: The sand worm's bit the dust? Well done, I'll get this beast bedded down for the night.
text.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 雷象训练：凶残的食人魔
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的草地践踏者去击败高里亚驱兽者。
text.description: 纳格兰对这头动物来说就像是家一样，而且经过了德莱尼这么多年的驯养，我们要训练它应该会格外容易。$B$B让我们带它去会一会你在那边的食人魔老熟人吧。就是那个浑身充满血腥和恐惧气息的高里亚驱兽者，让我们瞧瞧你的雷象面对他是否还能面不改色。
text.completion: Those poor beasts! I'm glad you two put that ogre out of commission. Check back in tomorrow and we can continue the training.
text.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Elekk Training: Cruel Ogres
english.objectives: Defeat the Gorian Beast-Lasher while riding your Meadowstomper-In-Training.
english.description: This beast is surely at home in Nagrand, and I bet ye after all of the years of domestication by Draenei, it's going to be a snap to train.$B$BLet's set it loose against the ogres of the region that yer familiar with. That Gorian Beast-Lasher, the one that smells of blood and fear, go on and see how your elekk  reacts to that.
english.completion: Those poor beasts! I'm glad you two put that ogre out of commission. Check back in tomorrow and we can continue the training.
english.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 伊萊克訓練：暗翼羅克
text.objectives: 在騎乘訓練中的踏草伊萊克時打敗暗翼羅克。
text.description: 在納葛蘭的風翼貓頭鷹是十分聰明的獵殺者，通常會成群結隊朝著粗心大意的獵物飛撲。如果你的野獸沒能注意天上的威脅，有可能保不住雙眼。$B$B前往納葛蘭，對抗其中最兇猛的風翼貓頭鷹，暗翼羅克。對你們兩個來說，這都是最好的考驗。
text.completion: From now on, I'm sure your mount will always remember to keep one eye on the skies. Great job!
text.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 雷象训练：雷鸣
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的草地践踏者去击败雷鸣。
text.description: 元素生物有时候也会对野兽构成威胁。见过雷暴雨中的山羊吗？它们会想尽办法逃窜，躲到任何比它们大的东西后面。我不知道这是不是山羊们所理解的世界末日，可如果你当时正好骑着一头，那情况就很不妙了。$B$B在纳格兰的海岸上，有一处迎风而立的峭壁。在那峭壁上住着雷暴雨的化身，它的名字叫雷鸣。骑上你的雷象去那儿对付它，让我们瞧瞧你的小象是否也会被吓跑。
text.completion: Well, it's a bit wet, but seems to be in good spirits. I'll get 'er dried off and into bed.
text.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Elekk Training: Thundercall
english.objectives: Defeat Thundercall while riding your Meadowstomper-In-Training.
english.description: The elements can sometimes pose a problem for some beasts. Ever seen a ram in a thunderstorm? They'll hide behind anything larger than themselves. I'm not sure if they think the world is ending or what, but it's not great if you're atop one at the time.$B$BIn Nagrand, off on a windswept cliff high above the shore, is a creature made of pure thunderstorms. Hop atop your elekk and face off against Thundercall, and we'll see if it gets spooked.
english.completion: Well, it's a bit wet, but seems to be in good spirits. I'll get 'er dried off and into bed.
english.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: Elekk Training: Ironbore
text.objectives: Defeat Ironbore while riding your Meadowstomper-In-Training.
text.description: Alright, we've taken on foes in the sky and on land, and even in the rain. What happens when the beasts are below your feet, though? We're about to find out!$B$BThe rockworm is a cunning predator, striking at prey from below the sands. Many beasts of Nagrand have grown wary of the rumbling of the earth. Take your elekk on out to the sandy shores and see if you can't take down one of the elder rockworms: Ironbore.
text.completion: The sand worm's bit the dust? Well done, I'll get this beast bedded down for the night.
text.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Elekk Training: Ironbore
english.objectives: Defeat Ironbore while riding your Meadowstomper-In-Training.

text.title: 雷象训练：兽人猎手
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的草地践踏者去击败狩猎大师卡拉克。
text.description: 纳格兰的战歌氏族算是一批非常优秀的猎人，我以前还栽他们手里过，真是倒霉。假如你想给你未来的坐骑找点真正的试炼的话，那就应该去会会他们当中的首席猎人。$B$B你能在纳格兰找到一位名叫卡拉克的兽人，死在他手上的凶残动物的数量是他们整个氏族里最多的，所以他们都叫他“狩猎大师”。骑上你的雷象去干掉他，为那些可怜的小动物报仇！
text.completion: Hunted the hunter, eh? Your beast doesn't seem any worse for wear, either! I'll brush it down.
text.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Elekk Training: Orc Hunters
english.objectives: Defeat Karak the Great Hunter while riding your Meadowstomper-In-Training.
english.description: The Warsong Clan of Nagrand are some of the best hunters I've ever had the misfortune of meeting. If anyone can pose a real test for your future mount, it's one of their chief beast-killers.$B$BOut in Nagrand, you'll find an orc by the name of Karak. They call him the Great Hunter, and he's taken down more fierce beasts than any other in the clan. Get astride your elekk and bring him down. In the name of the poor wee beasts!
english.completion: Hunted the hunter, eh? Your beast doesn't seem any worse for wear, either! I'll brush it down.
english.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 雷象训练：铁颚狼
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的草地践踏者去击败残爪。
text.description: 指挥官，我还有最后一项挑战要给你，这次可没那么简单。$B$B在德拉诺有一种狼，他们的皮肤像夜晚一样漆黑，他们体型比一般的狼要大上一倍，人们称他们为铁颚狼。它们转眼间就能把一个大活人撕成两半，任何脑子正常的动物遇到它们都会吓得腿软。$B$B有一头孤独的铁颚狼离开了它们世代居住的霜火岭跑到了纳格兰定居。骑上你的雷象去干掉它，如果你们两个能够生还，你的雷象才能成为一头真正的战兽。
text.completion: A fine beast, to be sure, commander. It'll stand up in even the toughest battles.$B$BI'll admit, I'm a bit jealous of ye'! Here's the reins! I'll be sure to take good care of it when ye bring it back.
text.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Elekk Training: The Garn
english.objectives: Defeat Maimclaw while riding your Meadowstomper-In-Training.
english.description: I've got one last challenge for ye, commander, but if it isn't a doozy.$B$BThey call them the garn. Wolves as black as night, and twice the size of a normal wolf, they can tear a man apart in seconds. Any beast in their right mind would be scared witless at the sight of such a predator.$B$BThere's a lone garn that's made it from their usual home in Frostfire, all the way over to Nagrand. Take your elekk, mount up, and bring it down. If the two of you survive, your elekk will truly be ready.
english.completion: A fine beast, to be sure, commander. It'll stand up in even the toughest battles.$B$BI'll admit, I'm a bit jealous of ye'! Here's the reins! I'll be sure to take good care of it when ye bring it back.
english.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 座狼训练：凶残的食人魔
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的啸狼去击败高里亚驱兽者。
text.description: 德拉诺的野狼是这里最凶残的野兽，它们对兽人和食人魔的外表和气味也是相当熟悉。我们要训练这团充满死亡气息的小毛球应该花不了多少时间。$B$B让我们带它去会一会你在那边的食人魔老熟人吧。就是那个浑身充满血腥和恐惧气息的高里亚驱兽者，让我们瞧瞧你的座狼面对他是否还能面不改色。
text.completion: Those poor beasts! I'm glad you two put that ogre out of commission. Check back in tomorrow and we can continue the training.
text.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Wolf Training: Cruel Ogres
english.objectives: Defeat the Gorian Beast-Lasher while riding your Snarler-In-Training.
english.description: The wolves of Draenor are some of the most savage beasts around, but they've also gotten used to the sights and smells of the orcs and ogres that live here. It shouldn't take us much time at all to train this little ball of fur and death.$B$BLet's set it loose against the ogres of the region that yer familiar with. That Gorian Beast-Lasher, the one that smells of blood and fear, go on and see how your wolf reacts to that.
english.completion: Those poor beasts! I'm glad you two put that ogre out of commission. Check back in tomorrow and we can continue the training.
english.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 狼之訓練：暗翼羅克
text.objectives: 在騎乘訓練中的咆哮者時打敗暗翼羅克。
text.description: 在納葛蘭的風翼貓頭鷹是十分聰明的掠食者，通常會成群結隊朝著沒警覺的獵物飛撲。如果你的野獸不好好看著天上來的威脅，牠最後就再也沒機會看到天空了。$B$B前往納葛蘭，對抗其中最兇猛的風翼貓頭鷹，暗翼羅克。對你們兩個來說，這都會是最棒的一場考驗。
text.completion: From now on, I'm sure your mount will always remember to keep one eye on the skies. Great job!
text.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Wolf Training: Darkwing Roc
english.objectives: Defeat the Darkwing Roc while riding your Snarler-In-Training.
english.description: The windrocs of Nagrand are a smart predator, often swooping down on unwary prey in packs. If your beast doesn't keep an eye on the sky, it's likely to lose both of em.'$B$BHead on out to Nagrand and take on the fiercest windroc of the bunch, the Darkwing Roc. That'll be a good test for the both of ye.
english.completion: From now on, I'm sure your mount will always remember to keep one eye on the skies. Great job!
english.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: Wolf Training: Moth of Wrath
text.objectives: Defeat the Moth of Wrath while riding your Snarler-In-Training.
text.description: Deep in the forests of Nagrand are some beasts capable of evading almost any predator. The greatest of them all, the Moth of Wrath, is coated with a foul-smelling dust.$B$BIf the moth dust is enough to keep wolves at bay, it'll probably be a pretty good test for your wolf. See if you can't keep it focused and take down that moth.
text.completion: Glad to see you two make it back. It'll need a bit of time to brush that dust off.
text.completed: Return to Fanny Firebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 黑手之印
text.objectives: 在普通难度下，从黑石铸造厂每一区的最终首领身上获取4份山脉余烬、4份石之心和4份铁中银。
text.description: <古拉鲁克长叹一声……像是解脱……又好像带有悔意？>$B$B曾几何时，我也在这座工厂里，作为一名黑石兽人自豪地工作着。但那是一条错误的道路。自古以来，我们的铁锤该铸造的就是利剑和铁斧……而不是这些由陌生人暗地里授意的机器。$B$B但督军是不会听这些的，我们只有用武力来劝服他。假如你可以从这座铸造厂里最强大的保卫者身上获取精华，我就能为你铸造一枚印记，使你能够直接进入黑手的熔炉。
text.progress: I will require essences from each of the Foundry's guardians if this is to work.
text.completion: You have done it!$B$B<Goraluk takes the items from your hands, and turns his back for a few moments>$B$BNow, I will touch this Sigil to your hand, and the entrance to the Crucible will open at your touch. Good luck.
text.completed: Return to Goraluk Anvilcrack within the Dread Grotto.

english.title: Sigil of the Black Hand
english.objectives: Collect 4 Embers of the Mountain, 4 Hearts of Stone, and 4 Shards of Iron from the final bosses of each wing of the Blackrock Foundry on Normal difficulty.
english.description: <Goraluk sighs with... relief? ...or perhaps regret?>$B$BOnce I walked these halls with pride, holding my head high as an orc of the Blackrock clan. But this is a wrong path. Our hammers were meant to craft axes, swords... not these machines from the stranger's whispers.$B$BThe Warlord will not be swayed, but by force. If you can retrieve essences from the Foundry's most powerful guardians, I can craft for you a sigil that will permit direct access to Blackhand's Crucible.
english.progress: I will require essences from each of the Foundry's guardians if this is to work.
english.completion: You have done it!$B$B<Goraluk takes the items from your hands, and turns his back for a few moments>$B$BNow, I will touch this Sigil to your hand, and the entrance to the Crucible will open at your touch. Good luck.

text.title: 野猪训练：裂鞭
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的石牙野猪去击败裂鞭。
text.description: 这头野猪的家乡就在戈尔隆德荒凉的平原上，我们训练起来会比较容易。和其它动物一样，我们先从它的家乡开始。$B$B让我瞧瞧你们两个能否干掉那头叫裂鞭的大迅猛龙，那家伙可是素来以捕食野猪闻名。
text.completion: A mighty kill. Your beast will need to rest now.
text.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

english.title: Boar Training: Riplash
english.objectives: Defeat Riplash while riding your Boar-In-Training.
english.description: This boar is at home in the rocky plains of Gorgrond, so it will be easier to train. As with other beasts, we will begin the training in the place it calls home.$B$BTest your boar against the great predator Riplash, a raptor known to hunt boars.
english.completion: A mighty kill. Your beast will need to rest now.
english.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

text.title: 野猪训练：格兹兰
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的石牙野猪去击败格兹兰。
text.description: 德拉诺的许多生物都是在最为严酷的环境中成长起来的。在这当中，最狡猾的要数潜伏者。$B$B这种怪物可以潜伏在环境之中，潜行并偷取附近猎物的蛋。这次让我们瞧瞧你的坐骑能否识破这种天然的伪装。你可以在塔拉多找到合适的潜伏者。
text.completion: A savage beast, but you have triumphed. Fine work, I will get your mount some water.
text.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

english.title: Boar Training: Gezz'ran
english.objectives: Defeat Gezz'ran while riding your Boar-In-Training.
english.description: Many of the creatures of Draenor have grown and thrived in a most hostile environment. One of the most cunning on is the stalker.$B$BStalkers can blend into their environments, allowing them to sneak in and steal the eggs of nearby prey. See if you and your beast can overcome this natural defense mechanism. You will find a proper predator in Talador.
english.completion: A savage beast, but you have triumphed. Fine work, I will get your mount some water.
english.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

text.title: 野猪训练：布巴波尔
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的石牙野猪去击败布巴波尔。
text.description: 在遥远南方的阿兰卡峰林，生长在水下的蘑菇正在不断地侵蚀着陆地，古怪的真菌生物四处横行。$B$B其中有一个真菌巨人叫布巴波尔，正好让你的坐骑见识一下它不曾见过的捕食者。
text.completion: You have returned victorious. I will bed your mount down for the night.
text.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

english.title: Boar Training: Bulbapore
english.objectives: Defeat Bulbapore while riding your Boar-In-Training.
english.description: In the far south, in the Spires of Arak, the land is being swallowed by the mushrooms that grow underwater, and strange fungal creatures grow uninhibited.$B$BTaking on a strange creature, like the fungal giant Bulbapore, will grant you a chance to expose your mount to unfamiliar predators.
english.completion: You have returned victorious. I will bed your mount down for the night.
english.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

text.title: Boar Training: Cruel Ogres
text.objectives: Defeat the Gorian Beast-Lasher while riding your Boar-In-Training.
text.description: Nagrand is home to the mightiest beasts in Draenor, and the ogres of the region have learned to tame them using brutal techniques.$B$BThere is one ogre in particular, the Gorian Beast-Lasher, that smells of blood and fear. Go on and see how your beast reacts to that.
text.completion: Those beasts will recover, in time. Let us rest for tonight, you have done well.
text.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

english.title: Boar Training: Cruel Ogres
english.objectives: Defeat the Gorian Beast-Lasher while riding your Boar-In-Training.
english.description: Nagrand is home to the mightiest beasts in Draenor, and the ogres of the region have learned to tame them using brutal techniques.$B$BThere is one ogre in particular, the Gorian Beast-Lasher, that smells of blood and fear. Go on and see how your beast reacts to that.
english.completion: Those beasts will recover, in time. Let us rest for tonight, you have done well.
english.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

text.title: 野猪训练：暗翼大鹏
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的石牙野猪去击败暗翼大鹏。
text.description: 纳格兰的风鹏是一种非常聪明的捕食者，它们经常成群结队地突袭猎物。要是你的坐骑不时刻注意着天空的话，就可得跟它这双眼睛说再见了。$B$B去纳格兰干掉那里最凶猛的风鹏——暗翼大鹏。这对你的坐骑来说是个不错的试炼。
text.completion: From now on, your mount will always remember to keep one eye on the skies.
text.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

english.title: Boar Training: Darkwing Roc
english.objectives: Defeat the Darkwing Roc while riding your Boar-In-Training.
english.description: The windrocs of Nagrand are a smart predator, often swooping down on unwary prey in packs. If your beast doesn't keep an eye on the sky, it's likely to lose both.$B$BTravel to Nagrand and take on the fiercest windroc of the bunch, the Darkwing Roc. It will be a good test for your mount.
english.completion: From now on, your mount will always remember to keep one eye on the skies.
english.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

text.title: 野猪训练：暴怒飞蛾
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的石牙野猪去击败暴怒飞蛾。
text.description: 在纳格兰的森林中有许多善于躲避捕食者的动物。但其中又要属那只名叫暴怒飞蛾的蛾子做的最好，它浑身覆满了充满恶臭的飞蛾之尘。$B$B如果它能让附近的野狼都不得不退避三舍，这对你的野猪来说一定是一次非常美妙的试炼。看看你能不能让它保持专注，干掉那只飞蛾吧。
text.completion: Glad to see you back. I will need some time to brush that dust off of your mount.
text.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

english.title: Boar Training: Moth of Wrath
english.objectives: Defeat the Moth of Wrath while riding your Boar-In-Training.
english.description: Deep in the forests of Nagrand are some beasts capable of evading almost any predator. The greatest of them all, the Moth of Wrath, is coated with a foul-smelling dust.$B$BIf the moth dust is enough to keep wolves at bay, it will probably be a pretty good test for your boar. See if you can keep it focused and defeat the moth.
english.completion: Glad to see you back. I will need some time to brush that dust off of your mount.
english.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

text.title: 野猪训练：雷鸣
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的石牙野猪去击败雷鸣。
text.description: 元素生物有时候也会对野兽构成威胁。即使是最强大座狼也常会被远处的雷声所惊吓。$B$B在纳格兰的海岸，有一处迎风而立的峭壁。在那峭壁上有一只由纯粹的雷雨构成的生物，它的名字叫雷鸣。骑上你的坐骑去那儿对付它，让我们瞧瞧结果如何。
text.completion: Your mount is bit wet, but seems to be in good spirits. I will dry it off and put it to rest.
text.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

english.title: Boar Training: Thundercall
english.objectives: Defeat Thundercall while riding your Boar-In-Training.
english.description: The elements can sometimes pose a problem for some beasts. Even the mightiest wolf will often cower at the sound of thunder in the distance.$B$BIn Nagrand, off on a windswept cliff high above the shore, is a creature made of pure thunderstorms. Hop atop your beast and face off against Thundercall, and we will see how your mount fares.
english.completion: Your mount is bit wet, but seems to be in good spirits. I will dry it off and put it to rest.
english.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

text.title: Boar Training: Ironbore
text.objectives: Defeat Ironbore while riding your Boar-In-Training.
text.description: You have defeated foes in the sky and on land, and even in the rain. Next, you face beasts beneath your very feet.$B$BThe rockworm is a cunning predator, striking at prey from below the sands. Many beasts of Nagrand have grown wary of the rumbling of the earth. Take your mount on out to the sandy shores test it against the elder worm Ironbore.
text.completion: You stand strong, though the ground crumbles. Admirable.$B$BAllow your mount to rest for the night.
text.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

english.title: Boar Training: Ironbore
english.objectives: Defeat Ironbore while riding your Boar-In-Training.
english.description: You have defeated foes in the sky and on land, and even in the rain. Next, you face beasts beneath your very feet.$B$BThe rockworm is a cunning predator, striking at prey from below the sands. Many beasts of Nagrand have grown wary of the rumbling of the earth. Take your mount on out to the sandy shores test it against the elder worm Ironbore.
english.completion: You stand strong, though the ground crumbles. Admirable.$B$BAllow your mount to rest for the night.
english.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

text.title: 野猪训练：兽人猎手
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的石牙野猪去击败狩猎大师卡拉克。
text.description: 纳格兰的战歌氏族可跻身德拉诺最优秀的猎人的行列，他们的狩猎者可以帮我们为这批坐骑提供试炼。$B$B你能在纳格兰找到一位名叫狩猎大师卡拉克的兽人，死在他手上的凶残动物的数量是他们整个氏族里最多的。骑上你的坐骑去干掉他，为那些被杀害的动物报仇。
text.completion: Ah, you have hunted the hunter. Many beasts will be pleased tonight.
text.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

english.title: Boar Training: Orc Hunters
english.objectives: Defeat Karak the Great Hunter while riding your Boar-In-Training.
english.description: The Warsong Clan of Nagrand are some of the finest hunters the world of Draenor has ever known. Their beast-killers will aid us in putting this mount to the test.$B$BOut in Nagrand, you will find an orc by the name of Karak, the Great Hunter. He has slain more fierce beasts than any other in the clan. Face him astride your mount, and avenge the slain.
english.completion: Ah, you have hunted the hunter. Many beasts will be pleased tonight.
english.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

text.title: 野猪训练：铁颚狼
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的石牙野猪去击败残爪。
text.description: 你的坐骑的最后一项挑战将是面对这片大地上最可怕的一种动物。$B$B有一种狼，他们的皮肤像夜晚一样漆黑，他们体型比一般的狼要大上一倍，它们就是铁颚狼。它们转眼间就能把一个兽人撕成两半，野兽们害怕它们不是没有理由的。$B$B现在有一头孤独的铁颚狼跑到了纳格兰定居。骑上你的野猪去干掉它，如果你们两个能够生还，你的野猪才真正算是准备好了。
text.completion: The garn is defeated, and your boar is now ready to see combat. Here are the reins, may you never part company.
text.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

english.title: Boar Training: The Garn
english.objectives: Defeat Maimclaw while riding your Boar-In-Training.
english.description: The last test for your mount will pit it against one of the great terrors of this land.$B$BThe garn. Wolves as black as night, and twice the size of a normal wolf, they can tear an orc apart in mere moments. The beasts here wisely fear them.$B$BThere is a lone garn that calls Nagrand its home. Take your boar, mount up, and bring it down. If the two of you survive, your boar will truly be ready.
english.completion: The garn is defeated, and your boar is now ready to see combat. Here are the reins, may you never part company.
english.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

text.title: 收废铁
text.objectives: 从德拉诺的钢铁部落成员身上收集$1oa块钢铁部落碎片。
text.description:
在军械库，我们可以把你收集到的钢铁部落护甲碎片打造成新的装备。尽管那并不是世上最坚实的材料，但看起来不错。

去找些钢铁部落碎片，然后回来找我。我会给你一件体面的战袍作为奖励。
text.progress: Got those scraps?
text.completion: Those scraps will do.
text.completed: Return to Grun'lek at the War Mill in your garrison.

english.title: Scraps of Iron
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Iron Horde Scraps from Iron Horde on Draenor.
english.description:
At the armory, we can take scraps of Iron Horde armor that you collect and turn them into new gear. It's not the strongest stuff in the world, but it looks good.

Get some Iron Horde scraps and come back my way. I'll set you up with a nice tabard for your troubles.
english.progress: Got those scraps?
english.completion: Yes, these debris will fit perfectly.
english.completed: Return to Grun'lek at the War Mill in your garrison.

text.title: 特立独行的发明
text.objectives: 从地精车间的工作台上拿取一份发明。
text.description:
我们的车间无时无刻不在运作，我们一直在出产新发明。你可以在我身后的工作台上找到它们。

快去拿今天的伟大发明吧。使用时产生的任何后果请自行负责。
text.completion: Pretty cool invention you have there.
text.completed: Return to Vee at the Goblin Workshop in your garrison.

english.title: Unconventional Inventions
english.objectives: Acquire an invention from the workbench at your Goblin Workshop.
english.description:
We've got a lot goin' on here at the workshop. We're buildin' new inventions all the time, and you can find 'em behind me on the workbench.

Go ahead and grab today's glorious invention. Use it at your own risk.
english.completion: Интересные изобретения у тебя тут.
english.completed: Return to Vee at the Goblin Workshop in your garrison.

text.title: 废物利用
text.objectives: 在废品站的焚化炉附近使用一小袋回收的物资。
text.description:
在废品站，你可以查看你的追随者们从战场上带回来的额外材料，并把所有有用的东西保留下来。

我手头有一包我们的人带回来的额外材料，但还没仔细分拣过。要不你就把它带到焚化炉那边去，看看里面还有没有什么能用的东西。
text.progress: Have you burned through that bag of salvage yet?
text.completion: That's all? Well. don't feel too bad. Some days we find nothing and the next we hit the jackpot!$B$BHere, I have a fresh supply of items from our latest outing. Check them out.$B$BGood luck!
text.completed: Return to Lumba the Crusher at the Salvage Yard in your garrison.

english.title: Salvaging the Situation
english.objectives: Use the Small Sack of Salavaged Goods near the incinerator at your Salvage Yard.
english.description:
Here at the Salvage Yard we inspect any extra material your followers bring back from the field, preserving anything that may be useful.

I have an extra pack of material our people brought in that I've yet to go through. Why don't you take it over to the incinerator and see if it contains anything useful?
english.progress: Have you burned through that bag of salvage yet?
english.completion: И все? Не расстраивайся, иногда мы не находим ничего, а в другой раз полезные находки так и прут.$B$BУ меня есть свежие вещи с последней вылазки. Проверь их.$b$bУдачи!
english.completed: Return to Lumba the Crusher at the Salvage Yard in your garrison.

text.title: 猎头的收获
text.objectives: 从霜壁旅社的阿坎亚那里雇佣一位追随者。
text.description:
嗨，伙计，我是新来的猎头。
这座酒馆是冒险者们长途跋涉后歇息的好地方。同时自然也是招募他们加入我们的好地方。

我这边有几个新来应聘的，假如你能挑一个我们能用的，我会给你点回扣的。
text.completion: I'm glad ya be findin' a good hire!$B$BMake sure to check back every week and I'll bring ya me latest recruits.
text.completed: Return to Akanja at Frostwall Tavern in your garrison.

english.title: The Headhunter's Harvest
english.objectives: Recruit a follower from Akanja in the Frostwall Tavern.
english.description:
Hey der mon, I be ya new headhunter. 
The tavern be a perfect place for adventurers to rest after a long journey. It also be a great place to talk them into joining our cause.

I be havin' a few recruits for ya to look at, if ya find one we can hire then I'll give ya a little somethin' as a finder fee for ya time.
english.completion:
Рада, что мы сработались!

Заглядывай каждую неделю, чтобы успеть ухватить новых наемников.
english.completed: Return to Akanja at Frostwall Tavern in your garrison.

objectiveDetails.description: 从猎头处招募一位追随者

text.title: 裂蹄牛训练：巨齿
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的裂蹄牛去击败巨齿。
text.description: 训练战斗坐骑的下一步是要让它熟悉战斗的情景和声音。假如处理不当，它可能会在非常不恰当的时机下害怕并逃走。$B$B带上这头小裂蹄牛，然后骑着它去影月谷平原地区找最大的一头野兽。面对这样一个敌人，你的坐骑能够更快地成长。
text.completion: Your clefthoof appears worn, but happy. You have done well, let it rest for a while.
text.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

english.title: Clefthoof Training: Great-Tusk
english.objectives: Defeat Great-Tusk while riding your Clefthoof -In-Training.
english.description: The next  step in training your mount for war will be getting it used to the sights and sounds of combat. If it is not trained properly, it might become afraid at a very inopportune time.$B$BThough small, take your clefthoof to the plains of Shadowmoon Valley and find the greatest beast you can. It will grow quickly against such a foe.
english.completion: Your clefthoof appears worn, but happy. You have done well, let it rest for a while.
english.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

text.title: 裂蹄牛训练：拉基尔
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的裂蹄牛去击败拉基尔。
text.description: 霜火岭对你的裂蹄牛来说就像是故乡一样，我们就在这儿展开训练。$B$B在这片冰原上，你会找到一只散布着死亡和鲜血的猎手：可怕的拉基尔。它可是这个地方的灾星，对你未来的坐骑来说，它也是一个很好的实战对象。
text.completion: The clefthoof is in good shape, you are a fine trainer for the beast. It will require some rest.
text.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

english.title: Clefthoof Training: Rakkiri
english.objectives: Defeat Rakkiri while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
english.description: Your clefthoof is most at home here in Frostfire Ridge, and that is where we will begin the training.$B$BOut on the icy plains, you will find a hunter of blood and death. The winged terror Rakkiri is feared by beasts across this region, and will prove a good first test for your future mount.
english.completion: The clefthoof is in good shape, you are a fine trainer for the beast. It will require some rest.
english.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

text.title: 裂蹄牛训练：裂鞭
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的裂蹄牛去击败裂鞭。
text.description: 许多坐骑在见到凶残的捕食者时都会吓得腿软。而在戈尔隆德荒凉的峭壁间，生存着世上最凶残的捕食者。你将在那里迎接下一场挑战。$B$B带上你的坐骑去大迅猛龙裂鞭的巢穴，看看你能否得胜归来。
text.completion: A mighty kill. Your beast will need to rest now.
text.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

english.title: Clefthoof Training: Riplash
english.objectives: Defeat Riplash while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
english.description: Many beasts will cower in fear at the sight of a mighty predator. In the desolate cliffs of Gorgrond lives one of the most fierce. It will prove your next challenge.$B$BTake your beast to the nest of the great Riplash, and see if you cannot emerge victorious.
english.completion: A mighty kill. Your beast will need to rest now.
english.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的裂蹄牛去击败格兹兰。

text.completion: A savage beast, but you have triumphed. Fine work, I will get your mount some water.
text.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

english.description: Many of the creatures of Draenor have grown and thrived in a most hostile environment. One of the most cunning on is the stalker.$B$BStalkers can blend into their environments, allowing them to sneak in and steal the eggs of nearby prey. See if you and your beast can overcome this natural defense mechanism. You will find a proper predator in Talador.
english.completion: A savage beast, but you have triumphed. Fine work, I will get your mount some water.
english.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的裂蹄牛去击败布巴波尔。
text.description: 在遥远南方的阿兰卡峰林，生长在水下的蘑菇正在不断地侵蚀着陆地，古怪的真菌生物四处横行。$B$B其中有一个真菌巨人叫布巴波尔，正好让你的坐骑见识一下它不曾见过的捕食者。
text.completion: You have returned victorious. I will bed your mount down for the night.
text.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

english.objectives: Defeat Bulbapore while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
english.description: In the far south, in the Spires of Arak, the land is being swallowed by the mushrooms that grow underwater, and strange fungal creatures grow uninhibited.$B$BTaking on a strange creature, like the fungal giant Bulbapore, will grant you a chance to expose your mount to unfamiliar predators.
english.completion: You have returned victorious. I will bed your mount down for the night.
english.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

text.title: 裂蹄牛训练：凶残的食人魔
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的裂蹄牛去击败高里亚驱兽者。
text.description: 在纳格兰居住着德拉诺最强大的野兽，而且那里的食人魔使用一种非常残忍的手段驯养他们。$B$B其中，又数那个叫高里亚驱兽者的尤为凶残。他浑身充满了血腥和恐惧的气息。让我们瞧瞧你的坐骑面对他是否还能面不改色。
text.completion: Those beasts will recover, in time. Let us rest for tonight, you have done well.
text.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

english.title: Clefthoof Training: Cruel Ogres
english.objectives: Defeat the Gorian Beast-Lasher while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
english.description: Nagrand is home to the mightiest beasts in Draenor, and the ogres of the region have learned to tame them using brutal techniques.$B$BThere is one ogre in particular, the Gorian Beast-Lasher, that smells of blood and fear. Go on and see how your beast reacts to that.
english.completion: Those beasts will recover, in time. Let us rest for tonight, you have done well.
english.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

text.title: Clefthoof Training: Darkwing Roc
text.objectives: Defeat the Darkwing Roc while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
text.description: The windrocs of Nagrand are a smart predator, often swooping down on unwary prey in packs. If your beast doesn't keep an eye on the sky, it's likely to lose both.$B$BTravel to Nagrand and take on the fiercest windroc of the bunch, the Darkwing Roc. It will be a good test for your mount.
text.completion: From now on, your mount will always remember to keep one eye on the skies.
text.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

text.title: Clefthoof Training: Moth of Wrath
text.objectives: Defeat the Moth of Wrath while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
text.description: Deep in the forests of Nagrand are some beasts capable of evading almost any predator. The greatest of them all, the Moth of Wrath, is coated with a foul-smelling dust.$B$BIf the moth dust is enough to keep wolves at bay, it will probably be a pretty good test for your clefthoof. See if you can keep it focused and defeat the moth.
text.completion: Glad to see you back. I will need some time to brush that dust off of your mount.
text.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

text.title: 裂蹄牛训练：雷鸣
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的裂蹄牛去击败雷鸣。
text.description: 元素生物有时候也会对野兽构成威胁。即使是最强大座狼也常会被远处的雷声所惊吓。$B$B在纳格兰的海岸，有一处迎风而立的峭壁。在那峭壁上有一只由纯粹的雷雨构成的生物，它的名字叫雷鸣。骑上你的坐骑去那儿对付它，让我们瞧瞧结果如何。
text.completion: Your mount is bit wet, but seems to be in good spirits. I will dry it off and put it to rest.
text.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

english.title: Clefthoof Training: Thundercall
english.objectives: Defeat Thundercall while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
english.description: The elements can sometimes pose a problem for some beasts. Even the mightiest wolf will often cower at the sound of thunder in the distance.$B$BIn Nagrand, off on a windswept cliff high above the shore, is a creature made of pure thunderstorms. Hop atop your beast and face off against Thundercall, and we will see how your mount fares.
english.completion: Your mount is bit wet, but seems to be in good spirits. I will dry it off and put it to rest.
english.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

text.title: Clefthoof Training: Ironbore
text.objectives: Defeat Ironbore while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
text.description: You have defeated foes in the sky and on land, and even in the rain. Next, you face beasts beneath your very feet.$B$BThe rockworm is a cunning predator, striking at prey from below the sands. Many beasts of Nagrand have grown wary of the rumbling of the earth. Take your mount on out to the sandy shores and test it against the elder worm Ironbore.
text.completion: You stand strong, though the ground crumbles. Admirable.$B$BAllow your mount to rest for the night.
text.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

text.title: 裂蹄牛训练：兽人猎手
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的裂蹄牛去击败狩猎大师卡拉克。
text.description: 纳格兰的战歌氏族可跻身德拉诺最优秀的猎人的行列，他们的狩猎者可以帮我们为这批坐骑提供试炼。$B$B你能在纳格兰找到一位名叫狩猎大师卡拉克的兽人，死在他手上的凶残动物的数量是他们整个氏族里最多的。骑上你的坐骑去干掉他，为那些被杀害的动物报仇。
text.completion: Ah, you have hunted the hunter. Many beasts will be pleased tonight.
text.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

english.title: Clefthoof Training: Orc Hunters
english.objectives: Defeat Karak the Great Hunter while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
english.description: The Warsong Clan of Nagrand are some of the finest hunters the world of Draenor has ever known. Their beast-killers will aid us in putting this mount to the test.$B$BOut in Nagrand, you will find an orc by the name of Karak, the Great Hunter. He has slain more fierce beasts than any other in the clan. Face him astride your mount, and avenge the slain.
english.completion: Ah, you have hunted the hunter. Many beasts will be pleased tonight.
english.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

text.title: 裂蹄牛训练：铁颚狼
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的裂蹄牛去击败残爪。
text.description: 你的坐骑的最后一项挑战将是面对这片大地上最可怕的一种动物。$B$B有一种狼，他们的皮肤像夜晚一样漆黑，他们体型比一般的狼要大上一倍，它们就是铁颚狼。它们转眼间就能把一个兽人撕成两半，野兽们害怕它们不是没有理由的。$B$B现在有一头孤独的铁颚狼跑到了纳格兰定居。骑上你的裂蹄牛去干掉它，如果你们两个能够生还，你的裂蹄牛才真正算是准备好了。
text.completion: The clefthoof is now fully-trained and prepared to be your mount. Take care of the beast, I hope to see the two of you again shortly.
text.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

english.title: Clefthoof Training: The Garn
english.objectives: Defeat Maimclaw while riding your Clefthoof-In-Training.
english.description: The last test for your mount will pit it against one of the great terrors of this land.$B$BThe garn. Wolves as black as night, and twice the size of a normal wolf, they can tear an orc apart in mere moments. The beasts here wisely fear them.$B$BThere is a lone garn that calls Nagrand its home. Take your clefthoof, mount up, and bring it down. If the two of you survive, your clefthoof will truly be ready.
english.completion: The clefthoof is now fully-trained and prepared to be your mount. Take care of the beast, I hope to see the two of you again shortly.
english.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

text.title: 物流失误
text.objectives: 收集$1oa箱剩余物资。
text.description:
$G先生:女士;，仓库已经全面投入使用，我已经妥善存放了你的补给品，并将它们逐一登记在册。

可惜我在盘点物资的过程中发现，我们弄丢了几箱剩余物资——可能是被搬运工放错地方了。

要是你在巡视时发现任何剩余物资的话，请把它们交给我，我会更新我们的货品清单。
text.progress: Hello commander, what can I do for you?
text.completion: Thank you, according to the ledger that appears to be everything we're missing.$BThose peons are going to be cleaning the latrines tonight for this!
text.completed: Return to Yorn Longhoof at the Storehouse in your garrison.

english.title: Lost in Transition
english.objectives: Gather $1oa Crate of Surplus Materials.
english.description:
$GSir:Ma'am;, the storehouse is fully operational and I've seen to it that your supplies are safely stored away and accounted for.

Unfortunately, during the rest of my audit I found that we are missing a few crates of surplus material - probably misplaced by one of the porters.

If you happen to come across any of the surplus crates while making your rounds, please bring them to me and I'll update our ledger.
english.progress: Hello commander, what can I do for you?
english.completion:
Thank you, according to the ledger that appears to be everything we're missing.
Those peons are going to be cleaning the latrines tonight for this!
english.completed: Return to Yorn Longhoof at the Storehouse in your garrison.

text.title: 商业机密
text.objectives: 找到并唤醒失踪的商人。
text.description:
为了打发时间，商人们通常会喝点小酒来提提神，你懂的吧。

但有时候，有些人会喝得太多。你的商人可能刚迈出门就倒在树下睡过去了。这种事情也是时有发生。

幸运的是，我这有一种专门用来弄醒这些酒醉商人的饮料。只要泼上一点，他们就会更愿意起来干活。
text.completion: You have learned one of my tricks of the trade, $n.
text.completed: Return to Fayla Fairfeather at the Trading Post in your garrison.

english.title: Tricks of the Trade
english.objectives: Find and rouse the missing Trader.
english.description:
To pass the time, traders have been known to consume beverages of an inspired nature, if you know what I mean.

Sometimes, they drink a bit too much. Your trader might have stumbled beyond the gates and passed out under a tree. It's been known to happen from time to time.

Luckily, I have a brew that I use to rouse groggy traders. One splash and I find they're more willing to work.
english.completion: $n, you $gBegot: Begot: One of the secrets of my craft.
english.completed: Return to Fayla Fairfeather at the Trading Post in your garrison.

text.title: 雷象训练：凶残的食人魔
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的草地践踏者去击败高里亚驱兽者。
text.description: 纳格兰对这头动物来说就像是家一样，而且经过了德莱尼这么多年的驯养，我们要训练它应该会格外容易。$B$B让我们带它去会一会你在那边的食人魔老熟人吧，那个浑身充满了血腥和恐惧气息的高里亚驱兽者。让我们瞧瞧你的雷象面对他是否还能面不改色。
text.completion: Those beasts will recover, in time. Let us rest for tonight, you have done well.
text.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

english.title: Elekk Training: Cruel Ogres
english.objectives: Defeat the Gorian Beast-Lasher while riding your Meadowstomper-In-Training.
english.description: This beast is surely at home in Nagrand, and after the years of domestication by Draenei it will be quite easy to train.$B$BWe shall face it against the ogres of the region that you are familiar with. The Gorian Beast-Lasher, the one that smells of blood and fear, see how this elekk reacts to him.
english.completion: Those beasts will recover, in time. Let us rest for tonight, you have done well.
english.completed: Return to Tormak the Scarred in your garrison.

text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的草地践踏者去击败暗翼大鹏。
text.description: 纳格兰的风鹏是一种非常聪明的捕食者，它们经常成群结队地突袭猎物。要是你的坐骑不时刻注意着天空的话，就可得跟它这双眼睛说再见了。$B$B去纳格兰干掉那里最凶猛的风鹏——暗翼大鹏。这对你的坐骑来说是个不错的试炼。

text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的草地践踏者去击败铁钻。
text.description: 你解决掉了陆地和天空的敌人，甚至还有雷雨。接下来你将面对你脚底下的动物。$B$B岩虫是一种狡猾的捕食者，它们喜欢从沙土底下钻出来袭击敌人。在纳格兰，很多野兽都学会了注意脚底下的动静。带你的座狼去那边的沙滩，尝试干掉那里的老岩虫：铁钻。
text.completion: You stand strong, though the ground crumbles. Admirable.$B$BAllow your mount to rest for the night.

text.title: 淡水兽训练：格兹兰
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的淡水兽去击败格兹兰。
text.description: 这头动物在塔拉多生活过一段时间，我们不如就从那里开始展开训练。这家伙看起来挺温驯的，和其它坐骑相比的话，我想训练它不会花太多时间。$B$B你可能已经知道了，潜伏者擅长隐匿在环境中，靠近并偷窃附近猎物的蛋。让我们瞧瞧你的淡水兽能否识破这天然的伪装。
text.completion: A savage beast, but you have triumphed. Fine work, I will get your mount some water.
text.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

english.title: Riverbeast Training: Gezz'ran
english.objectives: Defeat Gezz'ran while riding your Riverbeast-In-Training.
english.description: This bulbous beast has spent a number of years in the wilds of Talador. We will begin the training there. It is already docile, as well, so I do not think it will take as long to train as the others.$B$BAs you know, stalkers can blend into their environments, allowing them to sneak in and steal the eggs of nearby prey. See if you and your riverbeast can't overcome this natural defense mechanism.
english.completion: A savage beast, but you have triumphed. Fine work, I will get your mount some water.
english.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

text.title: 淡水兽训练：布巴波尔
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的淡水兽去击败布巴波尔。
text.description: 在遥远南方的阿兰卡峰林，生长在水下的蘑菇正在不断地侵蚀着陆地，古怪的真菌生物四处横行。$B$B其中有一个真菌巨人叫布巴波尔，正好让你的坐骑见识一下它不曾见过的捕食者。
text.completion: You have returned victorious. I will bed your mount down for the night.
text.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

english.objectives: Defeat Bulbapore while riding your Riverbeast-In-Training.
english.description: In the far south, in the Spires of Arak, the land is being swallowed by the mushrooms that grow underwater, and strange fungal creatures grow uninhibited.$B$BTaking on a strange creature, like the fungal giant Bulbapore, will grant you a chance to expose your mount to unfamiliar predators.

text.objectives: Defeat the Darkwing Roc while riding your Riverbeast-In-Training.
text.description: The windrocs of Nagrand are a smart predator, often swooping down on unwary prey in packs. If your beast doesn't keep an eye on the sky, it's likely to lose both.$B$BTravel to Nagrand and take on the fiercest windroc of the bunch, the Darkwing Roc. It will be a good test for your mount.
text.completion: From now on, your mount will always remember to keep one eye on the skies.
text.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

english.title: Riverbeast Training: Darkwing Roc
english.objectives: Defeat the Darkwing Roc while riding your Riverbeast-In-Training.
english.description: The windrocs of Nagrand are a smart predator, often swooping down on unwary prey in packs. If your beast doesn't keep an eye on the sky, it's likely to lose both.$B$BTravel to Nagrand and take on the fiercest windroc of the bunch, the Darkwing Roc. It will be a good test for your mount.
english.completion: From now on, your mount will always remember to keep one eye on the skies.
english.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

text.title: 淡水兽训练：暴怒飞蛾
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的淡水兽去击败暴怒飞蛾。
text.description: 在纳格兰的森林中有许多善于躲避捕食者的动物。但其中又要属那只名叫暴怒飞蛾的蛾子做的最好，它浑身覆满了充满恶臭的飞蛾之尘。$B$B如果它能让附近的野狼都不得不退避三舍，这对你的淡水兽来说一定是一次非常美妙的试炼。看看你能不能让它保持专注，干掉那只飞蛾吧。
text.completion: Glad to see you back. I will need some time to brush that dust off of your mount.
text.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

english.title: Riverbeast Training: Moth of Wrath
english.objectives: Defeat the Moth of Wrath while riding your Riverbeast-In-Training.
english.description: Deep in the forests of Nagrand are some beasts capable of evading almost any predator. The greatest of them all, the Moth of Wrath, is coated with a foul-smelling dust.$B$BIf the moth dust is enough to keep wolves at bay, it will probably be a pretty good test for your riverbeast. See if you can keep it focused and defeat the moth.
english.completion: Glad to see you back. I will need some time to brush that dust off of your mount.
english.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

text.title: 淡水兽训练：雷鸣
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的淡水兽去击败雷鸣。
text.description: 元素生物有时候也会对野兽构成威胁。即使是最强大座狼也常会被远处的雷声所惊吓。$B$B在纳格兰的海岸，有一处迎风而立的峭壁。在那峭壁上有一只由纯粹的雷雨构成的生物，它的名字叫雷鸣。骑上你的坐骑去那儿对付它，让我们瞧瞧结果如何。
text.completion: Your mount is bit wet, but seems to be in good spirits. I will dry it off and put it to rest.
text.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

english.title: Riverbeast Training: Thundercall
english.objectives: Defeat Thundercall while riding your Riverbeast-In-Training.
english.description: The elements can sometimes pose a problem for some beasts. Even the mightiest wolf will often cower at the sound of thunder in the distance.$B$BIn Nagrand, off on a windswept cliff high above the shore, is a creature made of pure thunderstorms. Hop atop your beast and face off against Thundercall, and we will see how your mount fares.
english.completion: Your mount is bit wet, but seems to be in good spirits. I will dry it off and put it to rest.
english.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

text.title: 淡水兽训练：铁钻
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的淡水兽去击败铁钻。
text.description: 你解决掉了陆地和天空的敌人，甚至还有雷雨。接下来你将面对你脚底下的动物。$B$B岩虫是一种狡猾的捕食者，它们喜欢从沙土底下钻出来袭击敌人。在纳格兰，很多野兽都学会了注意脚底下的动静。带你的座狼去那边的沙滩，尝试干掉那里的老岩虫：铁钻。
text.completion: You stand strong, though the ground crumbles. Admirable.$B$BAllow your mount to rest for the night.
text.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

english.title: Riverbeast Training: Ironbore
english.objectives: Defeat Ironbore while riding your Riverbeast-In-Training.
english.description: You have defeated foes in the sky and on land, and even in the rain. Next, you face beasts beneath your very feet.$B$BThe rockworm is a cunning predator, striking at prey from below the sands. Many beasts of Nagrand have grown wary of the rumbling of the earth. Take your mount on out to the sandy shores test it against the elder worm Ironbore.
english.completion: You stand strong, though the ground crumbles. Admirable.$B$BAllow your mount to rest for the night.
english.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

text.title: Riverbeast Training: Orc Hunters
text.objectives: Defeat Karak the Great Hunter while riding your Riverbeast-In-Training.
text.description: The Warsong Clan of Nagrand are some of the finest hunters the world of Draenor has ever known. Their beast-killers will aid us in putting this mount to the test.$B$BOut in Nagrand, you will find an orc by the name of Karak, the Great Hunter. He has slain more fierce beasts than any other in the clan. Face him astride your mount, and avenge the slain.
text.completion: Ah, you have hunted the hunter. Many beasts will be pleased tonight.
text.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

english.title: Riverbeast Training: Orc Hunters
english.objectives: Defeat Karak the Great Hunter while riding your Riverbeast-In-Training.
english.description: The Warsong Clan of Nagrand are some of the finest hunters the world of Draenor has ever known. Their beast-killers will aid us in putting this mount to the test.$B$BOut in Nagrand, you will find an orc by the name of Karak, the Great Hunter. He has slain more fierce beasts than any other in the clan. Face him astride your mount, and avenge the slain.
english.completion: Ah, you have hunted the hunter. Many beasts will be pleased tonight.
english.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

text.title: 淡水兽训练：铁颚狼
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的淡水兽去击败残爪。
text.description: 你的坐骑的最后一项挑战将是面对这片大地上最可怕的一种动物。$B$B有一种狼，他们的皮肤像夜晚一样漆黑，他们体型比一般的狼要大上一倍，它们就是铁颚狼。它们转眼间就能把一个兽人撕成两半，野兽们害怕它们不是没有理由的。$B$B现在有一头孤独的铁颚狼跑到了纳格兰定居。骑上你的淡水兽去干掉它，如果你们两个能够生还，你的淡水兽才真正算是准备好了。
text.completion: I had never seen such a beast before coming here, but you have trained it. No small feat, to be certain. Take the reins, you have earned them.
text.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

english.title: Riverbeast Training: The Garn
english.objectives: Defeat Maimclaw while riding your Riverbeast-In-Training.
english.description: The last test for your mount will pit it against one of the great terrors of this land.$B$BThe garn. Wolves as black as night, and twice the size of a normal wolf, they can tear an orc apart in mere moments. The beasts here wisely fear them.$B$BThere is a lone garn that calls Nagrand its home. Take your riverbeast, mount up, and bring it down. If the two of you survive, your riverbeast will truly be ready.
english.completion: I had never seen such a beast before coming here, but you have trained it. No small feat, to be certain. Take the reins, you have earned them.
english.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

text.title: 角斗士的召唤
text.objectives: 把悬槌徽记带给纳格兰悬槌角斗场的卡格。
text.description: 你的无双战绩已经引起了广泛关注，角斗士。有那么多的敌人在你的力量面前纷纷倒地，你无可匹敌的战斗力甚至传入了马尔高克元首的耳朵里。元首亲自邀请你去悬槌角斗场展现你的力量。那座角斗场就位于悬槌堡中，一场史诗般的战斗在等着你。$B$B身为一名角斗士，倘若你的内心愿意听从这份召唤，就把这个徽记带给我的兄弟卡格吧。他是竞技场大师，就待在纳格兰的角斗场外面。
text.completion: A bold decision, gladiator. For most, death is the only thing they find at the Coliseum. Surviving here is more than a test of skill, it is a test of wills. Do you have the fortitude to become a champion?

english.title: Call of the Gladiator
english.objectives: Take the Sigil of Highmaul to Kharg outside the Highmaul Coliseum in Nagrand.
english.description: Your merciless rampage has not gone unnoticed, gladiator. So many of your enemies have fallen before your might. It is because of your unrelenting savagery that Imperator Mar'gok himself has requested your presence at the grand Highmaul Coliseum. It is at Highmaul that a battle of epic proportions awaits.$B$BShould you heed the call of the gladiator, present this sigil to my brother, Kharg. He is the arena master residing outside of the Coliseum in Nagrand.
english.completion: A bold decision, gladiator. For most, death is the only thing they find at the Coliseum. Surviving here is more than a test of skill, it is a test of wills. Do you have the fortitude to become a champion?

text.title: 战斗！杀戮！欢呼！
text.objectives: 在悬槌角斗场中干掉100名角斗士。$B$B你可以通过与悬槌堡的卡格对话或在你的角斗士圣殿中与骨渣对话来进入角斗场。
text.description: 德拉诺最强大的角斗士们在角斗场里为荣耀与名誉而战。你究竟会成为下一个卡加斯·刃拳式的传奇人物，还是会在另一名凶残角斗士的战靴底下化为尘埃呢？只有一个方法能找到答案。$B$B你必须参与到这场对决中来，奋勇一战！胜利的条件是干掉100个对手！$B$B每天我会允许你免费入场一次，但假如你输了却还想继续战斗，那就要用你的血肉来支付入场费了！
text.completion: Remarkable! You have proven yourself a true gladiator. And to a true gladiator goes more than honor and glory!
text.completed: Return to Kharg outside the Highmaul Coliseum in Nagrand.

english.title: Fight, Kill, Salute!
english.objectives: Kill 100 Gladiators at the Coliseum in Highmaul.$B$BYou may access the Coliseum by talking to Kharg at Highmaul or Boneslag at your Gladiator's Sanctum.
english.description: The greatest gladiators on Draenor have fought for glory and honor inside the Coliseum. Will you become a legend like Kargath Bladefist or will you be nothing more than bone dust beneath the boots of a more savage gladiator? There is only one way to find out.$B$BYou must enter the competition and fight! The price of victory is 100 lives!$B$BI will admit you without cost once per day, but if you fail and wish to fight again you must pay the price of admission in blood and bone!
english.completion: Remarkable! You have proven yourself a true gladiator. And to a true gladiator goes more than honor and glory!
english.completed: Return to Kharg outside the Highmaul Coliseum in Nagrand.

text.title: 废物利用
text.objectives: 在废品站的焚化炉附近使用一小袋回收的物资。
text.description:
在废品站，你可以查看你的追随者们从战场上带回来的额外材料，并把所有有用的东西保留下来。

我手头有一包我们的人带回来的额外材料，但还没仔细分拣过。要不你就把它带到焚化炉那边去，看看里面还有没有什么能用的东西。
text.progress: Have you burned through that bag of salvage yet?
text.completion: That's all? Well. don't feel too bad. Some days we find nothing and the next we hit the jackpot!$b$bHere, I have a fresh supply of items from our latest outing. Check them out.$b$bGood luck!
text.completed: Return to Hennick Helmsley at the Salvage Yard in your garrison.

english.title: Salvaging the Situation
english.objectives: Use the Small Sack of Salavaged Goods near the incinerator at your Salvage Yard.
english.description:
Here at the Salvage Yard we inspect any extra material your followers bring back from the field, preserving anything that may be useful.

I have an extra pack of material our people brought in that I've yet to go through. Why don't you take it over to the incinerator and see if it contains anything useful?
english.progress: Have you burned through that bag of salvage yet?
english.completion: That's all? Well. don't feel too bad. Some days we find nothing and the next we hit the jackpot!$b$bHere, I have a fresh supply of items from our latest outing. Check them out.$b$bGood luck!
english.completed: Return to Hennick Helmsley at the Salvage Yard in your garrison.

text.title: 运输失误
text.objectives: 收集$1oa箱剩余物资。
text.description:
$G先生:女士;，仓库已经全面投入使用，我已经妥善存放了你的补给品，并一一登记在册。

可惜我在盘点物资的过程中发现，我们弄丢了几箱剩余物资——可能是被搬运工放错地方了。

要是你在巡视时发现任何剩余物资的话，请把它们交给我，我会更新我们的货品清单。
text.progress: Hello commander, what can I do for you?
text.completion: According to the ledger this appears to be everything we're missing. Those porters will be cleaning the latrines tonight for this!
text.completed: Return to Kyra Goldhands at the Storehouse in your garrison.

english.title: Lost in Transition
english.objectives: Gather $1oa Crate of Surplus Materials.
english.description:
$GSir:Ma'am;, the storehouse is fully operational and I've seen to it that your supplies are safely stored away and accounted for.

Unfortunately, during the rest of my audit I found that we are missing a few crates of surplus material - probably misplaced by one of the porters.

If you happen to come across any of the surplus crates while making your rounds, please bring them to me and I'll update our ledger.
english.progress: Hello commander, what can I do for you?
english.completion: According to the ledger this appears to be everything we're missing. Those porters will be cleaning the latrines tonight for this!
english.completed: Return to Kyra Goldhands at the Storehouse in your garrison.

text.title: 商业机密
text.objectives: 找到并唤醒失踪的商人。
text.description:
为了打发时间，商人们通常会喝点小酒来提提神，你懂的吧。

但有时候，有些人会喝得太多。你的商人可能刚迈出门就倒在树下睡过去了。这种事情也是时有发生。

幸运的是，我这有一种专门用来弄醒这些酒醉商人的饮料。只要泼上一点，他们就会更愿意起来干活。
text.completion: You have learned one of my tricks of the trade, $n.
text.completed: Return to Trader Joseph at the Trading Post in your garrison.

english.title: Tricks of the Trade
english.objectives: Find and rouse the missing Trader.
english.description:
To pass the time, traders have been known to consume beverages of an inspired nature, if you know what I mean.

Sometimes, they drink a bit too much. Your trader might have stumbled beyond the gates and passed out under a tree. It's been known to happen from time to time.

Luckily, I have a brew that I use to rouse groggy traders. One splash and I find they're more willing to work.
english.completion: $n, you $gBegot: Begot: One of the secrets of my craft.
english.completed: Return to Trader Joseph at the Trading Post in your garrison.

text.title: Unconventional Inventions
text.objectives: Acquire an invention from the workbench at the Gnomish Gearworks.
text.description:
The workshop is bustling with the whir of minds and motors. We're coming up with new inventions all the time.

Try out today's glorious invention on the workbench behind me.
text.completion: Nice invention!
text.completed: Return to Zee at the Gnomish Gearworks in your garrison.

english.title: Unconventional Inventions
english.objectives: Acquire an invention from the workbench at the Gnomish Gearworks.
english.description:
The workshop is bustling with the whir of minds and motors. We're coming up with new inventions all the time.

Try out today's glorious invention on the workbench behind me.
english.completion: Nice invention!
english.completed: Return to Zee at the Gnomish Gearworks in your garrison.

text.title: 收废铁
text.objectives: 从德拉诺的钢铁部落成员身上收集$1oa块钢铁部落碎片。
text.description:
在矮人地堡，我们可以把你收集到的钢铁部落护甲碎片打造成新的装备。尽管那并不是世上最坚实的材料，看起来还不错。

去找些钢铁部落碎片，然后回来找我。我会给你一件体面的战袍作为奖励。
text.progress: Got those scraps?
text.completion: Those scraps will do.
text.completed: Return to Kristen Stoneforge at the Dwarven Bunker in your garrison.

english.title: Scraps of Iron
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Iron Horde Scraps from Iron Horde on Draenor.
english.description:
At the Dwarven Bunker, we can take scraps of Iron Horde armor that you collect and turn them into new gear. It's not the strongest stuff in the world, but it looks good.

Get some Iron Horde scraps and come back my way. I'll set you up with a nice tabard for your troubles.
english.progress: Got those scraps?
english.completion: Those scraps will do.
english.completed: Return to Kristen Stoneforge at the Dwarven Bunker in your garrison.

text.title: 塔布羊训练：巨齿
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的塔布羊去击败巨齿。
text.description: 你的塔布羊已经准备好接受下一步的训练了，为了开始训练，我们得带它回到它的故乡影月谷。$B$B那里有一头叫做巨齿的野兽占领了那座山谷。带你的坐骑去与它一战吧，假如你们能活着回来，一定能极大地增强它的自信。
text.completion: That was a fine battle to test your talbuk against. It will need to rest before we can continue the training.
text.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

english.title: Talbuk Training: Great-Tusk
english.objectives: Defeat Great-Tusk while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
english.description: The talbuk is ready for more training, and for this, we will return to its home in Shadowmoon Valley.$B$BOne of the great beasts of this land, Great-Tusk, has taken the valley for his own. Pit your beast against him in combat, and if you should survive, it will have greater confidence in its own abilities.
english.completion: That was a fine battle to test your talbuk against. It will need to rest before we can continue the training.
english.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

text.title: 塔布羊训练：拉基尔
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的塔布羊去击败拉基尔。
text.description: 我们得在这片冰封的霜火岭雪原中开始训练你的塔布羊。必须先让他适应严酷的环境，否则它可能一进入战斗就被吓跑。$B$B在冰原上找到那只吸血大鸟拉基尔，并骑上你的塔布羊去干掉它。这能让它体验到战斗的滋味。
text.completion: Your talbuk is growing quickly, let us let it rest.
text.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

english.title: Talbuk Training: Rakkiri
english.objectives: Defeat Rakkiri while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
english.description: We shall start training the talbuk here, on the icy plains of Frostfire Ridge. We must train it rigorously, or else it may become afraid at the sight of combat, and run.$B$BFind the great blood-sucker, Rakkiri, out on the frozen plains, and bring him down astride your talbuk. That will give it a taste for combat.
english.completion: Your talbuk is growing quickly, let us let it rest.
english.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

text.title: 塔布羊训练：裂鞭
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的塔布羊去击败裂鞭。
text.description: 许多坐骑在见到凶残的捕食者时都会吓得腿软。而在戈尔隆德荒凉的峭壁间，生存着世上最凶残的捕食者。你将在那里迎接下一场挑战。$B$B带上你的坐骑去大迅猛龙裂鞭的巢穴，看看你能否得胜归来。
text.completion: A mighty kill. Your beast will need to rest now.
text.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

english.title: Talbuk Training: Riplash
english.objectives: Defeat Riplash while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
english.description: Many beasts will cower in fear at the sight of a mighty predator. In the desolate cliffs of Gorgrond lives one of the most fierce. It will prove your next challenge.$B$BTake your beast to the nest of the great Riplash, and see if you cannot emerge victorious.
english.completion: A mighty kill. Your beast will need to rest now.
english.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

text.title: 塔布羊训练：格兹兰
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的塔布羊去击败格兹兰。
text.description: 德拉诺的许多生物都是在最为严酷的环境中成长起来的。在这当中，最狡猾的要数潜伏者。$B$B这种怪物可以潜伏在环境之中，潜行并偷取附近猎物的蛋。这次让我们瞧瞧你的坐骑能否识破这种天然的伪装。你可以在塔拉多找到合适的潜伏者。
text.completion: A savage beast, but you have triumphed. Fine work, I will get your mount some water.
text.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

english.title: Talbuk Training: Gezz'ran
english.objectives: Defeat Gezz'ran while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
english.description: Many of the creatures of Draenor have grown and thrived in a most hostile environment. One of the most cunning is the stalker.$B$BStalkers can blend into their environments, allowing them to sneak in and steal the eggs of nearby prey. See if you and your beast can overcome this natural defense mechanism. You will find a proper predator in Talador.
english.completion: A savage beast, but you have triumphed. Fine work, I will get your mount some water.
english.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

text.title: 塔布羊训练：布巴波尔
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的塔布羊去击败布巴波尔。
text.description: 在遥远南方的阿兰卡峰林，生长在水下的蘑菇正在不断地侵蚀着陆地，古怪的真菌生物四处横行。$B$B其中有一个真菌巨人叫布巴波尔，正好让你的坐骑见识一下它不曾见过的捕食者。
text.completion: You have returned victorious. I will bed your mount down for the night.
text.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

english.title: Talbuk Training: Bulbapore
english.objectives: Defeat Bulbapore while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
english.description: In the far south, in the Spires of Arak, the land is being swallowed by the mushrooms that grow underwater, and strange fungal creatures grow uninhibited.$B$BTaking on a strange creature, like the fungal giant Bulbapore, will grant you a chance to expose your mount to unfamiliar predators.
english.completion: You have returned victorious. I will bed your mount down for the night.
english.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.
